title: 80-20 Rule of Problematic Clients
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 01/19/2015
WITH t1 AS (
SELECT 
j.client_name,
j.server_name,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT j.job_type_name) job_types,
SUM(j.duration_secs) duration,
SUM(j.kilobytes/1024/1024) size_gb,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.kilobytes > 4096 THEN j.mbytes_sec ELSE NULL END) mbytes_sec,
SUM(j.nbr_of_files) nbr_of_files,
SUM(DECODE(j.summary_status,2,1,0)) most_failures,
SUM(DECODE(j.summary_status,1,1,0)) most_partials
FROM apt_v_job j
WHERE start_date between ${startDate} and ${endDate}
AND j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.client_id <> j.server_id
GROUP BY
j.client_name,
j.server_name
),
largest AS (
SELECT 1 sort_order,  ' Largest' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, 
CASE
WHEN size_gb < 1024 THEN ROUND(size_gb,2)||' GB' 
WHEN size_gb > 1024 THEN ROUND(size_gb/1024,2)||' TB' 
END value 
FROM t1
WHERE size_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY size_gb DESC
),
longest AS (
SELECT 2 sort_order,  ' Longest Running' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(duration)||' Hrs' value
FROM t1
ORDER BY duration DESC
),
slowest AS (
SELECT 3 sort_order,  ' Slowest' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, ROUND(mbytes_sec,2)||' MB/Sec' value 
FROM t1
WHERE mbytes_sec > 0
ORDER BY mbytes_sec ASC
),
most_files AS (
SELECT 4 sort_order,  ' Most Files' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, 
CASE 
WHEN nbr_of_files > 1000000 THEN ROUND(nbr_of_files/1000000,1)||' Million Files'
WHEN nbr_of_files < 1000000 THEN ROUND(nbr_of_files/1000,0)||' Thousand Files'
END value 
FROM t1
WHERE nbr_of_files IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY nbr_of_files DESC
),
most_failures AS (
SELECT 5 sort_order,  ' Most Failures' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, most_failures||' Failed Jobs' value  
FROM t1
WHERE most_failures > 0
ORDER BY most_failures DESC
),
most_partials AS (
SELECT 6 sort_order,  ' Most Partials' metric, 
client_name, server_name, job_types, most_partials||' Partial Jobs' value  
FROM t1
WHERE most_partials > 0
ORDER BY most_partials DESC
),
t2 AS (
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM slowest
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM largest
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order,rownum  rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM longest
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order,rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM most_files
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order,rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM most_partials
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order,rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,client_name, server_name, job_types, value FROM most_failures
WHERE rownum <= ${freeCombo1}
),
occurrences AS (
SELECT
client_name,
COUNT(*) occurrences,
aptStringConcat(metric) other_bad_things
FROM t2
GROUP BY client_name
)
SELECT t2.*, occurrences,
DECODE(occurrences,1,'white',2,'yellow','red') status_dot,
other_bad_things,
REPLACE(REPLACE(other_bad_things,',',' '),metric,'') also
FROM t2, occurrences occ
WHERE
t2.client_name = occ.client_name
ORDER BY
sort_order ASC, rank ASC

title: 80-20 Rule of Problematic VM Guests
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/31/2015
WITH 
memstats AS (
SELECT
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name guest_host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_memory_usage_kb/1024/1024),2) max_memory_usage_gb,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_memory_usage_pct),2) max_memory_usage_pct,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_balloon_memory_kb/1024),2) max_baloon_memory_usage_gb
FROM apt_v_vmw_perform_memory_log p, apt_v_partition g, apt_v_virtual_system v, aps_v_host h
WHERE g.partition_id  = p.partition_id (+)
AND p.end_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND g.collection_status != 3
AND g.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND g.host_id = h.host_id
AND g.virtual_system_id = v.virtual_system_id
AND h.host_name <> v.virtual_system_name --this table has both guests and ESX servers
GROUP BY 
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name
),
cpustats AS (
SELECT
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name guest_host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_cpu_usage_mhz/1000),2) max_cpu_usage_ghz, --MHz converted to GHz
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_cpu_usage_pct),2) max_cpu_usage_pct,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_cpu_wait_ms),2) max_cpu_wait_ms,
ROUND(MAX(p.avg_cpu_ready_ms),2) max_cpu_ready_ms
FROM apt_v_vmw_perform_cpu_log p, apt_v_partition g, apt_v_virtual_system v, aps_v_host h
WHERE g.partition_id  = p.partition_id (+)
AND p.end_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND g.collection_status != 3
AND g.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND g.host_id = h.host_id
AND g.virtual_system_id = v.virtual_system_id
AND h.host_name <> v.virtual_system_name --this table has both guests and ESX servers
GROUP BY 
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name
),
diskstats AS (
SELECT
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name guest_host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name,
ROUND(AVG(p.disk_read_kbps/1024),2) disk_read_data_xfer_mbps,
ROUND(AVG(p.disk_write_kbps/1024),2) disk_write_data_xfer_mbps,
ROUND(AVG(NVL(p.total_device_latency_ms,0)),2) average_device_latency_ms, 
ROUND(MAX(NVL(p.total_device_latency_ms,0)),2) max_device_latency_ms, 
ROUND(SUM(p.nbr_of_disk_read),2) disk_read_nbr_reads, 
ROUND(AVG(NVL(p.avg_device_read_latency_ms,0)),2) disk_read_latency_ms, 
ROUND(SUM(p.nbr_of_disk_write),2) disk_write_nbr_writes, 
ROUND(AVG(NVL(p.avg_device_write_latency_ms,0)),2) disk_write_latency_ms
FROM apt_v_vmw_perform_disk_log p, apt_v_partition g, apt_v_virtual_system v, aps_v_host h
WHERE g.partition_id  = p.partition_id (+)
AND p.start_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND g.collection_status != 3
AND p.instance_name IS NOT NULL
AND g.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND g.host_id = h.host_id
AND g.virtual_system_id = v.virtual_system_id
GROUP BY 
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name
),
capstats AS (
SELECT
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name guest_host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name,
ROUND(MAX(total_size_kb/1024/1024),2) total_size_gb
FROM apt_v_vmw_virtual_machine_log p, apt_v_partition g, apt_v_virtual_system v, aps_v_host h
WHERE g.partition_id  = p.partition_id (+)
AND p.log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND g.collection_status != 3
AND g.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND g.host_id = h.host_id
AND g.virtual_system_id = v.virtual_system_id
AND h.host_name <> v.virtual_system_name --this table has both guests and ESX servers
GROUP BY 
g.partition_id, g.partition_name, 
g.host_id, h.host_name,
v.virtual_system_id, v.virtual_system_name
),
guestcount AS (
SELECT count(*) guest_count
FROM cpustats
),
most_cpu_usage_ghz AS (
SELECT 0 sort_order,  ' Most CPU Usage' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(max_cpu_usage_ghz)||'GHz' value 
FROM cpustats
ORDER BY max_cpu_usage_ghz DESC
),
most_cpu_usage_PCT AS (
SELECT 1 sort_order,  ' Most CPU %Used' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(max_cpu_usage_pct)||'%' value 
FROM cpustats
ORDER BY max_cpu_usage_pct DESC
),
most_memory_usage AS (
SELECT 2 sort_order,  ' Most Peak Memory Usage' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
max_memory_usage_gb||'GB' value 
FROM memstats
WHERE max_memory_usage_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY max_memory_usage_gb DESC
),
most_memory_usage_pct AS (
SELECT 3 sort_order,  ' Most Peak Memory %Used' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
max_memory_usage_pct||'%' value 
FROM memstats
ORDER BY max_memory_usage_pct DESC
),
most_disk_reads AS (
SELECT 4 sort_order,  ' Most Disk Reads' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(disk_read_nbr_reads)||' Reads' value 
FROM diskstats
ORDER BY disk_read_nbr_reads DESC
),
most_disk_writes AS (
SELECT 5 sort_order,  ' Most Disk writes' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(disk_write_nbr_writes)||' Writes' value 
FROM diskstats
ORDER BY disk_write_nbr_writes DESC
),
most_read_mbps AS (
SELECT 6 sort_order,  ' Highest Disk Read MB/Sec' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(disk_read_data_xfer_mbps)||' KB/Sec' value 
FROM diskstats
ORDER BY disk_read_data_xfer_mbps DESC
),
most_write_mbps AS (
SELECT 7 sort_order,  ' Highest Disk Write MB/Sec' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(disk_write_data_xfer_mbps)||' KB/Sec' value 
FROM diskstats
ORDER BY disk_write_data_xfer_mbps DESC
),
most_max_device_latency AS (
SELECT 9 sort_order,  ' Most Peak Device Latency' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(max_device_latency_ms)||' ms.' value 
FROM diskstats
ORDER BY max_device_latency_ms DESC
),
most_total_size_gb AS (
SELECT 8 sort_order,  ' Most Disk Usage' metric, 
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name, 
ROUND(total_size_gb)||' GB' value 
FROM capstats
WHERE total_size_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_size_gb DESC
),
t2 AS (
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_memory_usage
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_memory_usage_pct
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_cpu_usage_ghz
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_cpu_usage_pct
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_disk_reads
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_disk_writes
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_read_mbps
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_write_mbps
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_max_device_latency
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
UNION
SELECT sort_order, rownum rank, rownum||DECODE(rownum,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||metric metric,
virtual_system_id, virtual_system_name,  partition_id, partition_name, host_id, guest_host_name,value 
FROM most_total_size_gb
WHERE rownum <=  ${freeCombo1}
),
occurrences AS (
SELECT
partition_name,
COUNT(*) occurrences,
aptStringConcat(metric) other_bad_things
FROM t2
GROUP BY partition_name
)
SELECT t2.*, occurrences, guest_count,
DECODE(occurrences,1,'white',2,'yellow','red') status_dot,
other_bad_things,
REPLACE(REPLACE(other_bad_things,',',' '),metric,'') also
FROM t2, occurrences occ, guestcount
WHERE
t2.partition_name = occ.partition_name
ORDER BY
sort_order ASC, rank ASC

title: APTARE 90 Day NBU Backup Assessment
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last updated: 09/05/2012
WITH 
t1 AS (--Individual Job Statistics
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.server_id END) server_count1,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.server_id END) server_count2,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.server_id END) server_count3,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.media_server_id END) media_server_count1,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.media_server_id END) media_server_count2,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.media_server_id END) media_server_count3,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.client_id END) client_count1,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.client_id END) client_count2,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.client_id END) client_count3,
COUNT(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.job_id END) job_count1,
COUNT(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.job_id END) job_count2,
COUNT(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.job_id END) job_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,0,1,0) END) successful_job_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,0,1,0) END) successful_job_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,0,1,0) END) successful_job_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,1,1,0) END) partial_job_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,1,1,0) END) partial_job_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,1,1,0) END) partial_job_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,2,1,0) END) failed_job_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,2,1,0) END) failed_job_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.summary_status,2,1,0) END) failed_job_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob515_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob515_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob515_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob15_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob15_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN CASE WHEN (started_readwrite - start_date)*24*60 >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) qjob15_count3,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) avg_duration1,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) avg_duration2,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) avg_duration3,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) max_duration1,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) max_duration2,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.duration_secs/60 END) max_duration3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_l12_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_l12_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 0 AND 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_l12_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 12 AND 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_12_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 12 AND 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_12_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 BETWEEN 12 AND 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_12_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 >= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_24_count1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 >= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_24_count2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN CASE WHEN duration_secs/60/60 >= 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) job_24_count3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.job_type,101,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) full_job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,101,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) full_job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,101,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) full_job_volume3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.job_type,102,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) incr_job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,102,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) incr_job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,102,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) incr_job_volume3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.job_type,112,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) appl_job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,112,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) appl_job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,112,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) appl_job_volume3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN DECODE(j.job_type,107,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) dup_job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,107,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) dup_job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN DECODE(j.job_type,107,j.kilobytes/1024/1024,0) END) dup_job_volume3,

t2 AS (--Daily Aggregates
SELECT 
MAX(max_mb_sec1) max_daily_mb_sec1,
MAX(max_mb_sec2) max_daily_mb_sec2,
MAX(max_mb_sec3) max_daily_mb_sec3,
AVG(max_mb_sec1) avg_daily_mb_sec1,
AVG(max_mb_sec2) avg_daily_mb_sec2,
AVG(max_mb_sec3) avg_daily_mb_sec3,
AVG(job_volume1) avg_daily_job_volume1,
AVG(job_volume2) avg_daily_job_volume2,
AVG(job_volume3) avg_daily_job_volume3,
MAX(job_volume1) max_daily_job_volume1,
MAX(job_volume2) max_daily_job_volume2,
MAX(job_volume3) max_daily_job_volume3,
AVG(tot_nbr_of_files1) avg_daily_nbr_of_files1,
AVG(tot_nbr_of_files2) avg_daily_nbr_of_files2,
AVG(tot_nbr_of_files3) avg_daily_nbr_of_files3,
MAX(tot_nbr_of_files1) max_daily_nbr_of_files1,
MAX(tot_nbr_of_files2) max_daily_nbr_of_files2,
MAX(tot_nbr_of_files3) max_daily_nbr_of_files3
FROM
(SELECT
TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY'),
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.mbytes_sec END) max_mb_sec1,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.mbytes_sec END) max_mb_sec2,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.mbytes_sec END) max_mb_sec3,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.mbytes_sec END) avg_mb_sec1,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.mbytes_sec END) avg_mb_sec2,
AVG(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.mbytes_sec END) avg_mb_sec3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) job_volume3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.nbr_of_files END) tot_nbr_of_files1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.nbr_of_files END) tot_nbr_of_files2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.nbr_of_files END) tot_nbr_of_files3
FROM apt_v_nbu_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate
AND j.job_type <> 105
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY'))
),
t3 AS (--Future Expiring data
SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) tot_data_expiring1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) tot_data_expiring2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) tot_data_expiring3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_30_1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_30_2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_30_3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+365.25 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_1y_1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+365.25 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_1y_2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date AND j.start_date+365.25 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_1y_3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date+356.25 AND j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_5y_1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date+356.25 AND j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_5y_2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 AND j.expiration_date BETWEEN j.start_date+356.25 AND j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_5y_3,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_o5_1,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_o5_2,
SUM(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 AND j.expiration_date > j.start_date+1826 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) data_expiring_o5_3
FROM apt_v_nbu_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate
AND j.job_type <> 105
),
t4 AS (--Failed Clients 
SELECT
COUNT(failed_client1) failed_clients1,
COUNT(failed_client2) failed_clients2,
COUNT(failed_client3) failed_clients3
FROM (SELECT
j.client_id,
TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY'),
MIN(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.summary_status END) failed_client1,
MIN(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.summary_status END) failed_client2,
MIN(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.summary_status END) failed_client3
FROM apt_v_nbu_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate
GROUP BY j.client_id, TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')
HAVING MIN(j.summary_status) = 2)
),
t5 AS (--Sum of the largest full for each client done in a day. AKA Front End GB
SELECT
SUM(sum_of_fulls1) sum_of_fulls1,
SUM(sum_of_fulls2) sum_of_fulls2,
SUM(sum_of_fulls3) sum_of_fulls3
FROM (SELECT
j.client_id,j.policy_id,j.schedule_id,TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY'),
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate    THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) sum_of_fulls1,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) sum_of_fulls2,
MAX(CASE WHEN j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN j.kilobytes/1024/1024 END) sum_of_fulls3
FROM apt_v_nbu_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate
AND j.job_type IN (101)
GROUP BY j.client_id,j.policy_id,j.schedule_id,TO_CHAR(j.start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY'))
)

title: Ad Hoc Backup Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/19/2019
--Job Volume(GB),Total Job Count,Successful Job Count,Partial Job Count,Failed Job Count,Client Count,File Count,Duration Hrs
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT 
  DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days',1,'Weeks',7,'Months',31,'Quarters',93,'Years',365.25) AS day_multiplier,
  TO_NUMBER('${freeCombo3}') forecast_periods
FROM apt_v_dual
),
/***********************************************/
m0 AS (
SELECT --Result set starts here
 TRUNC(j.start_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')) AS the_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Job Volume(GB)' THEN SUM(j.kilobytes/1024/1024)
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Total Job Count' THEN COUNT(j.job_id)    
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Successful Job Count' THEN SUM(DECODE(summary_status,0,1,0))    
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Partial Job Count' THEN SUM(DECODE(summary_status,1,1,0))    
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Failed Job Count' THEN SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0))    
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Client Count' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT j.client_id) 
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'File Count' THEN SUM(j.nbr_of_files) 
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' = 'Duration Hrs' THEN SUM(j.duration_secs/60/60) 
  END AS the_value
FROM 
  apt_v_job j, var
WHERE 
  j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND j.client_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY 
 TRUNC(j.start_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years'))
ORDER BY 1
),
/***********************************************/
t1 AS (--Group the together if more than one were selected
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) the_period,
  the_date,
  ROUND(SUM(the_value),2) the_value
FROM 
  m0
GROUP BY 
  the_date
ORDER BY 
  the_date
),
f0 AS (--Gather the forecasting variables - This will return 1 row
SELECT DISTINCT
COUNT(*) OVER () nbr_of_periods,
MAX(the_value) OVER () max_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
REGR_INTERCEPT(the_value, the_period) OVER () lin_y_intercept,
REGR_SLOPE(the_value, the_period) OVER () lin_slope,
REGR_R2(the_value, the_period) OVER () r2_value,
REGR_COUNT(the_value, the_period) OVER () r_count,
(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (),0) pop_slope,
(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) -
(((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (),0))) * (COUNT(*) OVER ())) pop_y_intercept
FROM t1
),
d0 AS (--Future Dates
SELECT 
f0.nbr_of_periods + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) the_period, 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) the_future_period, --Will start as 1 in the future 
the_date the_date
FROM var, f0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(f0.last_date+var.day_multiplier,f0.last_date+(var.forecast_periods*var.day_multiplier),DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days',11,'Weeks',12,'Months',13,'Quarters',14,'Years',15))) the_dates
)
SELECT
'Past' the_tense,
t1.the_period,
TO_CHAR(t1.the_date,'YY/MM/DD') AS the_date,
ROUND(t1.the_value,2) the_value,
ROUND(t1.the_value,2) the_past_value,
0 the_future_value,
f0.nbr_of_periods,
f0.max_of_the_value,
f0.first_date,
f0.last_date,
f0.first_value, 
f0.last_value,
f0.lin_slope,
f0.lin_y_intercept,
ROUND((t1.the_period * f0.lin_slope) + f0.lin_y_intercept,2) lin_trend_line, 
f0.pop_slope,
f0.pop_y_intercept,
ROUND((t1.the_period * f0.pop_slope) + f0.pop_y_intercept,2) pop_trend_line 
FROM f0, t1, var
UNION
SELECT
'Future' the_tense,
d0.the_period,
TO_CHAR(d0.the_date,'YY/MM/DD') AS the_date,
ROUND(f0.last_value + (f0.lin_slope * d0.the_future_period),2) the_value,
0 the_past_value,
ROUND(f0.last_value + (f0.lin_slope * d0.the_future_period),2) the_future_value,
f0.nbr_of_periods,
f0.max_of_the_value,
f0.first_date,
f0.last_date,
f0.first_value, 
f0.last_value,
f0.lin_slope,
f0.lin_y_intercept,
ROUND((d0.the_period * f0.lin_slope) + f0.lin_y_intercept,2) lin_trend_line, 
f0.pop_slope,
f0.pop_y_intercept,
ROUND((d0.the_period * f0.pop_slope) + f0.pop_y_intercept,2) pop_trend_line 
FROM d0, f0, var
ORDER BY 3

title: Ad Hoc Host Attribute Breakdown

--Last Modified: 05/10/2012

count(hs.host_id) nbr_of_hosts,

metric

title: Array Allocated AOL Forecast.D
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/30/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an array based on 
--Average over Last (AOL) Last period - average period size
--This is a drill down report that can't run stand alone
WITH 
d0 AS (--Convert the human readable date selection to numeric values
SELECT
DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
--Limit the forecasting periods to 48
CASE 
WHEN to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') > 48 THEN 48 
ELSE to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') END forecast_periods,
'${TheGroupBy}' the_group_by --Need this for the drilldown
FROM apt_v_dual
),
a0 as (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
storage_array_id,
trunc(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
row_number() OVER (partition BY storage_array_id ORDER BY storage_array_id) row_number,
max(allocated_gb) allocated_gb,
max(capacity_gb) capacity_gb,
max(capacity_gb) - max(allocated_gb)  available_gb
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${TheArrayName}'
GROUP BY storage_array_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the number of periods found, will need this to get the last period
SELECT 
storage_array_id,
min(log_date) first_period_date,
max(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY storage_array_id
),
p1 AS (--Get the Period over Period Numbers
SELECT
a0.storage_array_id, 
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,1,a0.capacity_gb,0)) first_period_capacity_gb,
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,1,a0.allocated_gb,0)) first_period_allocated_gb,
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,1,a0.available_gb,0)) first_period_available_gb,
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,p0.period_count,a0.capacity_gb,0)) last_period_capacity_gb,
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,p0.period_count,a0.allocated_gb,0)) last_period_allocated_gb,
sum(DECODE(a0.row_number,p0.period_count,a0.available_gb,0)) last_period_available_gb
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.row_number IN (1,p0.period_count) --Only get the first and last period numbers
GROUP BY a0.storage_array_id
),
p2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Growth
SELECT
p1.storage_array_id, 
p1.first_period_capacity_gb,
p1.first_period_allocated_gb,
p1.first_period_available_gb,
p1.last_period_capacity_gb,
p1.last_period_allocated_gb,
p1.last_period_available_gb,
(p1.last_period_capacity_gb - p1.first_period_capacity_gb) / p0.period_count pop_capacity_growth,
(p1.last_period_allocated_gb - p1.first_period_allocated_gb) / p0.period_count pop_allocated_growth,
(p1.last_period_available_gb - p1.first_period_available_gb) / p0.period_count pop_available_growth
FROM p1,p0
) 
SELECT --Plot the prior history
a0.log_date log_date, 
a0.capacity_gb,
a0.allocated_gb,
a0.available_gb,
0 future_allocated_gb,
0 future_available_gb,
p2.pop_capacity_growth,
p2.pop_allocated_growth,
p2.pop_available_growth,
p2.last_period_allocated_gb - (p2.pop_allocated_growth*(p0.period_count-rownum)) allocated_trend_line
FROM a0,p2,p0
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = p2.storage_array_id
UNION ALL --Future values
SELECT 
trunc(the_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
p2.last_period_capacity_gb + (p2.pop_capacity_growth*rownum) capacity_gb,
0 allocated_gb,
0 available_gb,
p2.last_period_allocated_gb + (p2.pop_allocated_growth*rownum) future_allocated_gb,
p2.last_period_available_gb + (p2.pop_available_growth*rownum) future_available_gb,
p2.pop_capacity_growth,
p2.pop_allocated_growth,
p2.pop_available_growth,
p2.last_period_allocated_gb + (p2.pop_allocated_growth*rownum) allocated_trend_line
FROM a0,p0,p2,d0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_period_date+d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_period_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = p2.storage_array_id
AND a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.row_number = p0.period_count --Only need the last row

title: Array Allocated Linear Forecast.D
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/30/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an array based on 
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
WITH 
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
--Limit the forecasting periods to 48
CASE 
WHEN to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') > 48 THEN 48 
ELSE to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') END forecast_periods
FROM dual
),
a0 as (
SELECT 
array_name,
trunc(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
max(allocated_gb) allocated_gb,
max(capacity_gb) capacity_gb,
max(capacity_gb) - max(allocated_gb) available_gb
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${TheArrayName}' 
AND array_name is not null
GROUP BY array_name,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
a1 AS (
SELECT 
rownum period,
log_date,
allocated_gb,
capacity_gb,
REGR_SLOPE(allocated_gb,rownum) over (partition by array_name) slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(allocated_gb, rownum) over (partition by array_name) y_intercept
FROM a0
ORDER BY 1
),
MP AS (--Find the last period so you can forecast past it
SELECT 
max(period) last_period,
max(log_date) last_date
FROM a1
)
SELECT
log_date,
round(allocated_gb,2) allocated_gb,
0 future_allocated,
round(capacity_gb-allocated_gb,2) available_gb,
0 future_available,
period*slope+y_intercept trend_line--Future values can be determined for any period unsing this formula
FROM a1, mp
UNION ALL --Future
SELECT 
trunc(the_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 allocated_gb,
round((period+rownum)*slope+y_intercept,2) future_allocated,
0 available_gb,
round(capacity_gb - ((period+rownum)*slope+y_intercept),2) future_available,
(period+rownum)*slope+y_intercept trend_line
FROM a1,mp,d0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(mp.last_date+d0.nbr_of_days,mp.last_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE period = mp.last_period

title: Array Growth Period Over Period
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 08/29/2011
--This compares the total array capacity and the allocated capacity over a period of 360 days.
--NOTE: Some of the columns are hidden, simply edit the template, click on the formatting tab
--then un-check the columns you want to see. 
WITH 
q1 AS (
SELECT
array_name || ' - Capacity' metric,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-30  AND sysdate     THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon1_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-60  AND sysdate-30  THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon2_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-90  AND sysdate-60  THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon3_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-120 AND sysdate-90  THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon4_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-150 AND sysdate-120 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon5_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate-150 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon6_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-210 AND sysdate-180 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon7_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-240 AND sysdate-210 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon8_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-270 AND sysdate-240 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon9_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-300 AND sysdate-270 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon10_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-330 AND sysdate-300 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon11_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate-330 THEN capacity_gb ELSE 0 END) mon12_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-60  AND sysdate     THEN capacity_gb END) max60_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-120 AND sysdate-60  THEN capacity_gb END) maxP60_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-90  AND sysdate     THEN capacity_gb END) max90_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate-90  THEN capacity_gb END) maxP90_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate     THEN capacity_gb END) max180_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate-180 THEN capacity_gb END) maxP180_cap,
stddev(capacity_gb) std_dev,
stddev(DISTINCT capacity_gb) std_dev_d,
avg(capacity_gb) avg_nd,
avg(DISTINCT capacity_gb) avg_d
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate
AND capacity_gb > 10
AND allocated_gb > 10
GROUP BY array_name || ' - Capacity'
UNION
SELECT
array_name || ' - Allocated' metric,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-30  AND sysdate     THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon1_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-60  AND sysdate-30  THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon2_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-90  AND sysdate-60  THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon3_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-120 AND sysdate-90  THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon4_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-150 AND sysdate-120 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon5_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate-150 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon6_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-210 AND sysdate-180 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon7_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-240 AND sysdate-210 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon8_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-270 AND sysdate-240 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon9_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-300 AND sysdate-270 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon10_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-330 AND sysdate-300 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon11_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate-330 THEN allocated_gb ELSE 0 END) mon12_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-60  AND sysdate     THEN allocated_gb END) max60_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-120 AND sysdate-60  THEN allocated_gb END) maxP60_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-90  AND sysdate     THEN allocated_gb END) max90_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate-90  THEN allocated_gb END) maxP90_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate     THEN allocated_gb END) max180_cap,
max(CASE WHEN log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate-180 THEN allocated_gb END) maxP180_cap,
stddev(allocated_gb) std_dev,
stddev(DISTINCT allocated_gb) std_dev_d,
avg(allocated_gb) avg_nd,
avg(DISTINCT allocated_gb) avg_d
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN sysdate-360 AND sysdate
AND capacity_gb > 10
AND allocated_gb > 10
GROUP BY array_name || ' - Allocated'
)
SELECT
metric,
max60_cap,
maxP60_cap,
max90_cap,
maxP90_cap,
max180_cap,
maxP180_cap,
std_dev,
std_dev_d,
avg_nd,
avg_d,
nvl(mon2_cap,0) - nvl(mon1_cap,0) change_30_day,
nvl(max60_cap,0) - nvl(maxP60_cap,0) change_60_day_change,
nvl(max90_cap,0) - nvl(maxP90_cap,0) change_90_day_change,
nvl(max180_cap,0) - nvl(maxP180_cap,0) change_180_day_change,
mon12_cap,
mon11_cap,
mon10_cap,
mon9_cap,
mon8_cap,
mon7_cap,
mon6_cap,
mon5_cap,
mon4_cap,
mon3_cap,
mon2_cap,
mon1_cap
FROM q1
WHERE metric LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','All','%','%${freeCombo1}')
ORDER BY 1

title: Array List Showing Pools
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified 02/03/2015
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, 
${startDate} startDate, 
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
),
a0 AS ( -- HDS DP Pools
SELECT
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
sa.serial_nbr,
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sp.pool_id,
MAX(sp.allocated_kb/1024/1024) allocated_gb,
MAX(sp.unallocated_kb/1024/1024) unallocated_gb,
MAX(sp.available_kb/1024/1024) available_gb,
MAX(sp.capacity_kb/1024/1024) capacity_gb,
MAX(sp.capacity_of_vvols_kb/1024/1024) capacity_of_vvols_gb,
MAX(sp.touched_kb/1024/1024) touched_gb
FROM aps_v_hds_journal_pool_log sp, aps_v_storage_array sa
WHERE sp.log_date BETWEEN SYSDATE-1 AND SYSDATE
GROUP BY
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
sa.serial_nbr,
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sp.pool_id
),
t1 AS (
SELECT --Thick Provisioned Block
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
sa.serial_nbr,
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
null pool,
sa.capacity_gb/div_by capacity,
(SELECT SUM(ag.free_capacity_gb) 
  FROM aps_v_array_group ag 
  WHERE sa.storage_array_id = ag.storage_array_id)/div_by extra_capacity,
sa.allocated_gb/div_by allocated,
sa.available_gb/div_by available
FROM aps_v_storage_array sa, var
WHERE capacity_gb > 0
UNION
SELECT --HDS Pools
a0.vendor_name,
a0.array_family,
a0.serial_nbr,
a0.storage_array_id,
a0.array_name,
TO_CHAR(a0.pool_id) pool,
a0.capacity_gb/div_by capacity,
0 extra_capacity,
a0.allocated_gb/div_by allocated,
a0.available_gb/div_by available
FROM a0, var
UNION
SELECT --VNX Pools NS & VNX Total Size + Potential
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
sa.serial_nbr,
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sp.storage_pool_name pool,
(sp.total_size_kb)/1024/1024/div_by capacity,
sp.potential_additional_size_kb/1024/1024/div_by extra_capacity,
sp.used_size_kb/1024/1024/div_by allocated,
(sp.total_size_kb-sp.used_size_kb)/1024/1024/div_by available
FROM aps_v_vnx_storage_pool sp, aps_v_storage_array sa, var
WHERE sp.vnx_storage_system_id = sa.storage_array_id
UNION
SELECT --VN-series Pools (Clariion)
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
sa.serial_nbr,
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sp.description pool,
sp.user_capacity_gb/div_by capacity,
0 extra_capacity,
sp.consumed_capacity_gb/div_by allocated, 
sp.available_capacity_gb/div_by available
FROM aps_v_emc_cla_storage_pool sp, aps_v_storage_array sa, var
WHERE sp.storage_array_id = sa.storage_array_id
UNION
SELECT --VMAX-series Pools (Symmetrix)
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
NVL(sa.serial_nbr,sa.array_name),
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sp.pool_name pool,
ROUND(total_tracks_kb/1024/1024/div_by,2) capacity,
CASE 
    WHEN subscribed_pct <= 100 THEN 0
    ELSE ((total_tracks_kb * (subscribed_pct/100))/1024/1024/div_by) - (total_tracks_kb/1024/1024/div_by)
END extra_capacity, 
ROUND((total_used_tracks_kb)/1024/1024/div_by,2) allocated,
ROUND((total_tracks_kb-total_used_tracks_kb)/1024/1024/div_by,2) available
FROM  aps_v_emc_sym_storage_pool sp, aps_v_storage_array sa, var
WHERE sp.storage_array_id = sa.storage_array_id
UNION
SELECT --Symmetrix DMX
sa.vendor_name,
sa.array_family,
NVL(sa.serial_nbr,sa.array_name),
sa.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
null pool,
lg.capacity_gb/div_by capacity,
0 extra_capacity,
--(SELECT SUM(ag.free_capacity_gb) FROM aps_v_array_group ag WHERE sa.storage_array_id = --ag.storage_array_id)/div_by extra_capacity,
lg.allocated_gb/div_by allocated,
lg.available_gb/div_by available
FROM aps_v_storage_array sa, var,
     (SELECT storage_array_id, MAX(capacity_gb) capacity_gb,
             MAX(allocated_gb) allocated_gb,
             MAX(available_gb) available_gb
      FROM aps_v_storage_array_log
      GROUP BY storage_array_id) lg
WHERE sa.array_family LIKE '%DMX%'
AND sa.storage_array_id = lg.storage_array_id
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
--Add any array attributes here...
--at.location,
t1.vendor_name,
t1.array_family,
t1.serial_nbr,
t1.storage_array_id,
t1.array_name,
t1.pool,
t1.capacity,
t1.extra_capacity,
(t1.capacity + t1.extra_capacity) total_usable_capacity,
t1.allocated,
t1.available,
(t1.available/(t1.capacity + .0001)) pct_available,
(t1.available/(t1.capacity + .0001))*100 available_pct,
(t1.available + t1.extra_capacity)/((t1.capacity + .0001) + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0)) pct_tot_available,
(t1.available + t1.extra_capacity)/((t1.capacity + .0001) + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0))*100 tot_available_pct,
CASE 
   WHEN NVL(t1.capacity,0) + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0) > 0 THEN
        (t1.allocated/(NVL(t1.capacity,0) + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0)))*100
   ELSE
         t1.allocated
END tot_consumed,
CASE 
   WHEN NVL(t1.capacity,0) + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0) > 0 THEN
      (t1.allocated)/(t1.capacity + NVL(t1.extra_capacity,0))
   ELSE
       0
END tot_consumed_pct
FROM t1, aps_v_storage_array_attribute at
WHERE t1.storage_array_id=at.storage_array_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM t2 
WHERE t2.vendor_name LIKE DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All','%','${queryCombo1}')
ORDER BY 1,2,3 ASC

title: Array Port Intelligent Provisioning
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 01/20/2019
WITH 
t1 AS (--Host and LUN counts
SELECT
ap.storage_array_id,
ap.port_id,
ap.nickname,
ap.wwn,
COUNT(DISTINCT sp.host_id) hosts,
COUNT(DISTINCT sp.logical_unit_id) luns
FROM
aps_v_array_port ap,  aps_v_storage_path sp
WHERE 
ap.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
AND ap.port_id = sp.array_port_id
AND UPPER(ap.port_role) = 'TARGET'
GROUP BY
ap.storage_array_id,
ap.port_id,
ap.nickname,
ap.wwn
),
t2 AS (--Get all the Distinct LUNs
SELECT
DISTINCT
ap.storage_array_id,
ap.port_id,
sp.logical_unit_id,
sp.total_capacity_gb
FROM
aps_v_array_port ap,  aps_v_storage_path sp, t1
WHERE 
ap.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
AND ap.port_id = t1.port_id
AND UPPER(ap.port_role) = 'TARGET'
AND ap.port_id = sp.array_port_id
),
t3 AS (--Add Up the Capacity
SELECT
t2.storage_array_id,
t2.port_id,
SUM(t2.total_capacity_gb/1024) total_capacity_tb
FROM t2
GROUP BY
t2.storage_array_id,
t2.port_id
),
t4 AS (--Get the storage I/O
SELECT
l.port_id,
MAX(l.kbytes_transferred/1024/1024) gb_transferred
FROM aps_v_array_port_stats_log l, t1
WHERE
l.log_date >= sysdate -7
AND l.port_id = t1.port_id
GROUP BY
l.port_id
),
t5 AS (
SELECT
t1.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
sa.vendor_name,
t1.port_id,
t1.nickname,
t1.wwn,
t1.hosts,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(hosts,0) DESC) dr_hosts,
t1.luns,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(luns,0) DESC) dr_luns,
t3.total_capacity_tb,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(total_capacity_tb,0) DESC) dr_total_capacity_tb,
NVL(t4.gb_transferred,0) gb_transferred,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(gb_transferred,0) DESC) dr_gb_transferred
FROM
aps_v_storage_array sa, t1, t3, t4
WHERE
t1.port_id = t3.port_id
AND t1.port_id = t4.port_id (+)
AND t1.storage_array_id = sa.storage_array_id
)
SELECT
storage_array_id,
array_name,
vendor_name,
port_id,
nickname,
wwn,
gb_transferred,
dr_gb_transferred,
CASE WHEN dr_gb_transferred = 1 THEN 'red' WHEN dr_gb_transferred = 2 THEN 'yellow' WHEN dr_gb_transferred = 3 THEN 'green' WHEN dr_gb_transferred = 4 THEN 'blue' ELSE 'white' END transferred_dot,
hosts,
dr_hosts,
CASE WHEN dr_hosts = 1 THEN 'red' WHEN dr_hosts = 2 THEN 'yellow' WHEN dr_hosts = 3 THEN 'green'  WHEN dr_hosts = 4 THEN 'blue' ELSE 'white' END hosts_dot,
luns,
dr_luns,
CASE WHEN dr_luns = 1 THEN 'red' WHEN dr_luns = 2 THEN 'yellow' WHEN dr_luns = 3 THEN 'green' WHEN dr_luns = 4 THEN 'blue' ELSE 'white' END luns_dot,
total_capacity_tb,
dr_total_capacity_tb,
CASE WHEN dr_total_capacity_tb = 1 THEN 'red' WHEN dr_total_capacity_tb = 2 THEN 'yellow' WHEN dr_total_capacity_tb = 3 THEN 'green' WHEN dr_total_capacity_tb = 4 THEN 'blue' ELSE 'white' END capacity_dot,
'Ranks '||
CASE WHEN gb_transferred > 0 THEN dr_gb_transferred||DECODE(dr_gb_transferred,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||' in I/O, ' ELSE '' END ||
CASE WHEN hosts > 0 THEN dr_hosts||DECODE(dr_hosts,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||' in #Hosts, ' ELSE '' END
||dr_luns||DECODE(dr_luns,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||' in #LUNs, '
||dr_total_capacity_tb||DECODE(dr_total_capacity_tb,1,'st',2,'nd',3,'rd','th')||' in Capacity'
message
FROM t5
ORDER BY gb_transferred DESC

title: Array Port Performance Report
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 11/16/2012
SELECT 
e.storage_Array_id,array_name,
i.port_id,port_name,port_wwn_id,port_role,
ROUND(SUM(diff_total_io)/SUM(((log_date-prev_log_date )*86400))) total_io,
RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(diff_total_io)/SUM(((log_date-prev_log_date )*86400))) OVER(PARTITION BY e.storage_array_id)*100 total_io_pct,
ROUND(SUM((diff_kbytes_transferred)/1024),2) mb_transferred, 
RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM((diff_kbytes_transferred/1024))) OVER(PARTITION BY e.storage_array_id)*100 MB_transferred_pct

WHERE i.storage_array_id = e.storage_array_id
AND i.port_id = l.port_id(+)
AND l.log_date(+) BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY e.storage_Array_id,array_name,
i.port_id,port_name,port_wwn_id,port_role
ORDER BY 2,4

title: Array Stats vs Last Month
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 09/18/2015
--Compare metrics today vs same time last month
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT 
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by,
ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'MM'),-1) p_first, 
LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(sysdate,-1)) p_last, 
ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'DD'),-1) p_day,
TRUNC(sysdate,'MM') c_first, 
LAST_DAY(sysdate) c_last,
TRUNC(sysdate,'DD') c_day,
domain_id  
FROM aps_v_domain d
WHERE domain_name = '${queryCombo1}'
),
p0 AS (
SELECT
l.storage_array_id, 
MAX(l.thin_pool_subscribed_gb) thin_pool_subscribed,
MAX(l.raw_capacity_gb) raw_capacity,
MAX(l.allocated_gb) allocated
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log l, aps_v_storage_array a, var
WHERE a.storage_array_id = l.storage_array_id 
AND a.domain_id = var.domain_id
AND l.log_date BETWEEN p_first AND p_day
GROUP BY l.storage_array_id
),
p1 AS (
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT storage_array_id) storage_arrays,
ROUND(SUM(thin_pool_subscribed/div_by),2) thin_pool_subscribed,
ROUND(SUM(raw_capacity/div_by),2) raw_capacity,
ROUND(SUM(allocated/div_by),2) allocated
FROM p0, var
),
c0 AS (
SELECT
l.storage_array_id, 
MAX(l.thin_pool_subscribed_gb) thin_pool_subscribed,
MAX(l.raw_capacity_gb) raw_capacity,
MAX(l.allocated_gb) allocated
FROM aps_v_storage_array_log l, aps_v_storage_array a, var
WHERE a.storage_array_id = l.storage_array_id 
AND a.domain_id = var.domain_id
AND l.log_date BETWEEN c_first AND c_day
GROUP BY l.storage_array_id
),
c1 AS (
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT storage_array_id) storage_arrays,
ROUND(SUM(thin_pool_subscribed/div_by),2) thin_pool_subscribed,
ROUND(SUM(raw_capacity/div_by),2) raw_capacity,
ROUND(SUM(allocated/div_by),2) allocated
FROM c0, var
)
SELECT
1 sort_order,
'Storage Arrays' metric,
p1.storage_arrays p_value,
c1.storage_arrays c_value, 
(c1.storage_arrays - p1.storage_arrays) delta, 
ROUND((c1.storage_arrays - p1.storage_arrays) / DECODE(p1.storage_arrays,0,NULL,p1.storage_arrays),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.storage_arrays - p1.storage_arrays) / DECODE(p1.storage_arrays,0,NULL,p1.storage_arrays),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1
UNION
SELECT
2 sort_order,
'RAW Capacity'||' ('||var.unit||')' metric,
p1.raw_capacity p_value,
c1.raw_capacity c_value, 
(c1.raw_capacity - p1.raw_capacity) delta, 
ROUND((c1.raw_capacity - p1.raw_capacity) / DECODE(p1.raw_capacity,0,NULL,p1.raw_capacity),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.raw_capacity - p1.raw_capacity) / DECODE(p1.raw_capacity,0,NULL,p1.raw_capacity),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var
UNION
SELECT
3 sort_order,
'Allocated Capacity'||' ('||var.unit||')' metric,
p1.allocated p_value,
c1.allocated c_value, 
(c1.allocated - p1.allocated) delta, 
ROUND((c1.allocated - p1.allocated) / DECODE(p1.allocated,0,NULL,p1.allocated),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.allocated - p1.allocated) / DECODE(p1.allocated,0,NULL,p1.allocated),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var
UNION
SELECT
4 sort_order,
'Pool Used Capacity'||' ('||var.unit||')' metric,
p1.thin_pool_subscribed p_value,
c1.thin_pool_subscribed c_value, 
(c1.thin_pool_subscribed - p1.thin_pool_subscribed) delta, 
ROUND((c1.thin_pool_subscribed - p1.thin_pool_subscribed) / DECODE(p1.thin_pool_subscribed,0,NULL,p1.thin_pool_subscribed),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.thin_pool_subscribed - p1.thin_pool_subscribed) / DECODE(p1.thin_pool_subscribed,0,NULL,p1.thin_pool_subscribed),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var

title: Array Usable Free Multi Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 08/20/2018
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting Array Usable Free Capacity
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.storage_array_id the_id_1, 
1 the_id_2,
MAX(l.usable_free_capacity_gb/div_by) the_value
FROM
aps_v_storage_array_log l, var
WHERE l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.storage_array_id 
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) the_value_lin,
(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
ROUND(f2.first_value,2) first_value, 
f2.last_date,
ROUND(f2.last_value,2) last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
ROUND(f2.the_value_lin,2) the_value_lin,
ROUND(f2.sum_of_the_value,2) sum_of_the_value,
(f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) days_left_lin,
CASE 
WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0
THEN
  CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
    THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
    THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
  END
WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
(f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) days_left_pop,
CASE 
WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0
THEN
  CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
    THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
    THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
  END
WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
)
SELECT
f3.the_id_1,
a.array_name,
s1.the_spk,
ROUND(f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0),2) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Did Not Change'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, aps_v_storage_array a
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = a.storage_array_id
ORDER BY 
a.array_name,
f3.the_id_2

title: Array Use by Host
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 05/10/2011
WITH t1 as (
SELECT sa.storage_array_id, sa.array_name, sa.serial_nbr, sa.cache_kb,
lu.array_group_id,
hl.host_id,
hl.host_name,
ag.raid_type,
avg(ag.allocated_capacity_gb / DECODE(ag.total_capacity_gb,0,null,ag.total_capacity_gb)) raid_loss_factor,
sum(hl.lun_capacity_gb) sum_lun_size_gb,
count(DISTINCT hl.logical_unit_id) lun_count
FROM  aps_v_storage_array sa, aps_v_host_luns hl, aps_v_logical_unit lu,aps_v_array_group ag
WHERE sa.storage_array_id = hl.storage_array_id
AND hl.host_id in (${hosts})
AND hl.logical_unit_id = lu.logical_unit_id
AND lu.array_group_id IS NOT NULL
AND lu.array_group_id = ag.array_group_id
AND sa.vendor_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','All','%','%${freeCombo1}%')
GROUP BY sa.storage_array_id, sa.array_name, sa.serial_nbr, sa.cache_kb, lu.array_group_id,hl.host_id, hl.host_name,ag.raid_type
ORDER BY sa.storage_array_id, sa.array_name ,sa.serial_nbr, sa.cache_kb, lu.array_group_id,hl.host_id, hl.host_name,ag.raid_type
)
SELECT
host_id,
host_name,
array_name, serial_nbr, cache_kb/1024/1024 as cache_GB,
(SELECT avg(capacity_kb)/1024/1024 FROM aps_v_pdev pd WHERE pd.storage_array_id = t1.storage_array_id) drive_size, 
(SELECT count(pdev_id) FROM aps_v_pdev pd WHERE pd.storage_array_id = t1.storage_array_id) drive_count, 
raid_type,
sum_lun_size_gb*raid_loss_factor + sum_lun_size_gb assigned_size, 
sum_lun_size_gb true_usable_size, 
(SELECT sum(fsp.filesystem_used_kb)/1024/1024 FROM aps_v_file_system_path fsp WHERE fsp.host_id = t1.host_id AND is_san_disk='Y') used_size_gb,
(SELECT sum(fsp.filesystem_capacity_kb-fsp.filesystem_used_kb)/1024/1024 FROM aps_v_file_system_path fsp WHERE fsp.host_id = t1.host_id AND is_san_disk='Y') avail_size_gb,
(SELECT sum(fsp.filesystem_used_kb/DECODE(fsp.filesystem_capacity_kb,0,null,fsp.filesystem_capacity_kb)) FROM aps_v_file_system_path fsp WHERE fsp.host_id = t1.host_id AND is_san_disk='Y') utilization_pct
FROM t1

title: Array VM Guest Disk Used vs Free Over Time
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/22/2018
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by
FROM apt_v_dual
),
v1 AS (
SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE */ DISTINCT
vf.vm_id,
vf.storage_array_id
FROM apt_v_vmw_vmfile vf
WHERE
vf.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
),
t1 AS (
SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE */
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
gal.vm_id,
ROUND(MAX(gal.vm_size_kb/div_by),2) max_vm_size,
ROUND(MAX(gal.total_volume_size_kb/div_by),2) max_total_volume_size,
ROUND(MAX(gal.used_volume_size_kb/div_by),2) max_used_volume_size
FROM
apt_v_vmw_guest_allocusage_log gal, v1, var
WHERE
gal.vm_id = v1.vm_id 
AND gal.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY 
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),
gal.vm_id
ORDER BY 1,2
)
SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE */
log_date,
COUNT(DISTINCT vm_id) vm_count,
SUM(max_vm_size) max_vm_size,
SUM(max_used_volume_size) max_used_volume_size,
SUM(max_total_volume_size) max_total_volume_size,
SUM(max_total_volume_size)-SUM(max_used_volume_size) max_free_volume_size
FROM t1
GROUP BY
log_date
ORDER BY log_date

)
SELECT
unit,
to_char(trunc(end_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minute','MI','Hour','HH24','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') the_date,
to_char(trunc(end_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minute','MI','Hour','HH24','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') sort_order,
ROUND(SUM(elapsed_minutes/60/60),2) elapsed_hrs,--actually stored in seconds
ROUND(SUM((recovered_bytes)/div_by),2) recovered --actually stored in KB
FROM apt_v_avm_gc_status gc, apt_v_server s, var
WHERE 
end_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND s.server_id = gc.master_server_id

GROUP BY

to_char(trunc(end_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minute','MI','Hour','HH24','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')

title: Avamar Grid System Info Pivot
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 04/03/2018 WITH var AS ( SELECT ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',(1024),'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by FROM apt_v_dual ), n1 AS (--Get the nodes and their capacities SELECT n.master_server_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.node_id) nodes, REPLACE(aptStringConcat(DISTINCT version),',','
') versions, SUM(n.total_capacity_kb/div_by) nodes_total_capacity, SUM((n.total_capacity_kb-n.used_capacity_kb)/div_by) nodes_free_capacity, SUM(n.used_capacity_kb/div_by) nodes_used_capacity FROM apt_v_avm_node n, var, apt_v_server s WHERE n.master_server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id = n.master_server_id GROUP BY n.master_server_id ), dp AS (--Data Protected according to Avamar SELECT ds.master_server_id, MAX(ds.data_protected_kb) data_protected_kb FROM apt_v_avm_dpn_statistics ds, apt_v_server s WHERE ds.master_server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id = master_server_id GROUP BY master_server_id ), t2 AS (--Get the highest value for each client/plugin combination SELECT aa.server_id, aa.client_id, aa.plugin_id, MAX(aa.scanned_kb) scanned_kb FROM apt_v_avm_activities aa, var, apt_v_server s WHERE aa.server_id IN (${hosts}) AND aa.scanned_kb > 0 AND aa.expiration_date > sysdate AND s.server_id = aa.server_id GROUP BY aa.server_id, client_id, plugin_id ), t3 AS (--Add them up and this should be the "Front End " size of each client on the grid SELECT t2.server_id master_server_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) clients, SUM(t2.scanned_kb) scanned_kb FROM t2 GROUP BY t2.server_id ), t4 AS ( SELECT ms.axion_system_id, ms.gsan_system_name, ms.gsan_system_id, ms.master_server_id, ms.hfs_address, ms.local_hfs_address, ms.hfs_port, ms.mcs_port, ms.gsan_run_level, DECODE(ms.gsan_run_level,'up','green','degraded','yellow','red') run_level_dot, t3.clients, t3.scanned_kb/div_by scanned, dp.data_protected_kb/div_by data_protected, ROUND((dp.data_protected_kb / used_capacity_kb),1)||':1' dedup_ratio, ((ms.total_capacity_kb - ms.used_capacity_kb)*(dp.data_protected_kb / ms.used_capacity_kb))/div_by est_available_capacity, ms.total_capacity_kb/var.div_by total_capacity, (ms.total_capacity_kb - ms.used_capacity_kb)/div_by available_capacity, ms.used_capacity_kb/var.div_by used_capacity, (ms.used_capacity_kb/DECODE(ms.total_capacity_kb,0,null,ms.total_capacity_kb)) used_pct, (ms.used_capacity_kb/DECODE(ms.total_capacity_kb,0,null,ms.total_capacity_kb))*100 pct_used, ms.protected_bytes_quota, ms.license_expiration_date, ms.time_since_server_init, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(ms.time_since_server_init) time_since_server_init_hrs, ms.last_updated_in_avm, ms.last_checkpoint, ms.last_validated_checkpoint, n1.nodes, n1.versions, n1.nodes_total_capacity, n1.nodes_used_capacity, n1.nodes_free_capacity FROM apt_v_avm_axion_system ms, var, n1, dp, t3, apt_v_server s WHERE ms.master_server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id = ms.master_server_id AND ms.master_server_id = n1.master_server_id AND ms.master_server_id = dp.master_server_id(+) AND ms.master_server_id = t3.master_server_id(+) ) SELECT gsan_system_name, '01' sort_order,'Server ID Primary Key' metric, TO_CHAR(master_server_id) value FROM t4 UNION SELECT gsan_system_name, '02' ') versions, SUM(n.total_capacity_kb/div_by) nodes_total_capacity, SUM((n.total_capacity_kb-n.used_capacity_kb)/div_by) nodes_free_capacity, SUM(n.used_capacity_kb/div_by) nodes_used_capacity FROM apt_v_avm_node n, var, apt_v_server s WHERE n.master_server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id = n.master_server_id GROUP BY n.master_server_id ), dp AS (--Data Protected according to Avamar SELECT ds.master_server_id, MAX(ds.data_protected_kb) data_protected_kb FROM apt_v_avm_dpn_statistics ds, apt_v_server s WHERE ds.master_server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id = master_server_id GROUP BY master_server_id ), t2 AS (--Get the highest value for each client/plugin combination SELECT aa.server_id, aa.client_id, aa.plugin_id, MAX(aa.scanned_kb) scanned_kb FROM apt_v_avm_activities aa, var, apt_v_server s WHERE aa.server_id IN (${hosts}) AND aa.scanned_kb > 0 AND aa.expiration_date > sysdate AND s.server_id = aa.server_id GROUP BY aa.server_id, client_id, plugin_id ), t3 AS (--Add them up and this should be the "Front End " size of each client on the grid SELECT t2.server_id master_server_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) clients, SUM(t2.scanned_kb) scanned_kb FROM t2 GROUP BY t2.server_id ) SELECT ms.axion_system_id, ms.gsan_system_name, ms.gsan_system_id, ms.master_server_id, ms.hfs_address, ms.local_hfs_address, ms.hfs_port, ms.mcs_port, ms.gsan_run_level, DECODE(ms.gsan_run_level,'up','green','degraded','yellow','red') run_level_dot, t3.clients, t3.scanned_kb/div_by scanned, dp.data_protected_kb/div_by data_protected, ROUND((dp.data_protected_kb / used_capacity_kb),1)||':1' dedup_ratio, ((ms.total_capacity_kb - title: Avamar Groups Summary
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 01/07/2019
WITH 
gc AS (
SELECT 
ac.master_server_id, 
agm.avm_group_id, 
COUNT(agm.avm_group_id) client_count 
FROM 
apt_v_avm_group_members agm, apt_v_avm_clients ac
WHERE 
agm.client_id = ac.client_id 
AND ac.client_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY 
ac.master_server_id, 
agm.avm_group_id
) 
SELECT
gc.master_server_id,
avg.gsan_system_id, 
avg.gsan_system_name, 
avg.group_name, 
gc.client_count,
avg.avm_group_id, 
avg.avm_domain_id, 
avg.dataset_id, 
avd.dataset_name,
avg.retention_policy_id, 
avrp.retention_policy_name, 
avg.schedule_id, 
avs.schedule_name,
avg.created_date, 
avg.modified_date, 
avg.priority,
avg.is_enabled, 
avg.is_failed_stop,  
avg.is_read_only, 
avg.is_run_once, 
avg.is_skip_next, 
avg.retry_count,
avg.target_dpn, 
avg.timeout_min
FROM apt_v_avm_groups avg, apt_v_avm_datasets avd, apt_v_avm_schedules avs, apt_v_avm_retention_policies avrp, gc
WHERE avg.dataset_id = avd.dataset_id
AND avg.schedule_id = avs.schedule_id
AND avg.retention_policy_id = avrp.retention_policy_id
AND avg.avm_group_id = gc.avm_group_id (+)

title: Avamar Node Available Capacity Linear Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 12/07/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an Avamar Node based on 
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
--This is a drill down report that can't run stand alone
--TemplateName: AvamarNodeAvailableCapacityLinearForecastD
WITH 
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
to_number('${freeCombo2}') forecast_periods
FROM dual
),
a0 AS (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
master_server_id,
node_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() over (PARTITION BY master_server_id, node_id ORDER BY master_server_id, node_id) row_number,
ROUND(MAX((capacity_mb - used_mb)/1024),2) available
FROM apt_v_avm_node_space_log ansl, apt_v_server s 
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND master_server_id = s.server_id
AND s.hostname||' - '||node_id = '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY master_server_id, node_id, trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
a1 AS (
SELECT 
ROWNUM period,
log_date,
available,
REGR_SLOPE(available,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY master_server_id) slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY master_server_id) y_intercept
FROM a0
ORDER BY 1
),
p0 AS (--Find the last period so you can forecast past it
SELECT 
MAX(period) last_period,
MAX(log_date) last_date
FROM a1
)
SELECT
log_date,
round(available,2) available,
0 future_available,
period*slope+y_intercept trend_line--Future values can be determined for any period using this formula
FROM a1, p0
UNION ALL --Future
SELECT 
TRUNC(the_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 available,
ROUND((period+ROWNUM)*slope+y_intercept,2) future_available,
(period+ROWNUM)*slope+y_intercept trend_line
FROM a1,p0,d0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_date+d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE period = p0.last_period
