sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 12/07/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an Avamar Grid Node based on 
--a Period over Period forecasting method
WITH 
d0 AS (--Convert the human readable date selection to numeric values
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
to_number('${freeCombo2}') forecast_periods
FROM apt_v_dual
),
a0 AS (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
master_server_id,
node_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY master_server_id,  node_id ORDER BY master_server_id,  node_id) row_number,
ROUND(MAX((capacity_mb - used_mb)/1024),2) available
FROM apt_v_avm_node_space_log ansl, apt_v_server s 
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND master_server_id = s.server_id
AND s.hostname||' - '||node_id = '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY master_server_id,node_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the first and last period number for each array & pool 
SELECT
master_server_id,
node_id,
MIN(row_number) first_period_number, --First period will always be 1
MAX(row_number) last_period_number, --Last period is the current period or last time data was collected
min(log_date) first_period_date,
MAX(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY 
master_server_id,
node_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the first and last period metrics based on the row number of the periods
SELECT
a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id,
MAX(last_period_number) nbr_of_periods,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,first_period_number,a0.available,0)) first_available,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,last_period_number,a0.available,0)) last_available
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
GROUP BY a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id
),
pop2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Changes
SELECT
master_server_id, 
node_id,
first_available,
last_available,
ROUND((last_available - first_available),2) pop_available_delta,
ROUND((last_available - first_available) / DECODE(nbr_of_periods,0,null,nbr_of_periods),2) pop_available_trend
FROM pop1
) 
SELECT --Plot the prior history
a0.log_date, 
a0.available,
0 future_available,
pop2.last_available - (pop2.pop_available_trend*(period_count-ROWNUM)) available_trend_line
FROM a0, p0, pop2
WHERE a0.master_server_id = pop2.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = pop2.node_id
AND a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
UNION ALL --Future values
SELECT 
trunc(the_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend * ROWNUM) future_available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend * ROWNUM) available_trend_line
FROM a0, pop2, d0, p0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_period_date + d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_period_date + (d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE a0.master_server_id = pop2.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = pop2.node_id
AND a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
AND a0.row_number = p0.period_count --Only need the last row
ORDER BY 1

title: Avamar Node Available Capacity POP Forecast.D
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 12/03/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an Avamar Grid Node based on 
--a Period over Period forecasting method
--This is a drill down report that can't run stand alone
--TemplateName: AvamarNodeAvailableCapacityPOPForecast.D
WITH 
d0 AS (--Convert the human readable date selection to numeric values
SELECT
DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
--Limit the forecasting periods to 48
CASE 
WHEN to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') > 48 THEN 48 
ELSE to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') END forecast_periods,
'${TheGroupBy}' the_group_by --Need this for the drilldown
FROM dual
),
a0 AS (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
master_server_id,
node_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY master_server_id,  node_id ORDER BY master_server_id,  node_id) row_number,
ROUND(MAX((capacity_mb - used_mb)/1024),2) available
FROM apt_v_avm_node_space_log ansl, apt_v_server s 
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND master_server_id = s.server_id
AND s.hostname = '${TheMasterServerName}'
AND node_id = '${TheNodeID}'
GROUP BY master_server_id,node_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the first and last period number for each array & pool 
SELECT
master_server_id,
node_id,
MIN(row_number) first_period_number, --First period will always be 1
MAX(row_number) last_period_number, --Last period is the current period or last time data was collected
min(log_date) first_period_date,
MAX(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY 
master_server_id,
node_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the first and last period metrics based on the row number of the periods
SELECT
a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id,
MAX(last_period_number) nbr_of_periods,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,first_period_number,a0.available,0)) first_available,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,last_period_number,a0.available,0)) last_available
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
GROUP BY a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id
),
pop2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Changes
SELECT
master_server_id, 
node_id,
first_available,
last_available,
ROUND((last_available - first_available),2) pop_available_delta,
ROUND((last_available - first_available) / DECODE(nbr_of_periods,0,null,nbr_of_periods),2) pop_available_trend
FROM pop1
) 
SELECT --Plot the prior history
a0.log_date, 
a0.available,
0 future_available,
pop2.last_available - (pop2.pop_available_trend*(period_count-ROWNUM)) available_trend_line
FROM a0, p0, pop2
WHERE a0.master_server_id = pop2.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = pop2.node_id
AND a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
UNION ALL --Future values
SELECT 
trunc(the_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend * ROWNUM) future_available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend * ROWNUM) available_trend_line
FROM a0, pop2, d0, p0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_period_date + d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_period_date + (d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE a0.master_server_id = pop2.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = pop2.node_id
AND a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
AND a0.row_number = p0.period_count --Only need the last row
ORDER BY 1

title: Avamar Node Multi-Metric Available Capacity Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 11/14/2012
--Computes the future capacity of Avamar Nodes based on 2 different methods
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
--Period Over Period (POP) ((last period - first period) / nbr of periods) + last period...
--First period goes back as far back as data collection began and last period is
--the current capacity of the last time data collection occurred.
WITH
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
'${freeCombo1}' the_group_by
FROM dual
),
a0 as (
SELECT
master_server_id,
node_id,
trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
row_number() over (partition by master_server_id,  node_id ORDER BY master_server_id, node_id) row_number,
MAX((capacity_mb-used_mb)/1024) available
FROM apt_v_avm_node_space_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND master_server_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY master_server_id,node_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the first and last period number for each array & pool
SELECT
master_server_id,
node_id,
MIN(row_number) first_period_number, --First period will always be 1
MAX(row_number) last_period_number, --Last period is the current period or last time data was collected
min(log_date) first_period_date,
max(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY
master_server_id,
node_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the first and last period metrics based on the row number of the periods
SELECT
a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id,
MAX(last_period_number) nbr_of_periods,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,first_period_number,a0.available,0)) first_available,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,last_period_number,a0.available,0)) last_available
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.master_server_id = p0.master_server_id
AND a0.node_id = p0.node_id
GROUP BY a0.master_server_id, a0.node_id
),
pop2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Changes
SELECT
master_server_id,
node_id,
first_available,
last_available,
ROUND(last_available - first_available,2) pop_available_delta,
ROUND((last_available - first_available ) / DECODE(nbr_of_periods,0,null,nbr_of_periods),2) pop_available_trend
FROM pop1
),
lin1 AS (--Get the Linear Growth statistics
SELECT
a0.master_server_id,
a0.node_id,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(available,row_number),2) linear_trend,
REGR_R2(available,row_number) r2_value,
REGR_AVGX(available,row_number) avex,
REGR_AVGY(available,row_number)  avey,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available,row_number) y_intercept,
REGR_COUNT(available,row_number) period_count,
STDDEV(available)  stddev
FROM a0
GROUP BY master_server_id,  node_id
)
SELECT
pop1.master_server_id,
s.hostname,
pop1.node_id,
pop2.first_available,
pop2.last_available,
lin1.avey average_available,
period_count,
--
TO_CHAR(pop_available_trend) pop_available_trend,
TO_CHAR(linear_trend) linear_trend,
--
CASE
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN null
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0  THEN null
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0  THEN round(pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(pop_available_trend),0,null,abs(pop_available_trend)),0)
ELSE NULL
END pop_periods_left,
CASE
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN null
WHEN linear_trend > 0  THEN null
WHEN linear_trend < 0  THEN round(pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(linear_trend),0,null,abs(linear_trend)),0)
ELSE NULL
END linear_periods_left,
r2_value*100 r2_value,
lin1.y_intercept,
CASE
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'red'
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'white'
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'green'
END pop_status,
CASE
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Decreasing by '||abs(pop_available_trend)||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Staying Flat '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Increasing by '||pop_available_trend||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
END pop_status_name,
CASE
WHEN pop1.last_available <= 0 THEN 'Already out of capacity'
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'Not changing'
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN 'Not enough data to calculate'
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'Available capacity increased'
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'Will run out on:'|| to_char(sysdate+(d0.nbr_of_days*pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(pop_available_trend),0,null,abs(pop_available_trend))),'MM/DD/YYYY')
END pop_date_of_concern,
CASE
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'red'
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'white'
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'green'
END linear_status,
CASE
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Decreasing by '||abs(linear_trend)||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Staying Flat '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Increasing by '||linear_trend||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
END linear_status_name,
CASE
WHEN pop1.last_available <= 0 THEN 'Already out of capacity'
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'Not changing'
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN 'Not enough data to calculate'
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'Available capacity increased'
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'Will run out on:'|| to_char(sysdate+(d0.nbr_of_days*pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(linear_trend),0,null,abs(linear_trend))),'MM/DD/YYYY')
END linear_date_of_concern,
d0.nbr_of_days,
d0.the_group_by
FROM  d0, lin1, pop1, pop2, apt_v_server s
WHERE
pop1.master_server_id = s.server_id
AND pop1.master_server_id = pop2.master_server_id
AND pop1.node_id = pop2.node_id
AND pop1.master_server_id = lin1.master_server_id
AND pop1.node_id = lin1.node_id

title: Backup Client Volume Forecast CL
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 12/04/2018
--Forecasting Backup Framework II Future value
--Similar to original framework except rather than telling you when you will run out
--It tells you what a value will be in the future
--Also does not use POP only Linear because first value could be an incremental 
--you cant really compare first backup to last backup
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT 
TRUNC(j.finish_date) the_date,
j.server_id the_id_1,
j.client_id the_id_2,
NVL(ROUND(SUM(j.kilobytes/div_by),2),0) the_value
FROM 
apt_v_job j, var
WHERE 
j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND j.kilobytes > 0
AND j.summary_status < 2
AND j.server_id <> j.client_id
--All Backup Types,Fulls Only
AND UPPER(j.job_type_name) LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All Backup Types','%','Fulls Only','%FULL%')
GROUP BY 
TRUNC(j.finish_date),
j.server_id,
j.client_id
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
MAX(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) max_of_the_value,
AVG(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) avg_of_the_value,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) the_value_lin,
REGR_R2(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) r2_value,
REGR_AVGY(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) avg_y,
REGR_INTERCEPT(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) y_intercept
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
ROUND(f2.first_value,2) first_value, 
f2.last_date,
ROUND(f2.last_value,2) last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
ROUND(f2.the_value_lin,2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((f2.r2_value * 100),2) r2_value_pct,
ROUND(f2.avg_y,2) avg_y,
ROUND(f2.sum_of_the_value,2) sum_of_the_value,
ROUND(f2.max_of_the_value,2) max_of_the_value,
ROUND(f2.avg_of_the_value,2) avg_of_the_value,
ROUND((f2.avg_y + (f2.the_value_lin*30)),2) lin_30_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.avg_y + (f2.the_value_lin*180)),2) lin_180_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.avg_y + (f2.the_value_lin*365)),2) lin_365_day_forecast
FROM f2
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
s2 AS (-- Trend sparklines
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(f2.y_intercept + (f1.row_number * f2.the_value_lin),2)) ORDER BY f1.row_number) AS StringListType),', ') lin_spk
FROM f1,f2
WHERE
f1.the_id_1 = f2.the_id_1
AND f1.the_id_2 = f2.the_id_2
GROUP BY 
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2
)
SELECT
f3.the_id_1 server_id,
s.hostname server_name,
f3.the_id_2 client_id,
c.hostname client_name,
s1.the_spk,
s2.lin_spk,
f3.avg_y avg_avail,
f3.sum_of_the_value,
f3.max_of_the_value,
f3.avg_of_the_value,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) = 0 THEN 'Did Not Change'
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) < 0 THEN 'trend_down'
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) = 0 THEN 'trend_flat'
WHEN (f3.the_value_lin) > 0 THEN 'trend_up'
END trend_icon,
f3.r2_value_pct,
lin_30_day_forecast,
lin_180_day_forecast,
lin_365_day_forecast
FROM f3, s1, s2, apt_v_server s, apt_v_server c
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = s2.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s2.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = s.server_id
AND f3.the_id_2 = c.server_id
ORDER BY 1,4

title: Backup Hogs
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 07/30/2015
WITH 
t1 AS (--get the largest backup
SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE  */
j.server_id,
j.server_name,
j.client_id,
j.client_name,
MAX(j.kilobytes) max_kb
FROM 
apt_v_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
--AND j.server_id <> j.client_id
AND j.summary_status IN (0,1)
GROUP BY 
j.server_id,
j.server_name,
j.client_id,
j.client_name
HAVING 
MAX(j.kilobytes) >= ${freeText1} * 1024 * 1024
)--Now get the job Id for that backup
SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE(t1) */
j.product_type_name,
j.job_id,
t1.server_id,
t1.server_name,
t1.client_id,
t1.client_name,
j.finish_date,
j.job_type_name,
j.nbr_of_files,
t1.max_kb
FROM 
apt_v_job j, t1
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
--AND j.server_id <> j.client_id
AND j.client_id = t1.client_id
AND j.server_id = t1.server_id
AND j.summary_status IN (0,1)
AND j.kilobytes = t1.max_kb
ORDER BY max_kb DESC

title: Backup Job and Client Status per Backup Server
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 01/11/2019
WITH 
d1 AS (
SELECT
--Dates Required for Drilldown 
TO_CHAR(${startDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') start_date_char,
TO_CHAR(${startDate},'HH24') start_hour_char,
TO_CHAR(${endDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') finish_date_char,
TO_CHAR(${endDate},'HH24') finish_hour_char
FROM apt_v_dual
),
j1 AS (--Job Stats
SELECT 
j.server_id,
j.server_name,
j.product_type_name,
SUM(j.kilobytes/1024/1024/1024) job_volume,
COUNT(j.job_id) job_count,
SUM(DECODE(j.vendor_status_name,'Successful',1,0)) successful_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(j.vendor_status_name,'Failed',1,0)) failed_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(j.vendor_status_name,'Partial',1,0)) partial_job_count,
ROUND((sum(DECODE(j.vendor_status_name,'Successful',1,0))+sum(DECODE(j.vendor_status_name,'Partial',1,0)))
/count(j.job_id)*100,2) job_success_rate
FROM apt_v_job j
WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND j.server_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY 
j.server_id,
j.server_name,
j.product_type_name
),
fc1 AS (--Failed Clients 
SELECT
j.server_id,
j.client_id,
min(summary_status) min_summary_status,
max(summary_status) max_summary_status
FROM apt_v_job j
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND summary_status IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
j.server_id,
j.client_id
),
fc2 AS (
SELECT
server_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) client_count,
SUM(CASE WHEN min_summary_status = 2 AND max_summary_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) failed_clients,
SUM(CASE WHEN min_summary_status = 1 AND max_summary_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) partial_clients,
SUM(CASE WHEN min_summary_status = 0 AND max_summary_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) successful_clients,
SUM(CASE WHEN min_summary_status <> max_summary_status THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mixed_clients
FROM fc1
GROUP BY server_id
), 
fc3 AS (
SELECT
server_id,
failed_clients,
partial_clients,
successful_clients,
mixed_clients,
client_count,
ROUND(failed_clients/client_count*100,2) client_failure_rate,
ROUND(partial_clients/client_count*100,2) client_partial_rate,
ROUND(successful_clients/client_count*100,2) client_success_rate,
ROUND(mixed_clients/client_count*100,2) client_mixed_rate
FROM fc2
)
SELECT 
--If you have attributes for your backup servers un-comment the line 
--below and modify the attribute name if necessary.  The example below assumes a
--'Location' attribute has been assigned to each backup server.
--rtd.getObjectAttributeValue(j1.server_id,'Location','S') location,
j1.server_id,
server_name,
product_type_name,
job_volume,
job_count,
CASE 
WHEN job_success_rate BETWEEN ${freeCombo2} AND 99.999 THEN 'green'
WHEN job_success_rate BETWEEN ${freeCombo1} AND ${freeCombo2} THEN 'yellow'
WHEN job_success_rate < ${freeCombo1} THEN 'red'
WHEN job_success_rate = 100 THEN 'blue'
ELSE 'white'
END job_status_dot,
successful_job_count,
partial_job_count,
failed_job_count,
job_success_rate,
client_count,
CASE 
WHEN client_success_rate BETWEEN ${freeCombo2} AND 99.999 THEN 'green'
WHEN client_success_rate BETWEEN ${freeCombo1} AND ${freeCombo2} THEN 'yellow'
WHEN client_success_rate < ${freeCombo1} THEN 'red'
WHEN client_success_rate = 100 THEN 'blue'
ELSE 'white'
END client_status_dot,
successful_clients,
partial_clients,
failed_clients,
mixed_clients,
client_success_rate,
start_date_char,
start_hour_char,
finish_date_char,
finish_hour_char
FROM d1, j1, fc3
WHERE j1.server_id = fc3.server_id 
ORDER BY 10 asc

title: Backup Period Over Period Stats Detail
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/22/2013
-- Compares the Period over Period values 
WITH
var AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
d0 AS ( --Decode the date ranges
SELECT 
(TRUNC(${endDate}) - TRUNC(${startDate}))+1 day_num
FROM apt_v_dual
),
d1 AS (
SELECT
day_num,
TRUNC(sysdate - (day_num * 2)) prior_start_date,
TRUNC((sysdate - day_num))  prior_end_date,
TRUNC((sysdate - day_num)) current_start_date,
TRUNC(sysdate) current_end_date
FROM d0
),
j1 AS ( --Prior period client stats
SELECT 
j.client_id, 
j.client_name, 
SUM(kilobytes/div_by) job_volume,
COUNT(job_id) job_count
FROM d1, apt_v_job j, var
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN prior_start_date AND prior_end_date
AND j.summary_status IN (0,1)
GROUP BY j.client_id, j.client_name
),
j2 AS ( --Current period stats
SELECT 
j.client_id, 
j.client_name, 
SUM(kilobytes/div_by) job_volume,
COUNT(job_id) job_count
FROM d1, apt_v_job j, var
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN current_start_date AND current_end_date
AND j.summary_status IN (0,1)
GROUP BY j.client_id, j.client_name
),
c0 AS ( --Clients who stayed exactly the same
SELECT
1 sort_order,
'Client Stayed the Same' metric,
j1.client_id,
j1.client_name, 
j1.job_volume vol_prior,
j2.job_volume vol_curr,
j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume vol_change,
(j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume)/DECODE(j2.job_volume,0,null,j2.job_volume)*100 pct_change
FROM j1,j2
WHERE j1.client_id = j2.client_id
AND (j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume) = 0
),
c1 AS ( --Clients who increased
SELECT
2 sort_order,
'Client Increased' metric,
j1.client_id,
j1.client_name, 
j1.job_volume vol_prior,
j2.job_volume vol_curr,
j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume vol_change,
(j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume)/DECODE(j2.job_volume,0,null,j2.job_volume)*100 pct_change
FROM j1,j2
WHERE j1.client_id = j2.client_id
AND (j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume) > 0
),
c2 AS ( --Clients who decreased
SELECT
3 sort_order,
'Client Decreased' metric,
j1.client_id,
j1.client_name, 
j1.job_volume vol_prior,
j2.job_volume vol_curr,
j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume vol_change,
(j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume)/DECODE(j2.job_volume,0,null,j2.job_volume)*100 pct_change
FROM j1,j2
WHERE j1.client_id = j2.client_id
AND (j2.job_volume-j1.job_volume) < 0
),
t1 AS (
SELECT 
4 sort_order,
'Client Retired' metric,
j1.client_id,
j1.client_name, 
j1.job_volume vol_prior,
0 vol_curr,
j1.job_volume vol_change,
100 pct_change
FROM j1
WHERE j1.client_id NOT IN (SELECT j2.client_id FROM j2)
UNION
SELECT 
5 sort_order,
'New Client' metric,
j2.client_id,
j2.client_name, 
0 vol_prior,
j2.job_volume vol_curr,
j2.job_volume vol_change,
100 pct_change
FROM j2
WHERE j2.client_id NOT IN (SELECT j1.client_id FROM j1)
UNION
SELECT 
6 sort_order,
'Client backup size decreased' metric,
c2.client_id,
c2.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c2.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c2
UNION
SELECT 
7 sort_order,
'Client backup size stayed the same' metric,
c0.client_id,
c0.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c0.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c0
UNION
SELECT 
8 sort_order,
'Client backup size increased 1% to 20% ' metric,
c1.client_id,
c1.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c1.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c1
WHERE c1.pct_change < 20 
UNION
SELECT 
9 sort_order,
'Client backup size increased 20% to 50% ' metric,
c1.client_id,
c1.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c1.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c1
WHERE c1.pct_change BETWEEN 20 AND 50
UNION
SELECT 
10 sort_order,
'Client backup size increased 50% to 100% ' metric,
c1.client_id,
c1.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c1.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c1
WHERE c1.pct_change BETWEEN 50 AND 100
UNION
SELECT 
11 sort_order,
'Client backup size increased over 100% ' metric,
c1.client_id,
c1.client_name, 
vol_prior,
vol_curr,
c1.vol_change vol_change,
pct_change
FROM c1
WHERE c1.pct_change > 100
)
SELECT *
FROM t1 
WHERE metric LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}%')

sql_query: --Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 10/01/2013 -- Compares the Period over Period values WITH var AS ( SELECT DECODE('${freeCombo1}', TRUNC(sysdate) current_end_date FROM d0 ), j1 AS ( --Prior period client stats SELECT j.client_id, SUM(kilobytes/div_by) job_volume_tot, COUNT(job_id) job_count FROM d1, apt_v_job j, var WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.start_date BETWEEN prior_start_date AND prior_end_date AND j.summary_status IN (0,1) GROUP BY j.client_id ), p1 AS ( --Prior period totals SELECT SUM(job_volume_tot) job_volume_tot, COUNT(job_count) job_count, COUNT(client_id) client_count FROM j1 ), j2 AS ( --Current period stats SELECT j.client_id, SUM(kilobytes/div_by) job_volume_tot, COUNT(job_id) job_count FROM d1, apt_v_job j, var WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.start_date BETWEEN current_start_date AND current_end_date AND j.summary_status IN (0,1) GROUP BY j.client_id ), p2 AS ( --Prior period totals SELECT SUM(job_volume_tot) job_volume_tot, COUNT(job_count) job_count, COUNT(client_id) client_count FROM j2 ), c0 AS ( --Clients who stayed exactly the same SELECT j1.client_id, (j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot) = 0 ), c1 AS ( --Clients who increased SELECT j1.client_id, j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot vol_change, (j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot)/DECODE(j2.job_volume_tot,0,null,j2.job_volume_tot)*100 pct_change FROM j1,j2 WHERE j1.client_id = j2.client_id AND (j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot) > 0 ), c2 AS ( --Clients who decreased SELECT j1.client_id, j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot vol_change, (j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot)/DECODE(j2.job_volume_tot,0,null,j2.job_volume_tot)*100 pct_change FROM j1,j2 WHERE j1.client_id = j2.client_id AND (j2.job_volume_tot-j1.job_volume_tot) < 0 ) SELECT 0 sort_order, 'Clients Current Period: '||TO_CHAR(current_start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')||' - '||TO_CHAR(current_end_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') metric, p2.client_count the_count, p2.job_volume_tot the_volume, NULL the_pct FROM d1, p2 UNION SELECT 1 sort_order, 'Clients Prior Period: '||TO_CHAR(prior_start_date,'MM/DD/YYYY')||' - '||TO_CHAR(prior_end_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') metric, p1.client_count the_count, p1.job_volume_tot the_volume, NULL the_pct FROM d1, p1 UNION SELECT 2 the_pct FROM p1, p2, d0 UNION SELECT 3 sort_order, 'Retired Clients' metric, COUNT(j1.client_id) the_count, SUM(j1.job_volume_tot)*-1 the_volume,--Show this as a negative number so bottom line will c1.pct_change < 20 UNION SELECT 7 sort_order, 'Clients with 20% to 50% increase' metric, COUNT(c1.client_id) the_count, SUM(c1.vol_change) the_volume, SUM(c1.vol_change)/MAX(p2.job_volume_tot)*100 the_pct FROM c1, p2 WHERE c1.pct_change BETWEEN 20 AND 50 UNION SELECT 8 sort_order, 'Clients with 50% to 100% increase' metric, COUNT(c1.client_id) the_count, SUM(c1.vol_change) the_volume, SUM(c1.vol_change)/MAX(p2.job_volume_tot)*100 the_pct FROM c1, p2 WHERE c1.pct_change BETWEEN 50 AND 100 UNION SELECT 9 sort_order, 'Clients with over 100% increase' metric, COUNT(c1.client_id) the_count, SUM(c1.vol_change) the_volume, SUM(c1.vol_change)/MAX(p2.job_volume_tot)*100 the_pct FROM c1, p2 WHERE c1.pct_change > 100

title: Backup Skipped File and Reason
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 09/30/201 SELECT j.product_type_name, j.server_name, j.client_name, COUNT(j.job_id) skipped_file_count, REPLACE(aptStringConcat(DISTINCT sbf.skipped_filename),',','
') skipped_file, REPLACE(aptStringConcat(DISTINCT jml.message),',','
') reason FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_skipped_backup_file sbf,apt_v_job_message_log jml WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.summary_status=1 AND j.job_id = sbf.job_id AND j.job_id = jml.job_id GROUP BY j.product_type_name, j.server_name, j.client_name ORDER BY 1,2,3

title: Backup Stats vs Last Month
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 09/18/2015
--Compare backup metrics today vs same time last month
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT 
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by,
ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'MM'),-1) p_first, 
LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(sysdate,-1)) p_last, 
ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'DD'),-1) p_day,
TRUNC(sysdate,'MM') c_first, 
LAST_DAY(sysdate) c_last,
TRUNC(sysdate,'DD') c_day
FROM apt_v_dual
),
p0 AS (
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) clients,
ROUND(SUM(kilobytes/div_by),2) volume,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0)) failed_jobs,
SUM(nbr_of_files/1000000) nbr_of_files
FROm apt_v_job j, var
WHERE client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.finish_date BETWEEN p_first AND p_day
),
c0 AS (
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) clients,
ROUND(SUM(kilobytes/div_by),2) volume,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0)) failed_jobs,
SUM(nbr_of_files/1000000) nbr_of_files
FROM apt_v_job j, var
WHERE client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.finish_date BETWEEN c_first AND c_day
)
-- Metrics Start Here --
SELECT
1 sort_order,
'Backup Clients' metric,
p0.clients p_value,
c0.clients c_value, 
(c0.clients - p0.clients) delta, 
ROUND((c0.clients - p0.clients) / DECODE(p0.clients,0,NULL,p0.clients),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c0.clients - p0.clients) / DECODE(p0.clients,0,NULL,p0.clients),2)) pct_delta
FROM p0, c0
UNION
SELECT
2 sort_order,
'Backup Volume'||' ('||var.unit||')' metric,
p0.volume p_value,
c0.volume c_value, 
(c0.volume - p0.volume) delta, 
ROUND((c0.volume - p0.volume) / DECODE(p0.volume,0,NULL,p0.volume),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c0.volume - p0.volume) / DECODE(p0.volume,0,NULL,p0.volume),2)) pct_delta
FROM p0, c0, var
UNION
SELECT
3 sort_order,
'Failed Backups' metric,
p0.failed_jobs p_value,
c0.failed_jobs c_value, 
(c0.failed_jobs - p0.failed_jobs) delta, 
ROUND((c0.failed_jobs - p0.failed_jobs) / DECODE(p0.failed_jobs,0,NULL,p0.failed_jobs),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c0.failed_jobs - p0.failed_jobs) / DECODE(p0.failed_jobs,0,NULL,p0.failed_jobs),2)) pct_delta
FROM p0, c0
UNION
SELECT
4 sort_order,
'Files Protected (Millions)' metric,
p0.nbr_of_files p_value,
c0.nbr_of_files c_value, 
(c0.nbr_of_files - p0.nbr_of_files) delta, 
ROUND((c0.nbr_of_files - p0.nbr_of_files) / DECODE(p0.nbr_of_files,0,NULL,p0.nbr_of_files),2) delta_pct,

title: Client Final Status Count by Day,Week,Month,Qtr,Yr
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 12/11/2012
--Daily Client Final Status by Day,Week,Month,Quarter,Year
--This report helps to see if how the overall client status is doing over time.
--This report determines the final client status based on a user defined cutoff time
--Then it aggregates that count by Day, Week, Month, or Year
--If the all the clients jobs failed the client is flagged as failed
--If all the client's jobs were successful then the client is flagged as successful
--If all the client's jobs were partially successful then the client is flagged as partial
--If there is any combination of the above then the client is flagged as mixed 
--NOTE: Successful and Partials are hidden by default to help focus on the problems
--they can be enabled by editing the Report Template and checking the columns in the 
--Formatting tab.
WITH
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Midnight','1am',1,'2am',2,'3am',3,'4am',4,'5am',5,'6am',6,'7am',7,'8am',8,'9am',9,'10am',10,'11am',11,'12pm',12) cutoff_time
FROM dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
TRUNC(start_date)+(d0.cutoff_time/24) cutoff_date_time,
j.client_name,
COUNT(job_id) job_count,
MIN(summary_status) min_summary_status,
MAX(summary_status) max_summary_status,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,0,1,0)) status_0_count,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,1,1,0)) status_1_count,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0)) status_2_count
FROM apt_v_job j,d0
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
TRUNC(start_date)+(d0.cutoff_time/24),
j.client_name
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
cutoff_date_time,
SUM(DECODE(min_summary_status,2,1,0)) failed_clients,
SUM(DECODE(min_summary_status,1,1,0)) partial_clients,
SUM(DECODE(max_summary_status,0,1,0)) successful_clients,
SUM(CASE WHEN min_summary_status < 2 AND max_summary_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) success_and_failed_clients
FROM t1
GROUP BY cutoff_date_time
)
SELECT
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(cutoff_date_time,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'YYYY/MM/DD') the_date,
SUM(successful_clients) successful_clients,
SUM(partial_clients) partial_clients,
SUM(success_and_failed_clients) success_and_failed_clients,
SUM(failed_clients) failed_clients
FROM t2
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(cutoff_date_time,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'YYYY/MM/DD')

title: Client Status.D
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/02/2012
--NOTE: This is a drilldown report only and will not run standalone
--The templateName is ClientStatusSummary.D
WITH 
d1 AS (
SELECT
--Dates Required for Drilldown 
TO_CHAR(${startDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') start_date_char,
TO_CHAR(${startDate},'HH24') start_hour_char,
TO_CHAR(${endDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') finish_date_char,
TO_CHAR(${endDate},'HH24') finish_hour_char
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
server_id,
server_name,
client_id,
client_name,
COUNT(job_id) job_count,
min(summary_status) min_summary_status,
max(summary_status) max_summary_status,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,0,1,0)) successful_jobs,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,1,1,0)) partial_jobs,
SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0)) failed_jobs
FROM apt_v_job 
WHERE
client_id IN (${hosts})
AND start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND summary_status IS NOT NULL
AND server_id = ${the_server_id}
GROUP BY 
server_id,
server_name,
client_id,
client_name
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
server_id,
server_name,
client_id,
client_name,
CASE 
WHEN min_summary_status = 2 AND max_summary_status = 2 THEN 'Failed'
WHEN min_summary_status = 1 AND max_summary_status = 1 THEN 'Partial'
WHEN min_summary_status = 0 AND max_summary_status = 0 THEN 'Successful'
WHEN min_summary_status <> max_summary_status THEN 'Mixed'
END status,
(successful_jobs+partial_jobs+failed_jobs) total_jobs,
successful_jobs,
partial_jobs,
failed_jobs
FROM t1
)
SELECT t2.*,d1.* 
FROM t2, d1
WHERE status = DECODE('${the_status}','All',status,'${the_status}')

title: Clients Who Missed Their Backups
sql_query:
-- Of the jobs run within the specified time frame, display the clients
-- that are in the same server group, who did not have a job present.
-- In addition to displaying the client, also display the last tbackup they had, and what was
-- it's status.
WITH 
t1 as (--All clients in the server group
SELECT DISTINCT server_id
FROM apt_v_server
WHERE server_id IN (${hosts})
),
t2 as (--Clients which had backups in the last x days
SELECT 
DISTINCT client_id
FROM apt_v_job  j
WHERE  j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
)
SELECT t1.server_id, s.hostname, lcj.job_id, lcj.finish_date,
DECODE(lcj.summary_status,0,'blue',1,'yellow',2,'red') summary_status
FROM t1, apt_v_server s, apt_v_last_client_job lcj
WHERE t1.server_id NOT IN (SELECT client_id FROM t2)
AND t1.server_id = s.server_id
AND t1.server_id = lcj.client_id (+)

title: Clients with no Backup in X Days
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 01/11/2018
WITH 
c1 AS (
SELECT 
DISTINCT server_id client_id, hostname
FROM apt_v_server
WHERE server_id IN (${hosts})
),
j1 AS (
SELECT
client_id,
MAX(lcj.finish_date) last_backup
FROM apt_v_last_client_job lcj
WHERE server_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY client_id
),
j2 AS (
SELECT
c1.hostname client,
NVL(to_char(last_backup,'MM/DD/YYYY'),'Never') last_backup, 
NVL((sysdate - last_backup),99999) days_since_last
FROM j1, c1
WHERE
c1.client_id = j1.client_id (+)
)
SELECT 
client,
last_backup,
days_since_last
FROM j2
WHERE days_since_last >=
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'in at least 3 Days',3,
'in at least 7 Days',7,
'in at least 14 Days',14,
'in at least 30 Days',30,
'in at least 60 Days',60,
'Ever',99999
)
ORDER BY
days_since_last

title: CommVault Disk Library Capacity & Utilization
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 07/24/2018
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
s.server_id s_server_id,
s.display_name s_display_name,
cdl.cmv_disk_library_id,
cdl.library_external_name,
COUNT(DISTINCT cdm.cmv_disk_media_id) nbr_drives,
SUM(cdm.total_space_kb/div_by) total_space,
SUM(cdm.free_space_kb/div_by) free_space,
SUM(cdm.used_space_kb/div_by) used_space,
SUM(cdm.used_space_kb)/SUM(NULLIF(cdm.total_space_kb,0)) pct_used,
SUM(cdm.used_space_kb)/SUM(NULLIF(cdm.total_space_kb,0))*100 used_pct,
SUM(cdm.nbr_backups) nbr_backups, 
MAX(last_backup_time) last_backup_time, 
SUM(cdm.nbr_restores) nbr_restores, 
MAX(last_restore_time) last_restore_time,
SUM(NVL(cdm.nbr_hard_errors,0)+NVL(cdm.nbr_soft_errors,0)) nbr_of_errors
FROM
var, apt_v_server s, apt_v_cmv_disk_media cdm, apt_v_cmv_disk_library cdl
WHERE
cdm.server_id = s.server_id
AND cdm.server_id IN (${hosts})
AND cdm.cmv_disk_library_id =  cdl.cmv_disk_library_id
GROUP BY
s.server_id,
s.display_name,
cdl.cmv_disk_library_id,
cdl.library_external_name
),
t2 AS (
SELECT 
cdm.cmv_disk_library_id,
COUNT(DISTINCT j.job_id) nbr_of_jobs,
SUM(j.kilobytes/div_by) job_volume,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(j.kilobytes/div_by,2)) ORDER BY j.start_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_cmv_job_disk_media jdm, apt_v_cmv_disk_media cdm, var
WHERE jdm.job_id = j.job_id
AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND j.server_id IN (${hosts})
AND jdm.cmv_disk_media_id = cdm.cmv_disk_media_id
GROUP BY cdm.cmv_disk_library_id
)
SELECT 
t1.s_server_id,
t1.s_display_name,
t1.library_external_name,
t1.nbr_drives,
t1.total_space,
t1.free_space,
t1.used_space,
t1.pct_used,
t1.used_pct,
t1.last_backup_time, 
t1.last_restore_time,
t1.nbr_of_errors,
t2.nbr_of_jobs,
NVL(t2.job_volume,0) job_volume,
t2.the_spk
FROM t1, t2
WHERE 
t1.cmv_disk_library_id = t2.cmv_disk_library_id (+)
--AND t2.nbr_of_jobs >  0
ORDER BY NVL(t2.job_volume,0) DESC

title: CommVault Tape Drive Activity and Idle Time
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 06/14/2018
WITH 
d0 as (
SELECT (${endDate} - ${startDate})*24 nbr_of_hrs
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 as (
SELECT 
td.management_server_name, 
td.controlling_server_name,
td.library_id,
td.library_name, 
td.drive_id,
td.drive_name, 
SUM(CASE WHEN tdl.tape_media_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_use,
SUM(CASE WHEN tdl.tape_media_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) not_in_use
FROM apt_v_tape_drive td, apt_v_tape_drive_log tdl
WHERE td.drive_id = tdl.drive_id 
AND tdl.poll_time BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND td.management_server_id IN (${hosts}) 
GROUP BY  td.management_server_name, td.controlling_server_name,
td.library_id,td.library_name, td.drive_id, td.drive_name 
),
t2 as (
SELECT
management_server_name, 
controlling_server_name,
library_id,library_name, 
drive_id, drive_name, 
in_use,not_in_use,
in_use+not_in_use nbr_of_samples,
DECODE(not_in_use,0,null,not_in_use)/DECODE((in_use+not_in_use),0,null,(in_use+not_in_use))*100 not_in_use_pct,
DECODE(not_in_use,0,null,not_in_use)/DECODE((in_use+not_in_use),0,null,(in_use+not_in_use)) pct_not_in_use
FROM t1
)
SELECT management_server_name, controlling_server_name,library_id,library_name, drive_id, drive_name, 
in_use,not_in_use,
not_in_use_pct,
pct_not_in_use,
nbr_of_hrs,
nbr_of_samples,
nbr_of_samples/nbr_of_hrs samples_hr,
(not_in_use_pct/100)*nbr_of_hrs available_hours,
rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs((not_in_use_pct/100)*nbr_of_hrs*60*60) idle_time
FROM t2,d0
ORDER by 1,2,4,5

sql_query:
WITH

server_name entity,

SUM(DECODE(summary_status,0,1)) successful_jobs,

AVG(mbytes_sec) mbytes_sec,

server_name

entity,

),

)

title: Compliance RTO RPO Report
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 06/24/2014 WITH VAR AS ( SELECT ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, ${startDate} startDate, DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by FROM apt_v_dual ), c0 AS (--Get all the servers in the group, rely on this list in case they never had a job SELECT DISTINCT server_id client_id, display_name client_name FROM apt_v_server WHERE server_id IN (${hosts}) ), f0 AS ( SELECT j.client_id, MAX(j.job_id) last_full_job_id FROM apt_v_job j WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.job_type = 101 AND j.summary_status = 0 AND j.kilobytes > 0 --Eliminate NBU Parent Jobs GROUP BY j.client_id ), f1 AS (--Go back and grab all the details of the last job SELECT f0.last_full_job_id, f0.client_id, j.job_type_name, j.vendor_status, j.vendor_status_name, j.vendor_state_name, j.vendor_state, j.start_date, j.finish_date fb_finish, j.kilobytes/var.div_by fb_size, j.duration_secs fb_dura, j.product_type, j.product_type_name FROM apt_v_job j, f0, var WHERE j.job_id = f0.last_full_job_id ), i1 AS (--Add up all the incrementals in case there was no full SELECT j.client_id, COUNT(j.job_id) ib_count, SUM(j.kilobytes/var.div_by) ib_size, SUM(j.duration_secs) ib_dura, AVG(j.mbytes_sec) ib_avg_throughput, MAX(j.finish_date) ib_finish FROM apt_v_job j, var WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.job_type = 102 AND j.summary_status = 0 GROUP BY j.client_id ), i2 AS (--Add up all the incrementals after the last full SELECT j.client_id, COUNT(j.job_id) ib_count, SUM(j.kilobytes/var.div_by) ib_size, SUM(j.duration_secs) ib_dura, AVG(j.mbytes_sec) ib_avg_throughput, MAX(j.finish_date) ib_finish FROM apt_v_job j, f0, var WHERE j.client_id = f0.client_id AND j.job_id > f0.last_full_job_id AND j.finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.job_type = 102 AND j.summary_status = 0 GROUP BY j.client_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN (f1.fb_dura/60/60) >= ${freeCombo2} THEN 'red' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL THEN 'red' ELSE 'green' END status_based_on_last_f, CASE WHEN (f1.fb_dura/60/60) + (i2.ib_dura/60/60) >= ${freeCombo2} THEN 'red' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL THEN 'red' ELSE 'green' END status_based_on_last_f_and_i, c0.client_id, c0.client_name, f1.last_full_job_id, CASE WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NULL THEN 'No Backups!' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NOT NULL THEN 'Incr Only
No Full!' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NOT NULL AND i2.ib_finish IS NULL THEN 'Full Only' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NOT NULL AND i2.ib_finish IS NOT NULL THEN 'Full+Incr' END restore_plan, to_char(f1.fb_finish,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mi AM') fb_finish, f1.fb_size, f1.fb_dura fb_dura_secs, f1.fb_dura/60/60 fb_dura_hrs, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(f1.fb_dura) fb_duration, TO_CHAR(i2.ib_finish,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mi AM') ib_finish2, i2.ib_count ib_count2, i2.ib_size ib_size2, i2.ib_dura ib_dura2, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(i2.ib_dura) ib_duration2, (i2.ib_dura/60/60) hrs_of_incrementals2, TO_CHAR(i1.ib_finish,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mi AM') ib_finish1, i1.ib_count ib_count1, i1.ib_size ib_size1, i1.ib_dura ib_dura_secs1, i1.ib_dura/60/60 ib_dura_hrs1, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(i1.ib_dura) ib_duration1, TO_CHAR(sysdate+NVL((f1.fb_dura/60/60),0)+NVL((i2.ib_dura/60/60),0),'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mi AM') earliest_recovery, (sysdate - f1.fb_finish)*24 hrs_since_last_full, -- CASE WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NULL THEN 'No full backup to restore from!' ELSE 'It has been '||TO_CHAR((sysdate - f1.fb_finish)*24,'999,999.99')||' Hrs since the last full backup' END status_msg_f, -- CASE WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NULL THEN 'No backups to restore from!' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NOT NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NOT NULL THEN 'It has been '||TO_CHAR((sysdate - f1.fb_finish)*24,'999,999.99')||' Hrs since the last full backup which will take a minimum of '||rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(f1.fb_dura)||' to restore, plus a minimum of '||rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(i2.ib_dura)||' to apply the incrementals' WHEN f1.fb_finish IS NOT NULL AND i1.ib_finish IS NULL THEN 'It has been '||TO_CHAR((sysdate - f1.fb_finish)*24,'999,999.99')||' Hrs since the last full backup which will take a minimum of '||rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(f1.fb_dura)||' to restore' END status_msg_f_i, TO_CHAR(GREATEST(f1.fb_finish,i2.ib_finish),'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mi AM') recovery_point, rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(((sysdate+NVL((f1.fb_dura/60/60),0)+NVL((i2.ib_dura/60/60),0)) - (GREATEST(f1.fb_finish,i2.ib_finish)))*24*60*60) lost_time FROM f1, i1, i2, c0 WHERE c0.client_id = f1.client_id (+) AND c0.client_id = i1.client_id (+) AND c0.client_id = i2.client_id (+)

title: Consecutive Client Failure Alert
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 12/07/2017
WITH d0 AS (
SELECT 14 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-14) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-13) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 13 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-13) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-12) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 12 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-12) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-11) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 11 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-11) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-10) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 10 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-10) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-09) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 09 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-09) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-08) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 08 the_day, 2 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-08) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-07) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 07 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-07) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-06) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 06 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-06) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-05) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 05 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-05) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-04) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 04 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-04) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-03) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 03 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-03) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-02) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 02 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-02) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-01) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual UNION
SELECT 01 the_day, 1 the_week, 1 the_month, TRUNC(sysdate-01) start_date, TRUNC(sysdate-00) cutoff_date FROM apt_v_dual
),
d1 AS (--Apply the cutoff time to the date pairs
SELECT 
the_day,the_week,the_month,
TRUNC(start_date)+(1/24) * DECODE('${freeCombo1}','5:00am',5,'6:00am',6,'7:00am',7,'8:00am',8,'9:00am',9,'10:00am',10,'11:00am',11) start_date,
TRUNC(cutoff_date)+(1/24) * DECODE('${freeCombo1}','5:00am',5,'6:00am',6,'7:00am',7,'8:00am',8,'9:00am',9,'10:00am',10,'11:00am',11) cutoff_date  
FROM d0
),
t1 AS (--Client Daily Statistics
SELECT 
d1.the_day, d1.the_week, d1.the_month, d1.start_date, d1.cutoff_date,
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name,
COUNT(j.job_id) job_count,
MIN(summary_status) min_status,
MAX(summary_status) max_status,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT j.vendor_status) vendor_codes
FROM apt_v_job j, d1
WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND j.start_date BETWEEN d1.start_date AND d1.cutoff_date
AND j.client_id IN (${hosts})
GROUP BY 
d1.the_day, d1.the_week, d1.the_month, d1.start_date, d1.cutoff_date,
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name
ORDER BY 
d1.the_day,d1.the_week,d1.the_month, d1.start_date, d1.cutoff_date,
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name
),
t2 AS (--Crosstab the results
SELECT
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,01,min_status)) day01_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,02,min_status)) day02_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,03,min_status)) day03_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,04,min_status)) day04_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,05,min_status)) day05_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,06,min_status)) day06_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,07,min_status)) day07_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,08,min_status)) day08_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,09,min_status)) day09_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,10,min_status)) day10_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,11,min_status)) day11_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,12,min_status)) day12_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,13,min_status)) day13_status,
MIN(DECODE(the_day,14,min_status)) day14_status,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,01,job_count)) day01_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,02,job_count)) day02_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,03,job_count)) day03_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,04,job_count)) day04_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,05,job_count)) day05_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,06,job_count)) day06_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,07,job_count)) day07_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,08,job_count)) day08_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,09,job_count)) day09_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,10,job_count)) day10_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,11,job_count)) day11_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,12,job_count)) day12_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,13,job_count)) day13_job_count,
SUM(DECODE(the_day,14,job_count)) day14_job_count,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,01,vendor_codes)) day01_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,02,vendor_codes)) day02_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,03,vendor_codes)) day03_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,04,vendor_codes)) day04_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,05,vendor_codes)) day05_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,06,vendor_codes)) day06_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,07,vendor_codes)) day07_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,08,vendor_codes)) day08_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,09,vendor_codes)) day09_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,10,vendor_codes)) day10_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,11,vendor_codes)) day11_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,12,vendor_codes)) day12_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,13,vendor_codes)) day13_codes,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT DECODE(the_day,14,vendor_codes)) day14_codes
FROM t1
GROUP BY 
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name
),
t3 AS (--Evaluate the risk
SELECT
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name,
CASE 
WHEN NVL(day01_status,0)+ NVL(day02_status,0)+ NVL(day03_status,0) = 6
THEN 'Failed Backup 3 Consecutive Days'
WHEN NVL(day01_status,0)+ NVL(day02_status,0) = 4
THEN 'Failed Backup 2 Consecutive Days'
WHEN day01_status IS NULL AND day02_status = 2 AND day03_status = 2
THEN 'No Backup After 2 Days of Failure'
WHEN day01_status IS NULL AND day02_status IS NULL AND day03_status = 2
THEN 'No Backup in 2 Days After Failure'
WHEN day01_status IS NULL AND day02_status IS NULL AND day03_status IS NULL
THEN 'No Backup Last 3 Days'
END risk_analysis,
day01_status, day02_status, day03_status, day04_status, day05_status, day06_status, day07_status,
day08_status, day09_status, day10_status, day11_status, day12_status, day13_status, day14_status,
DECODE(day01_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day01_dot,
DECODE(day02_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day02_dot, 
DECODE(day03_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day03_dot, 
DECODE(day04_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day04_dot, 
DECODE(day05_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day05_dot, 
DECODE(day06_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day06_dot, 
DECODE(day07_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day07_dot,
DECODE(day08_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day08_dot,
DECODE(day09_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day09_dot, 
DECODE(day10_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day10_dot, 
DECODE(day11_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day11_dot, 
DECODE(day12_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day12_dot, 
DECODE(day13_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day13_dot, 
DECODE(day14_status,null,'white',0,'green',1,'yellow',2,'red') day14_dot,
day01_job_count, day02_job_count, day03_job_count, day04_job_count, day05_job_count, day06_job_count, day07_job_count,
day08_job_count, day09_job_count, day10_job_count, day11_job_count, day12_job_count, day13_job_count, day14_job_count,
day01_codes, day02_codes, day03_codes, day04_codes, day05_codes, day06_codes, day07_codes,
day08_codes, day09_codes, day10_codes, day11_codes, day12_codes, day13_codes, day14_codes
FROM t2
WHERE 
--Only get ones that had a failure in the last 14 days
GREATEST(NVL(day01_status,0), NVL(day02_status,0), NVL(day03_status,0), NVL(day04_status,0), NVL(day05_status,0), NVL(day06_status,0), NVL(day07_status,0),
NVL(day08_status,0), NVL(day09_status,0), NVL(day10_status,0), NVL(day11_status,0), NVL(day12_status,0), NVL(day13_status,0), NVL(day14_status,0)) = 2
)
SELECT
server_id, server_name,
client_id, client_name,
risk_analysis,
day01_dot, day02_dot, day03_dot, day04_dot, day05_dot, day06_dot, day07_dot,
day08_dot, day09_dot, day10_dot, day11_dot, day12_dot, day13_dot, day14_dot,
day01_job_count, day02_job_count, day03_job_count, day04_job_count, day05_job_count, day06_job_count, day07_job_count,
day08_job_count, day09_job_count, day10_job_count, day11_job_count, day12_job_count, day13_job_count, day14_job_count,
day01_codes, day02_codes, day03_codes, day04_codes, day05_codes, day06_codes, day07_codes,
day08_codes, day09_codes, day10_codes, day11_codes, day12_codes, day13_codes, day14_codes
FROM t3
WHERE
risk_analysis LIKE 
CASE 
WHEN '${freeCombo2}' = 'All' THEN '%'
WHEN '${freeCombo2}' = 'Failed Backup' THEN 'Failed Backup%'
WHEN '${freeCombo2}' = 'All' THEN 'No Backup%'
END
ORDER BY 
UPPER(server_name),
UPPER(client_name)

w_count, SUM(DECODE(summary_status,2,1,0)) f_count, SUM(DECODE(is_active,'Y',1,0)) i_count, MIN(start_date) first_attempt, MAX(start_date) last_attempt, aptStringConcat(DISTINCT job_type_name) 'Successful & Warnings & Failed', 8 , 'Incomplete', 9 , 'Successful & Incomplete', 10 , 'Warnings & Incomplete', 11 , 'Successful & Warnings & Incomplete', 12 , 'Failed & Incomplete', 13 , 'Successful & Failed & Incomplete', 14 , 'Warnings & Failed & Incomplete', 15 , 'Successful & Warnings & Failed & Incomplete', 'Other') overall_client_status, /* DECODE(secret_code, 1 , '', 2 , '', 3 , '', 4 , title: Daily Job Size vs 3 Day Moving Average
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 11/26/2012
WITH t1 AS (
SELECT
TRUNC(start_date,'DD') the_date,
server_name,
ROUND(SUM(kilobytes/1024/1024),2) job_size
FROM apt_v_job
WHERE
client_id IN (${hosts})
AND start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY trunc(start_date,'DD'), server_name
ORDER BY 1,2
)
SELECT 
the_date,server_name,job_size,
avg(job_size) OVER (PARTITION BY server_name ORDER BY the_date ROWS BETWEEN ${freeCombo1} PRECEDING AND 0 FOLLOWING) moving_average FROM t1
ORDER BY 2,1 DESC

MAX(start_date) max_start_date,

MAX(finish_date) max_finish_date,

  'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual

SELECT

  ROUND(SUM(local_comp_kb/div_by),2) total_size,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date > sysdate-1 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) one_day,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-7 AND sysdate-2 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_2_and_7,

  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-30 AND sysdate-14 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_14_and_30,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-60 AND sysdate-30 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_30_and_60,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-90 AND sysdate-60 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_60_and_90,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-180 AND sysdate-90 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_90_and_180,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_modified_date BETWEEN sysdate-365 AND sysdate-180 THEN local_comp_kb/div_by END),2) bt_180_and_365,

title: Data Domain Filesystem Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 06/26/2018
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting DataDomain Filesystem
TRUNC(l.collection_time) the_date,
l.host_id the_id_1,
l.filesystem_id the_id_2,
MAX(ROUND(((l.filesystem_size_kb - l.filesystem_used_kb)/div_by),2)) the_value
FROM 
apt_v_ddm_file_system f,apt_v_ddm_file_system_log l, var
WHERE 
l.collection_time BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND l.filesystem_id = f.filesystem_id
AND f.filesystem_name NOT LIKE '/ddvar'
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.collection_time),
l.host_id,
l.filesystem_id
ORDER BY 1,2,3
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC),2) first_value, 
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC),2) last_value,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0),2) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
f2.first_value, 
f2.last_date,
f2.last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
f2.the_value_lin,
f2.sum_of_the_value,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN NULL
  ELSE 9999
END days_left_lin,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
--
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN NULL 
  ELSE 9999
END days_left_pop,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2, var
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
t1 AS (--Format the final Output
SELECT
dfs.host_id,
dfs.host_name,
dfs.filesystem_id,
dfs.filesystem_name,
s1.the_spk,
f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Not Changed'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, apt_v_ddm_file_system dfs
WHERE 
f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = dfs.host_id
AND f3.the_id_2 = dfs.filesystem_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM t1
WHERE usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}')
ORDER BY days_left_pop ASC

WITH 
t1 AS (
SELECT
s.server_id,
s.hostname,
s.location,
s.ip_address,
de.model_number,
ds.serial_number,
s.os_version,
sum(dfs.filesystem_size_kb/1024/1024/1024) filesystem_size_tb,
sum(dfs.pre_comp_size_kb/1024/1024/1024) pre_comp_size_tb,
sum(dfs.filesystem_used_kb/1024/1024/1024) filesystem_used_tb,
sum(dfs.filesystem_cleanable_kb/1024/1024/1024) filesystem_cleanable_tb

AND ds.host_id = de.host_id
AND ds.host_id = dfs.host_id
AND de.enclosure_id = 1
GROUP BY
s.server_id,
s.hostname,
s.location,
s.ip_address,
de.model_number,
ds.serial_number,
s.os_version
),
t2 AS(
SELECT
location,
round(sum(filesystem_size_tb),2) filesystem_size_tb,
round(sum(pre_comp_size_tb),2) pre_comp_size_tb,
round(sum(filesystem_used_tb),2) filesystem_used_tb,
round(avg((pre_comp_size_tb/filesystem_used_tb)),2) avg_comp_ratio,
round(sum(filesystem_cleanable_tb),2) filesystem_cleanable_tb,

--Last Updated: 08/23/2011
--EMC VMAX Pool subscription by Total,Used,Available,Subscribed,Over Subscribed
WITH q1 AS (
SELECT
pool_name,
sp.dev_config raid_type,

round(total_used_tracks_kb/1024/1024/1024,2) used_tracks,
round((total_tracks_kb-total_used_tracks_kb)/1024/1024/1024,2) avail_tracks,

  ELSE ((total_tracks_kb * (subscribed_pct/100))/1024/1024/1024) - (total_tracks_kb/1024/1024/1024)

array_name = '${queryCombo1}'
AND array_name is not null
)

pool_name,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'Total Capacity',total_tracks,
'Used Capacity',used_tracks,
'Available Capacity',avail_tracks,
'Amount Subscribed',subscribed,
'Amount Over Subscribed',over_subscribed
) metric
FROM q1

title: EMC VNX Individual Pool Capacity Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/13/2016
--Computes the future capacity of an array based on 
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
WITH 
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',10,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
TO_NUMBER('${freeCombo2}') forecast_periods,
'${freeCombo3}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo3}', 'GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t0 AS (--Get all indiviapt_v_dual pools for each period
SELECT 
array_name||' - '||pool_name entity,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
MAX(total_subscribed_capacity_gb) subscribed,
MAX(available_capacity_gb) + MAX(consumed_capacity_gb) capacity,
MAX(consumed_capacity_gb) used,
MAX(available_capacity_gb) available
FROM aps_v_emc_cla_storage_pool_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name||' - '||pool_name = '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY array_name||' - '||pool_name,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
a0 AS (--Aggregate them 
SELECT 
entity,
log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity  ORDER BY entity) row_number,
subscribed,
capacity,
used,
available
FROM t0
ORDER BY entity, log_date
),
a1 AS (
SELECT 
ROWNUM period,
log_date,
subscribed,
capacity,
used,
available,
REGR_SLOPE(available,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) a_slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) a_y_intercept,
REGR_SLOPE(used,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) u_slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(used, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) u_y_intercept
FROM a0
ORDER BY 1,2
),
p0 AS (--Find the last period so you can forecast past it
SELECT 
MAX(period) last_period,
MAX(log_date) last_date
FROM a1
)
SELECT
TO_CHAR(log_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') log_date,
ROUND(subscribed/div_by,2) subscribed,
ROUND(capacity/div_by,2) capacity,
ROUND(available/div_by,2) available,
0 future_available,

title: EMC VNX Total Pool Capacity Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/25/2016
--Computes the future capacity of an array based on 
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
WITH 
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',10,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
TO_NUMBER('${freeCombo2}') forecast_periods,
'${freeCombo3}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo3}', 'GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t0 AS (--Get all indiviapt_v_dual pools for each period
SELECT 
array_name,
emc_cla_storage_pool_id pool_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
MAX(total_subscribed_capacity_gb) subscribed,
MAX(available_capacity_gb) + MAX(consumed_capacity_gb) capacity,
MAX(consumed_capacity_gb) used,
MAX(available_capacity_gb) available
FROM aps_v_emc_cla_storage_pool_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY array_name, emc_cla_storage_pool_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
t1 AS (--Aggregate them at the array level
SELECT 
array_name entity,
log_date,
COUNT(DISTINCT pool_id) nbr_of_pools,
SUM(subscribed) subscribed,
SUM(capacity) capacity,
SUM(used) used,
SUM(available) available
FROM t0
GROUP BY array_name, log_date
ORDER BY array_name, log_date
),
a0 AS (--Aggregate them at the array level
SELECT 
entity,
log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity  ORDER BY entity) row_number,
subscribed,
capacity,
used,
available
FROM t1
ORDER BY entity, log_date
),
a1 AS (
SELECT 
ROWNUM period,
log_date,
subscribed,
capacity,
used,
available,
REGR_SLOPE(available,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) a_slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) a_y_intercept,
REGR_SLOPE(used,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) u_slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(used, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY entity) u_y_intercept
FROM a0
ORDER BY 1,2
),
p0 AS (--Find the last period so you can forecast past it
SELECT 
MAX(period) last_period,
MAX(log_date) last_date
FROM a1
)
SELECT
TO_CHAR(log_date,'MM/DD/YYYY') log_date,
ROUND(subscribed/div_by,2) subscribed,
ROUND(capacity/div_by,2) capacity,
ROUND(available/div_by,2) available,
0 future_available,
ROUND((period*a_slope+a_y_intercept)/div_by,2) a_trend_line,
ROUND(used/div_by,2) used,
0 future_used,
ROUND((period*u_slope+u_y_intercept)/div_by,2) u_trend_line,
unit
FROM a1, p0, d0
UNION ALL --Future
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(the_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'MM/DD/YYYY') log_date,
ROUND(subscribed/div_by,2) subscribed,
ROUND(capacity/div_by,2) capacity,
0 available,
ROUND(((period+ROWNUM)*a_slope+a_y_intercept)/div_by,2) future_available,
ROUND(((period+ROWNUM)*a_slope+a_y_intercept)/div_by,2) a_trend_line,
0 used,
ROUND(((period+ROWNUM)*u_slope+u_y_intercept)/div_by,2) future_used,
ROUND(((period+ROWNUM)*u_slope+u_y_intercept)/div_by,2) u_trend_line,
unit
FROM a1, p0, d0, 
TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_date+d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE period = p0.last_period
AND ROUND((period+ROWNUM)*a_slope+a_y_intercept,2) > 0

sql_query: --failed or no backup for last 3 days WITH t_3 as ( SELECT client_id, min(summary_status) min_status FROM apt_v_job WHERE start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE-3) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE-2) AND client_id IN (${hosts}) GROUP BY client_id ), t_2 as ( SELECT client_id, min(summary_status) min_status FROM apt_v_job WHERE start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE-2) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE-1) AND client_id IN (${hosts}) GROUP BY client_id ), t_1 as ( SELECT client_id, min(summary_status) min_status FROM apt_v_job WHERE start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE-1) AND SYSDATE AND client_id IN (${hosts}) GROUP BY client_id ), ts as ( SELECT s.server_id,s.display_name, DECODE(t_3.min_status,2,'1',null,'0') three_days_ago, DECODE(t_2.min_status,2,'1',null,'0') two_days_ago, DECODE(t_1.min_status,2,'1',null,'0') Last_Night FROM t_3, t_2, t_1, apt_v_server s WHERE s.server_id IN (${hosts}) AND s.server_id=t_3.client_id (+) AND s.server_id=t_2.client_id (+) AND s.server_id=t_1.client_id (+) ) SELECT ''||ts.display_name||'' Client, DECODE ((ts.three_days_ago+ts.two_days_ago+ts.Last_Night), 0,'No backup for 3 days', 2,'2 Failed backups in last 3 days', 3,'Failed backups 3 days in a row', 'No backup at all' ) status FROM ts WHERE (ts.three_days_ago+ts.two_days_ago+ts.Last_Night) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Upper(ts.display_name)

title: HDS DP LUN Perspective Storage
sql_query:
--This takes a pipe separated list of array names and pool numbers as wildcards NOTE: Use * for all 
--EXAMPLE Array(s): USP_12|USP_13 Pool: 1|2|3|4
--or Array(s): USP_12 Pool(s):*
--or Array(s):* Pool(s):*
WITH 
l1 as (--Get all the distinct LUNS
SELECT DISTINCT
hlu.array_name,
hlu.logical_unit_id,
hlu.logical_unit_name,
lu.status,
lu.total_capacity_gb,
hlu.consumed_capacity_gb
FROM aps_v_hds_logical_unit hlu, aps_v_logical_unit lu
WHERE lu.logical_unit_id = hlu.logical_unit_id 
AND hlu.dp_type = 0
AND REGEXP_LIKE(hlu.array_name,'${freeText1}', 'i')
AND REGEXP_LIKE(hlu.dp_pool_id,'${freeText2}', 'i')
),
h1 as (
SELECT 
hlu.array_name,
hlu.logical_unit_id,
hlu.logical_unit_name,
sp.total_capacity_gb,
hlu.consumed_capacity_gb,
count(DISTINCT sp.host_storage_domain) nbr_of_hosts,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT sp.host_storage_domain) hosts
FROM aps_v_storage_path sp, aps_v_hds_logical_unit hlu
WHERE sp.logical_unit_id = hlu.logical_unit_id (+)
AND REGEXP_LIKE(hlu.array_name,'${freeText1}', 'i')
AND REGEXP_LIKE(hlu.dp_pool_id,'${freeText2}', 'i')
AND hlu.dp_type = 0
GROUP BY
hlu.array_name,
hlu.logical_unit_id,
hlu.logical_unit_name,
sp.total_capacity_gb,
hlu.consumed_capacity_gb
)
SELECT
l1.array_name,
l1.logical_unit_name,
l1.status,
l1.total_capacity_gb,
l1.consumed_capacity_gb,
(l1.consumed_capacity_gb/(l1.total_capacity_gb+.0001))*100 pct_consumed,
(l1.consumed_capacity_gb/(l1.total_capacity_gb+.0001)) pct_consumed_bar,
h1.nbr_of_hosts,
CASE WHEN h1.nbr_of_hosts > 1
THEN SUBSTR(h1.hosts, 1 ,INSTR(h1.hosts, ',', 1, 1)-1) 
ELSE h1.hosts
END hosts,
hosts all_hosts
FROM l1,h1
WHERE 
l1.logical_unit_id = h1.logical_unit_id(+)
ORDER BY 1,2
