--Limit the forecasting periods to 48
CASE 
WHEN to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') > 48 THEN 48 
ELSE to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') END forecast_periods
FROM dual
),
a0 AS (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
array_name,
pool_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() over (PARTITION BY array_name, pool_id ORDER BY array_name, pool_id) row_number,
MAX(available_kb/1024/1024) available
FROM aps_v_hds_journal_pool_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${TheArrayName}'
AND pool_id = '${ThePoolID}'
AND pool_function = 5
GROUP BY array_name, pool_id, trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
a1 AS (
SELECT 
ROWNUM period,
log_date,
available,
REGR_SLOPE(available,ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY array_name) slope,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available, ROWNUM) OVER (PARTITION BY array_name) y_intercept
FROM a0
ORDER BY 1
),
p0 AS (--Find the last period so you can forecast past it
SELECT 
MAX(period) last_period,
MAX(log_date) last_date
FROM a1
)
SELECT
log_date,
round(available,2) available,
0 future_available,
period*slope+y_intercept trend_line--Future values can be determined for any period unsing this formula
FROM a1, p0
UNION ALL --Future
SELECT 
TRUNC(the_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 available,
ROUND((period+ROWNUM)*slope+y_intercept,2) future_available,
(period+ROWNUM)*slope+y_intercept trend_line
FROM a1,p0,d0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_date+d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE period = p0.last_period

title: HDS DP Pool Available Capacity POP Forecast.D
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/30/2012
--Computes the future capacity of an array based on 
--a Period over Period forecasting method
--This is a drill down report that can't run stand alone
--TemplateName: HDSDPPoolAvailableCapacityPOPForecast.D
WITH 
d0 AS (--Convert the human readable date selection to numeric values
SELECT
DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
--Limit the forecasting periods to 48
CASE 
WHEN to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') > 48 THEN 48 
ELSE to_number('${TheForecastPeriods}') END forecast_periods,
'${TheGroupBy}' the_group_by --Need this for the drilldown
FROM dual
),
a0 AS (--Get all the capacity merics for each period
SELECT 
storage_array_id,
pool_id,
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id,  pool_id ORDER BY storage_array_id,  pool_id) row_number,
ROUND(MAX(available_kb/1024/1024),2) available
FROM aps_v_hds_journal_pool_log
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${TheArrayName}'
AND pool_id = '${ThePoolID}'
AND pool_function = 5
GROUP BY storage_array_id,pool_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the first and last period number for each array & pool 
SELECT
storage_array_id,
pool_id,
MIN(row_number) first_period_number, --First period will always be 1
MAX(row_number) last_period_number, --Last period is the current period or last time data was collected
min(log_date) first_period_date,
MAX(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY 
storage_array_id,
pool_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the first and last period metrics based on the row number of the periods
SELECT
a0.storage_array_id, a0.pool_id,
MAX(last_period_number) nbr_of_periods,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,first_period_number,a0.available,0)) first_available,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,last_period_number,a0.available,0)) last_available
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = p0.pool_id
GROUP BY a0.storage_array_id, a0.pool_id
),
pop2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Changes
SELECT
storage_array_id, 
pool_id,
first_available,
last_available,
ROUND(last_available - first_available,2) pop_available_delta,
ROUND((last_available - first_available ) / DECODE(nbr_of_periods,0,null,nbr_of_periods),2) pop_available_trend
FROM pop1
) 
SELECT --Plot the prior history
a0.log_date, 
a0.available,
0 future_available,
pop2.last_available - (pop2.pop_available_trend*(period_count-ROWNUM)) available_trend_line
FROM a0, p0, pop2
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = pop2.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = pop2.pool_id
AND a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = p0.pool_id
UNION ALL --Future values
SELECT 
trunc(the_date,DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
0 available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend*ROWNUM) future_available,
pop2.last_available + (pop2.pop_available_trend*ROWNUM) available_trend_line
FROM a0, pop2, d0, p0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(p0.last_period_date+d0.nbr_of_days,p0.last_period_date+(d0.forecast_periods*d0.nbr_of_days),DECODE('${TheGroupBy}','Day',11,'Week',12,'Month',13,'Quarter',14,'Year',15))) the_dates
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = pop2.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = pop2.pool_id
AND a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = p0.pool_id
AND a0.row_number = p0.period_count --Only need the last row
ORDER BY 1

title: HDS DP Pool Multi-Metric Available Capacity Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/31/2012
--Computes the future capacity of HDS DP Pools based on 3 different methods
--Linear Regression (Linear) Sum of squares linear algorithm y=mX+b
--Period Over Period (POP) ((last period - first period) / nbr of periods) + last period...
--First period goes back as far back as data collection began and last period is 
--the current array capacity of the last time data collection occurred. 
WITH 
d0 AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day',1,'Week',7,'Month',31,'Quarter',93,'Year',365.24) nbr_of_days,
'${freeCombo1}' the_group_by
FROM apt_v_dual
),
a0 as (
SELECT 
storage_array_id,

pool_id,
trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
row_number() over (partition by storage_array_id,  pool_id order by storage_array_id, pool_id) row_number,
max(capacity_kb/1024/1024) capacity,
max(allocated_kb/1024/1024) allocated,
max(unallocated_kb/1024/1024) unallocated,
max(available_kb/1024/1024) available,
max(capacity_of_vvols_kb/1024/1024) capacity_of_vvols,
max(touched_kb/1024/1024) touched,
max(associated_warn_kb/1024/1024) associated_warn,
max(allocated_warn_kb/1024/1024) allocated_warn
FROM aps_v_hds_journal_pool_log 
WHERE log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = DECODE('${queryCombo1}', ' All',array_name, '${queryCombo1}')
AND pool_function = 5
GROUP BY storage_array_id,pool_id,trunc(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
p0 AS (--Get the first and last period number for each array & pool 
SELECT
storage_array_id,

pool_id,
MIN(row_number) first_period_number, --First period will always be 1
MAX(row_number) last_period_number, --Last period is the current period or last time data was collected
min(log_date) first_period_date,
max(log_date) last_period_date,
COUNT(log_date) period_count
FROM a0
GROUP BY 
storage_array_id,

pool_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the first and last period metrics based on the row number of the periods
SELECT
a0.storage_array_id, a0.pool_id,
MAX(last_period_number) nbr_of_periods,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,first_period_number,a0.available,0)) first_available,
SUM(DECODE(a0.row_number,last_period_number,a0.available,0)) last_available
FROM a0,p0
WHERE a0.storage_array_id = p0.storage_array_id
AND a0.pool_id = p0.pool_id
GROUP BY a0.storage_array_id, a0.pool_id
),
pop2 AS (--Calculate the Period Over Period Changes
SELECT
storage_array_id, 

pool_id,
first_available,
last_available,
ROUND(last_available - first_available,2) pop_available_delta,
ROUND((last_available - first_available ) / DECODE(nbr_of_periods,0,null,nbr_of_periods),2) pop_available_trend
FROM pop1
),
lin1 AS (--Get the Linear Growth statistics
SELECT 
a0.storage_array_id,
a0.pool_id,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(available,row_number),2) linear_trend,
REGR_R2(available,row_number) r2_value,
REGR_AVGX(available,row_number) avex,
REGR_AVGY(available,row_number)  avey,
REGR_INTERCEPT(available,row_number) y_intercept,
REGR_COUNT(available,row_number) period_count,
STDDEV(available)  stddev
FROM a0
GROUP BY storage_array_id,  pool_id
)
SELECT 
pop1.storage_array_id,
sa.array_name,
pop1.pool_id,
pop2.first_available,
pop2.last_available,
lin1.avey average_available,
period_count,
--
pop_available_trend,
linear_trend,
--
CASE 
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN null
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0  THEN null
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0  THEN round(pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(pop_available_trend),0,null,abs(pop_available_trend)),0) 
ELSE NULL
END pop_periods_left,
CASE 
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN null
WHEN linear_trend > 0  THEN null
WHEN linear_trend < 0  THEN round(pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(linear_trend),0,null,abs(linear_trend)),0) 
ELSE NULL
END linear_periods_left,
r2_value*100 r2_value,
lin1.y_intercept,
CASE
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'red'
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'white'
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'green'
END pop_status,
CASE
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Decreasing by '||abs(pop_available_trend)||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Staying Flat '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Increasing by '||pop_available_trend||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
END pop_status_name,
CASE 
WHEN pop1.last_available <= 0 THEN 'Already out of capacity'
WHEN pop_available_trend = 0 THEN 'Not changing'
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN 'Not enough data to calculate'
WHEN pop_available_trend > 0 THEN 'Available capacity increased'
WHEN pop_available_trend < 0 THEN 'Will run out on:'|| to_char(sysdate+(d0.nbr_of_days*pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(pop_available_trend),0,null,abs(pop_available_trend))),'MM/DD/YYYY')
END pop_date_of_concern,
CASE
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'red'
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'white'
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'green'
END linear_status,
CASE
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Decreasing by '||abs(linear_trend)||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Staying Flat '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'Available Capacity Increasing by '||linear_trend||'(GB) '||the_group_by||' Over '||the_group_by
END linear_status_name,
CASE 
WHEN pop1.last_available <= 0 THEN 'Already out of capacity'
WHEN linear_trend = 0 THEN 'Not changing'
WHEN period_count < 3 THEN 'Not enough data to calculate'
WHEN linear_trend > 0 THEN 'Available capacity increased'
WHEN linear_trend < 0 THEN 'Will run out on:'|| to_char(sysdate+(d0.nbr_of_days*pop1.last_available/DECODE(abs(linear_trend),0,null,abs(linear_trend))),'MM/DD/YYYY')
END linear_date_of_concern,
d0.nbr_of_days, 
d0.the_group_by
FROM  d0, lin1, pop1, pop2, aps_v_storage_array sa
WHERE
pop1.storage_array_id = sa.storage_array_id
AND pop1.storage_array_id = pop2.storage_array_id
AND pop1.pool_id = pop2.pool_id
AND pop1.storage_array_id = lin1.storage_array_id
AND pop1.pool_id = lin1.pool_id

title: HDS DP Pool Usage History Single Array
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 02/22/2018
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
a0 AS (--Get the indiviapt_v_dual pools then add them up in the end 
SELECT
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Hour','HH24','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year')) log_date,
array_name,
pool_id,
ROUND(MAX(allocated_kb/div_by),2) allocated,
ROUND(MAX(unallocated_kb/div_by),2) unallocated,
ROUND(MAX(available_kb/div_by),2) available,
ROUND(MAX(capacity_kb/div_by),2) capacity,
ROUND(MAX(capacity_of_vvols_kb/div_by),2) capacity_of_vvols,
ROUND(MAX(touched_kb/div_by),2) touched,
ROUND(MAX(associated_warn_kb/div_by),2) associated_warn,
ROUND(MAX(allocated_warn_kb/div_by),2) allocated_warn
FROM 
aps_v_hds_journal_pool_log, var
WHERE 
log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND array_name = '${queryCombo1}'
AND array_name is not null
GROUP BY 
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Hour','HH24','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year')),
array_name,
pool_id
HAVING MAX(allocated_kb) > 0
)
SELECT 
log_date,
SUM(a0.allocated) allocated,

SUM(a0.capacity) capacity,
SUM(a0.capacity_of_vvols) capacity_of_vvols, 
SUM(a0.touched) touched,
SUM(a0.available) available,
SUM(a0.touched + a0.available) associated,
SUM(a0.associated_warn) associated_warn,
SUM(a0.allocated_warn) allocated_warn
FROM 
a0
GROUP BY
log_date
ORDER BY 
log_date ASC

title: HDS DP Pool Usage Report
sql_query:
--Author:rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 09/10/2015
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, 
${startDate} startDate, 
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
)
SELECT
storage_array_id,
array_name,
pool_id,
NVL(pool_name,'DP '||pool_id) pool_name, 
capacity_kb/div_by capacity,
free_capacity_kb/div_by free_capacity,
(capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/div_by touched,
ROUND((capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb*100) pct_touched,
(capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb touched_pct,
threshold,
CASE WHEN ((capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb*100) >= threshold THEN 'red' ELSE 'green' END t1_dot,
CASE WHEN ((capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb*100) >= threshold THEN 'Exceeds' ELSE 'Less Than' END t1_message,
threshold2,
CASE WHEN ((capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb*100) >= threshold2 THEN 'red' ELSE 'green' END t2_dot,
CASE WHEN ((capacity_kb - free_capacity_kb)/capacity_kb*100) >= threshold2 THEN 'Exceeds' ELSE 'Less Than' END t2_message,
capacity_of_vvols_kb/div_by capacity_of_vvols,
((capacity_kb-capacity_of_vvols_kb)/div_by)*-1 provisioned,
CASE WHEN (capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100) > 100 
THEN '<font color=red>'||ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100))||'%'
ELSE '<font color=green>'||ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100))||'%'
END prov_pct,
--usage_rate,
DECODE(threshold_vol_forewarn,-1,null,threshold_vol_forewarn) threshold_vol_forewarn,
CASE 
WHEN threshold_vol_forewarn = -1 THEN 'white'
WHEN ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100)) >= threshold_vol_forewarn THEN 'red' 
WHEN ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100)) BETWEEN 0 AND threshold_vol_forewarn THEN 'green' 
ELSE 'blue' END fore_dot,
DECODE(threshold_vol_overwarn,-1,null,threshold_vol_overwarn) threshold_vol_overwarn,
CASE 
WHEN threshold_vol_overwarn = -1 THEN 'white'
WHEN ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100)) >= threshold_vol_overwarn THEN 'red' 
WHEN ROUND((capacity_of_vvols_kb/capacity_kb*100)) BETWEEN 0 AND threshold_vol_overwarn THEN 'green' 
ELSE 'blue' END over_dot
FROM aps_v_hds_journal_pool, var
WHERE array_name LIKE DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All','%','${queryCombo1}')
AND array_name IS NOT NULL
AND capacity_of_vvols_kb > 0

title: HDS Dynamic Tiering Individual LDEV Comparisons
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 09/28/2017
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, 
${startDate} startDate, 
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
ll.storage_array_id,
ll.array_name,
ll.ldev_id,
l.label,
TRUNC(ll.log_date,'HH24') the_date,
MAX(ll.dp_tier0_consumed_kb/div_by) max_tier0,
MAX(ll.dp_tier1_consumed_kb/div_by) max_tier1,
MAX(ll.dp_tier2_consumed_kb/div_by) max_tier2
FROM aps_v_hds_ldev_log ll, aps_v_hds_ldev l, var
WHERE 
ll.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
AND ll.ldev_id = l.ldev_id
AND ll.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND ll.dp_tier0_consumed_kb+ll.dp_tier2_consumed_kb+ll.dp_tier2_consumed_kb > 0
GROUP BY
ll.storage_array_id,
ll.array_name,
ll.ldev_id,
l.label,
TRUNC(ll.log_date,'HH24')
ORDER BY 1
),
t2 AS (--Get the values of the first and last periods to caclulate deltas
SELECT DISTINCT
storage_array_id,
ldev_id,
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier0) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_tier0, 
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier0) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_tier0,
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier1) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_tier1, 
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier1) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_tier1,
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier2) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_tier2, 
FIRST_VALUE(max_tier2) OVER (PARTITION BY storage_array_id, ldev_id ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_tier2
FROM T1
),
t3 AS (--Build the sparlines 
SELECT 
storage_array_id,
array_name,
ldev_id,
label,
MIN(the_date) first_sample,
MAX(the_date) last_sample,
COUNT(the_date) sample_count,
MAX(max_tier0) max_tier0,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(max_tier0,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') spk_tier0,
MAX(max_tier1) max_tier1,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(max_tier1,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') spk_tier1,
MAX(max_tier2) max_tier2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(max_tier2,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') spk_tier2
FROM t1
GROUP BY
storage_array_id,
array_name,
ldev_id,
label
)
SELECT
t3.storage_array_id,
t3.array_name,
t3.ldev_id,
t3.label,
t3.first_sample,
t3.last_sample,
t3.sample_count,
--Tier 0
t3.max_tier0,
t2.first_tier0,
t2.last_tier0,
t2.first_tier0 - t2.last_tier0 delta_t0,
t3.spk_tier0,
--Tier 1
t3.max_tier1,
t2.first_tier1,
t2.last_tier1,
t2.first_tier1 - t2.last_tier1 delta_t1,
t3.spk_tier1,
--Tier 2
t3.max_tier2,
t2.first_tier2,
t2.last_tier2,
t2.first_tier2 - t2.last_tier2 delta_t2,
t3.spk_tier2
FROM 
t2, t3
WHERE 
t2.storage_array_id = t3.storage_array_id
AND t2.ldev_id = t3.ldev_id
AND (ABS(ROUND(t2.first_tier0)-ROUND(t2.last_tier0)) > DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Only LDEVs that changed',0, -1))
ORDER BY 
ABS(t2.first_tier0 - t2.last_tier0) DESC

title: HDS HNAS Filesystem Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 10/18/2017
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting HNAS File System Available Capacity
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.hnas_storage_system_id the_id_1, 
l.hnas_file_system_id the_id_2,
MAX(l.available_capacity_kb/div_by) the_value
FROM
aps_v_hnas_file_system_log l, var
WHERE l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.hnas_storage_system_id IN (${arrays})
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.hnas_storage_system_id, 
l.hnas_file_system_id
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) the_value_lin,
(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
ROUND(f2.first_value,2) first_value, 
f2.last_date,
ROUND(f2.last_value,2) last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
ROUND(f2.the_value_lin,2) the_value_lin,
ROUND(f2.sum_of_the_value,2) sum_of_the_value,
(f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) days_left_lin,
CASE 
WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0
THEN
  CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
    THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
    THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
  END
WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
(f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) days_left_pop,
CASE 
WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0
THEN
  CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
    THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
    WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
    THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
  END
WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
)
SELECT
f3.the_id_1,
a.array_name,
f3.the_id_2,
f.span_instance_name||' - '||f.instance_name filesystem_name,
s1.the_spk,
ROUND(f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0),2) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Did Not Change'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, aps_v_hnas_storage_system a,aps_v_hnas_file_system f
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = a.hnas_storage_system_id
AND f3.the_id_2 = f.hnas_file_system_id
ORDER BY 
a.array_name,
f3.the_id_2

title: HDS LUNs External to Storage Arrays
sql_query:
--Author: paul.hogan@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 09/15/2011
--This report shows the array and LUNs that are external to the array that is virtualizing them.
SELECT a.logical_unit_id,
  a.logical_unit_name,
  a.array_name,
  b.array_name ext_array_name,
  b.group_name ext_raid_group,
  b.open_allocated_capacity_gb ext_group_capacity_gb,
  b.disk_size_gb ext_disk_size_gb,
  b.raid_type ext_raid_type
FROM
  (SELECT a.logical_unit_id,
    a.logical_unit_name,
    a.array_name,
    a.external_serial_nbr,
    a.external_device_nbr,
    b.array_group_id,
    b.ldev_id
  FROM
    (SELECT c.logical_unit_id,
      c.logical_unit_name,
      b.array_name,
      b.external_serial_nbr,
      b.external_device_nbr
    FROM aps_v_hds_ldev a,
      aps_v_hds_virtual_volume b,
      aps_v_hds_logical_unit c
    WHERE a.ldev_id = b.ldev_id
    AND c.logical_unit_id=a.logical_unit_id
    ) a,
    aps_v_hds_ldev b,
    aps_v_hds_storage_array c
  WHERE a.external_device_nbr = b.device_nbr
  AND c.serial_nbr = a.external_serial_nbr
  AND c.storage_array_id = b.storage_array_id
  ) a,
  aps_v_hds_array_group b
WHERE a.array_group_id = b.array_group_id
AND a.array_name LIKE DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All','%','${queryCombo1}')
ORDER BY a.logical_unit_name,
  b.storage_array_id

title: HDS LUSE Detail by Array
sql_query:
--Author:paul.hogan@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 10/4/2012
--This will list all LDEV's that make up all LUSE's within an array
SELECT   a.logical_unit_id,
  a.logical_unit_name,
  c.device_nbr,
         c.array_name, 
         c.capacity_gb ldev_capacity_gb, 
         c.raid_type, 
         c.array_group_name, 
         a.dp_type, 
         a.dp_pool_id, 
         case when a.logical_unit_name=substr(logical_unit_name,0,3)||regexp_replace(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)||nvl(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-1,1),'0'),' ','0') then b.luse_capacity_gb else null end luse_capacity_gb,
         case when a.logical_unit_name=substr(logical_unit_name,0,3)||regexp_replace(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)||nvl(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-1,1),'0'),' ','0') then c.path_exists else null end allocated,
         --c.path_exists allocated, 
         case when a.logical_unit_name=substr(logical_unit_name,0,3)||regexp_replace(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)||nvl(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-1,1),'0'),' ','0') then logical_unit_name else null end luse_head, 
         case when a.logical_unit_name<>substr(logical_unit_name,0,3)||regexp_replace(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)||nvl(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-1,1),'0'),' ','0') then logical_unit_name else null end luse_sub,
         substr(logical_unit_name,0,3)||regexp_replace(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)||nvl(substr(to_char(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-1,1),'0'),' ','0') ldev

FROM     (SELECT * FROM aps_v_hds_ldev WHERE logical_unit_id IN ( SELECT logical_unit_id FROM aps_v_hds_ldev 
         GROUP BY logical_unit_id HAVING (COUNT(logical_unit_id ) > 1))) c, 
         
         (SELECT SUM(c.capacity_gb) luse_capacity_gb, a.logical_unit_id FROM (SELECT * FROM aps_v_hds_ldev WHERE logical_unit_id IN (SELECT logical_unit_id FROM aps_v_hds_ldev GROUP BY logical_unit_id HAVING (COUNT(logical_unit_id ) > 1))) c,
  aps_v_hds_logical_unit a WHERE c.logical_unit_id=a.logical_unit_id GROUP BY a.logical_unit_id) b,
         
         aps_v_hds_logical_unit a
         
WHERE    c.logical_unit_id=a.logical_unit_id 
AND c.logical_unit_id=b.logical_unit_id
AND a.array_name = DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All',a.array_name,'${queryCombo1}')
ORDER BY luse_head

title: HDS LUSE Summary by Array
sql_query:
--Author:paul.hogan@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 10/4/2012
--This will list all LDEV's that make up a LUSE
WITH t1 AS
  (SELECT a.logical_unit_id,
    a.logical_unit_name,
    a.storage_array_id,
    c.device_nbr,
    c.array_name,
    c.capacity_gb ldev_capacity_gb,
    c.raid_type,
    c.array_group_name,
    a.dp_type,
    a.dp_pool_id,
    CASE
      WHEN a.logical_unit_name=SUBSTR(logical_unit_name,0,3)
        ||regexp_replace(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)
        ||NVL(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),           -1,1),'0'),' ','0')
      THEN b.luse_capacity_gb
      ELSE NULL
    END luse_capacity_gb,
    CASE
      WHEN a.logical_unit_name=SUBSTR(logical_unit_name,0,3)
        ||regexp_replace(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)
        ||NVL(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),           -1,1),'0'),' ','0')
      THEN c.path_exists
      ELSE NULL
    END allocated,
    --c.path_exists allocated,
    CASE
      WHEN a.logical_unit_name=SUBSTR(logical_unit_name,0,3)
        ||regexp_replace(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)
        ||NVL(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),           -1,1),'0'),' ','0')
      THEN logical_unit_name
      ELSE NULL
    END luse_head,
    CASE
      WHEN a.logical_unit_name<>SUBSTR(logical_unit_name,0,3)
        ||regexp_replace(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)
        ||NVL(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),           -1,1),'0'),' ','0')
      THEN logical_unit_name
      ELSE NULL
    END luse_sub,
    SUBSTR(logical_unit_name,0,3)
    ||regexp_replace(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),-2,1)
    ||NVL(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(c.device_nbr,'XXXX'),           -1,1),'0'),' ','0') ldev
  FROM
    (SELECT *
    FROM aps_v_hds_ldev
    WHERE logical_unit_id IN
      (SELECT logical_unit_id
      FROM aps_v_hds_ldev
      GROUP BY logical_unit_id
      HAVING (COUNT(logical_unit_id ) > 1)
      )
    ) c,
    (SELECT SUM(c.capacity_gb) luse_capacity_gb,
      a.logical_unit_id
    FROM
      (SELECT *
      FROM aps_v_hds_ldev
      WHERE logical_unit_id IN
        (SELECT logical_unit_id
        FROM aps_v_hds_ldev
        GROUP BY logical_unit_id
        HAVING (COUNT(logical_unit_id ) > 1)
        )
      ) c,
      aps_v_hds_logical_unit a
    WHERE c.logical_unit_id=a.logical_unit_id
    GROUP BY a.logical_unit_id
    ) b,
    aps_v_hds_logical_unit a
  WHERE c.logical_unit_id=a.logical_unit_id
  AND c.logical_unit_id  =b.logical_unit_id
  )
SELECT array_name,
  logical_unit_name,
  SUM(ldev_capacity_gb) luse_capacity_gb,
  REPLACE(aptStringConcat(DISTINCT ldev),'+',',') ldev_list
FROM t1
WHERE array_name = DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All',array_name,'${queryCombo1}')
GROUP BY array_name,
  logical_unit_name

title: HP 3Par LUNs with DeDup Storage Savings Distribution by Ratio
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified 09/20/2018
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'GB',(1),'TB',(1024),'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT 
h3p_storage_system_id,
system_name,
tier1_dsp_name,
tier2_dsp_name,
tier3_dsp_name,
snap_dsp_name,
user_dsp_name,
logical_unit_id,
logical_unit_name,
(NVL(tier1_user_kb,0)+NVL(tier2_user_kb,0)+NVL(tier3_user_kb,0))/1024/1024 t1t2t3_user_gb,
--
ROUND(NVL(dedup_ratio,1),1) dedup_ratio_num,
ROUND(NVL(dedup_ratio,1),1)||':1' dedup_ratio,
CEIL(DECODE(dedup_ratio,NULL,1,0,1,dedup_ratio))||':1' dedup_ratio_norm,
--
ROUND(NVL(compression_ratio,1),1) compression_ratio_num,
ROUND(NVL(compression_ratio,1),1)||':1' compression_ratio,
CEIL(DECODE(compression_ratio,NULL,1,0,1,compression_ratio))||':1' compression_ratio_norm,
--
ROUND(NVL(compaction_ratio,1),1) compaction_ratio_num,
ROUND(NVL(compaction_ratio,1),1)||':1' compaction_ratio,
CEIL(DECODE(compaction_ratio,NULL,1,0,1,compaction_ratio))||':1' compaction_ratio_norm,
--
total_capacity_gb,
raw_admin_gb,
raw_copy_gb,
raw_user_gb,
raw_blocks_gb,
consumable_admin_gb,
consumable_copy_gb,
consumable_user_gb,
used_snapshot_admin_space_gb,
used_snapshot_data_space_gb,
used_user_space_gb,
--
tier1_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier1_admin,
tier2_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier2_admin,
tier3_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier3_admin,
--
tier1_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier1_snapshot,
tier2_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier2_snapshot,
tier3_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier3_snapshot,
--
tier1_user_kb/1024/1024 tier1_user,
tier2_user_kb/1024/1024 tier2_user,
tier3_user_kb/1024/1024 tier3_user,
date_created,
master_node,
backup_node1,
backup_node2,
lun_policy,
preferred_availability,
current_availability,
export_state,
disk_device_type,
snap_space_allocation_warning,
snap_space_allocation_limit,
user_space_allocation_warning,
user_space_allocation_limit,
lun_domain,
set_size,
set_data,
expiration_time,
retention_time,
lun_operational_status||' - '||lun_other_operational_status lun_operational_status,
volume_type,
lun_access,
is_underlying_redundancy,
data_redundancy,
package_redundancy,
name_format,
name_space,
is_thinly_provisioned,
device_nbr,
object_id,
usr_array_group_id,
snp_array_group_id,
vcopy_base_logical_unit_id,
tier1_array_group_id,
tier2_array_group_id,
tier3_array_group_id,
--
tier1_new_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier1_new_admin,
tier2_new_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier2_new_admin,
tier3_new_admin_kb/1024/1024 tier3_new_admin,
--
tier1_new_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier1_new_snapshot,
tier2_new_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier2_new_snapshot,
tier3_new_snapshot_kb/1024/1024 tier3_new_snapshot,
--
tier1_new_user_kb/1024/1024 tier1_new_user,
tier2_new_user_kb/1024/1024 tier2_new_user,
tier3_new_user_kb/1024/1024 tier3_new_user,
--
is_compression_enabled,
is_dedup_enabled,
--compaction_ratio_str,
--compression_ratio_str,
--dedup_ratio_str,
last_updated
FROM
  aps_v_h3p_logical_unit
WHERE 
h3p_storage_system_id IN (${arrays})
AND is_dedup_enabled = 'Yes'
AND ROUND(NVL(dedup_ratio,1),1) > 1
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
system_name,
user_dsp_name,
logical_unit_id,
logical_unit_name,
dedup_ratio_norm,
used_user_space_gb,
used_user_space_gb * dedup_ratio_num AS actual_size_needed_gb,

((used_user_space_gb * dedup_ratio_num) - used_user_space_gb ) * ${freeText1} AS actual_savings_money
FROM t1
)
SELECT
dedup_ratio_norm,
COUNT(DISTINCT logical_unit_id) lun_count,
ROUND(SUM(used_user_space_gb/div_by),2) used_user_space,
ROUND(SUM(actual_size_needed_gb/div_by),2) actual_size_needed,
ROUND(SUM(actual_savings_gb/div_by),2) actual_savings,
SUM(actual_savings_money) actual_savings_money
FROM t2, var
GROUP BY
dedup_ratio_norm

title: HP Data Protector Session Status Summary
sql_query:
--Author:rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 11/02/2015
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, 
${startDate} startDate, 
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
hj.session_id,
hj.session_name,
MIN(hj.start_date) started,
MAX(finish_date) ended,
COUNT(DISTINCT hj.client_id) clients,
SUM(kilobytes/div_by) job_size,
COUNT(hj.job_id) total_jobs,
SUM(DECODE(hj.summary_status,0,1,0)) success,
SUM(DECODE(hj.summary_status,1,1,0)) partial,
SUM(DECODE(hj.summary_status,2,1,0)) failed,
SUM(DECODE(hj.summary_status,null,1,0)) incomplete,
SUM(DECODE(hj.vendor_status,5,1,0)) running,
SUM(DECODE(hj.vendor_status,6,1,0)) pending
FROM apt_v_hpd_job hj, var
WHERE
hj.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND hj.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
hj.session_id,
hj.session_name
)
SELECT
session_id,
session_name,
started,
ended,
clients,
job_size,
total_jobs,
success,
partial,
failed,
failed/DECODE((total_jobs - incomplete),0,null,(total_jobs - incomplete)) pct_fail,
failed/DECODE((total_jobs - incomplete),0,null,(total_jobs - incomplete))*100 fail_pct,
incomplete,
running,
pending,
incomplete/DECODE(total_jobs,0,null,total_jobs) pct_incomplete,
incomplete/DECODE(total_jobs,0,null,total_jobs)*100 incomplete_pct
FROM t1
ORDER BY 
started DESC

title: HPE 3PAR Chunklet Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 08/20/2018
--Forecasting Framework
--Plots the Chunklet Normal Unused Free Capacity (CNUF) of HP 3Par Arrays
--The chunklets are given out to Logical Drive (LD) Capacity as needed 
--based on thresholds.  
--HP 3Par Free Capacity = (CNUF + LD Capacity) - LD Used
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting HP 3Par Usage over time
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.h3p_storage_system_id the_id_1,
0 the_id_2,
MAX(l.chunk_normal_unused_free_gb/div_by) the_value
FROM
aps_v_h3p_storage_system_log l, var
WHERE
l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.h3p_storage_system_id IN (${arrays})  
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.h3p_storage_system_id
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC),2) first_value, 
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC),2) last_value,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0),2) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
f2.first_value, 
f2.last_date,
f2.last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
f2.the_value_lin,
f2.sum_of_the_value,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_lin,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
--
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_pop,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2, var
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
t1 AS (--Format the final Output
SELECT
f3.the_id_1,
s.array_name,
f3.the_id_2,
s1.the_spk,
f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Not Changed'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, aps_v_storage_array s
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = s.storage_array_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM t1
WHERE 
usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}')
AND nbr_of_days >= ${freeCombo3}
ORDER BY NVL(days_left_pop,0) ASC

title: HPE 3PAR Host Virtual Volume Tiered Storage
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 08/08/2017
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays,
${startDate} startDate,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
), 
lu AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
hlu.H3P_STORAGE_SYSTEM_ID
, hlu.SYSTEM_NAME
, hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_NAME
,(NVL(hlu.TIER1_USER_KB,0)+NVL(hlu.TIER2_USER_KB,0)+NVL(hlu.TIER3_USER_KB,0)) total_user_kb
FROM
APS_V_H3P_LOGICAL_UNIT hlu
WHERE
(NVL(hlu.TIER1_USER_KB,0)+NVL(hlu.TIER2_USER_KB,0)+NVL(hlu.TIER3_USER_KB,0)) > 0
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, hlu.TIER1_DSP_NAME 
, hlu.TIER1_ADMIN_KB 
, hlu.TIER1_USER_KB 
, hlu.TIER1_SNAPSHOT_KB 
FROM
APS_V_H3P_LOGICAL_UNIT hlu
),
t2 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_NAME
, hlu.TIER2_DSP_NAME 
, hlu.TIER2_ADMIN_KB 
, hlu.TIER2_USER_KB 
, hlu.TIER2_SNAPSHOT_KB 
FROM
APS_V_H3P_LOGICAL_UNIT hlu
),
t3 AS (
SELECT
hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, hlu.LOGICAL_UNIT_NAME
, hlu.TIER3_DSP_NAME 
, hlu.TIER3_ADMIN_KB 
, hlu.TIER3_USER_KB 
, hlu.TIER3_SNAPSHOT_KB 
FROM
APS_V_H3P_LOGICAL_UNIT hlu
), 
t4 AS (
SELECT  
lu.H3P_STORAGE_SYSTEM_ID
, lu.SYSTEM_NAME
, h.host_id
, h.host_name
, lu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, lu.LOGICAL_UNIT_NAME
, t1.TIER1_DSP_NAME 
, lu.total_user_kb/div_by total_user
, t1.TIER1_ADMIN_KB/div_by  tier1_admin
, t1.TIER1_USER_KB/div_by tier1_user
, t1.tier1_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb t1_user_pct_bar
, t1.tier1_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb*100 t1_user_pct
, t1.TIER1_SNAPSHOT_KB/div_by teir1_snapshot
, t2.TIER2_DSP_NAME 
, t2.TIER2_ADMIN_KB/div_by tier2_admin
, t2.TIER2_USER_KB/div_by tier2_user
, t2.tier2_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb t2_user_pct_bar
, t2.tier2_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb*100 t2_user_pct
, t2.TIER2_SNAPSHOT_KB/div_by tier2_snapshot
, t3.TIER3_DSP_NAME 
, t3.TIER3_ADMIN_KB/div_by tier3_admin
, t3.TIER3_USER_KB/div_by tier3_user
, t3.tier3_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb t3_user_pct_bar
, t3.tier3_user_kb/lu.total_user_kb*100 t3_user_pct
, t3.TIER3_SNAPSHOT_KB/div_by tier3_snapshot
FROM var, lu, t1, t2, t3, aps_v_storage_path sp, aps_v_host h
WHERE
lu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID = t1.logical_unit_id (+)
AND lu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID = t2.logical_unit_id (+)
AND lu.LOGICAL_UNIT_ID = t3.logical_unit_id (+)
AND lu.logical_unit_id = sp.logical_unit_id
AND sp.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND sp.host_id = h.host_id (+)
ORDER BY h.host_name
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
H3P_STORAGE_SYSTEM_ID
, SYSTEM_NAME
, host_id
, host_name
, LOGICAL_UNIT_ID
, LOGICAL_UNIT_NAME
, TIER1_DSP_NAME 
, total_user
, tier1_user
, t1_user_pct_bar
, t1_user_pct
, TIER2_DSP_NAME 
, tier2_user
, t2_user_pct_bar
, t2_user_pct
, TIER3_DSP_NAME 
, tier3_user
, t3_user_pct_bar
, t3_user_pct
FROM t4
ORDER BY host_name

sql_query:

),

),

),

t1.a_host_id,

t1.related_host_ids,
lu.storage_array_id,
lu.array_name,

lu.total_capacity_kb/div_by lun_capacity,
t1.related_host_names related_host_names

host_id,
'Array WWN '||sp.array_port_wwn||' - Host WWN '||sp.host_port_wwn||'Unknown' host_name,
'N' is_esx,
0 related_host_ids,
lu.storage_array_id,
lu.array_name,
lu.logical_unit_id lun,
lu.logical_unit_name lun_name,
lu.total_capacity_kb/div_by lun_capacity,
NULL related_host_names

AND lu.logical_unit_id = sp.logical_unit_id (+)

2,6

array_name,

title: Host Filesystem 90 Day Usage
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 03/01/2012
--Used to determine which filesystems are fluctuating the most over their  
--90 day average usage.
SELECT DISTINCT 
f.host_id,
f.host_name, 
f.mount_point, 
f.file_system_name,
f.storage_type, 
f.volume_group_name,
f.filesystem_capacity_kb/1024/1024 filesystem_capacity_gb,
f.filesystem_used_kb/1024/1024 filesystem_used_gb,
(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)/1024/1024 filesystem_available_gb,
round((f.filesystem_used_kb-fs.used_90day_avg)/f.filesystem_used_kb*100,2) used_90day_delta_avg,
round((f.filesystem_used_kb-fs.used_90day_max)/f.filesystem_used_kb*100,2) used_90day_delta_max,
fs.capacity_90day_avg/1024/1024 capacity_90day_avg,
fs.capacity_90day_max/1024/1024 capacity_90day_max,
fs.capacity_90day_min/1024/1024 capacity_90day_min,
fs.used_90day_avg/1024/1024 used_90day_avg,
fs.used_90day_max/1024/1024 used_90day_max,
fs.used_90day_min/1024/1024 used_90day_min
FROM aps_v_file_system_path f, aps_v_file_system_stat fs
WHERE f.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND f.filesystem_id=fs.filesystem_id
AND f.storage_type LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','SAN','S','DAS','D','All','%')
ORDER BY f.host_name, f.file_system_name

title: Host Filesystem Growth Period Over Period
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/03/2012
--Filesystem Pct Used over time
--
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT 
(${endDate} - ${startDate}) num_day,
${startDate} start_date,
${endDate} end_date,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','SAN','S','DAS','D','NAS','N','All','%') fs_storage_type 
FROM dual
),
c0 AS (
SELECT 
fsp.host_id,
fsp.filesystem_id, 
avg(fsl.used_kb)/1024/1024 current_used_gb,
avg(fsl.capacity_kb)/1024/1024 current_capacity_gb
FROM aps_v_file_system_path fsp, aps_v_file_system_log fsl,var
WHERE
fsp.filesystem_id = fsl.filesystem_id
AND fsl.log_date BETWEEN var.start_date AND var.end_date
AND fsp.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND fsp.storage_type LIKE var.fs_storage_type
GROUP BY fsp.host_id, fsp.filesystem_id
),
c1 AS (
SELECT 
host_id, 
count(filesystem_id) nbr_of_filesystems_current,
sum(current_used_gb) current_used_gb,
sum(current_capacity_gb) current_capacity_gb
FROM c0
GROUP BY host_id
),
p0 AS (
SELECT 
fsp.host_id,
fsp.filesystem_id, 
avg(fsl.used_kb)/1024/1024 prior_used_gb,
avg(fsl.capacity_kb)/1024/1024 prior_capacity_gb
FROM aps_v_file_system_path fsp, aps_v_file_system_log fsl,var
WHERE
fsp.filesystem_id = fsl.filesystem_id
AND log_date BETWEEN start_date - var.num_day AND start_date
AND fsp.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND fsp.storage_type LIKE var.fs_storage_type
GROUP BY fsp.host_id, fsp.filesystem_id
),
p1 AS (
SELECT 
host_id, 
count(filesystem_id) nbr_of_filesystems_prior,
sum(prior_used_gb) prior_used_gb,
sum(prior_capacity_gb) prior_capacity_gb
FROM p0
GROUP BY host_id
),
t0 AS (
SELECT 
c1.host_id,
p1.nbr_of_filesystems_prior, 
c1.nbr_of_filesystems_current, 
p1.prior_used_gb, c1.current_used_gb, 
(c1.current_used_gb- p1.prior_used_gb) delta_used,
p1.prior_used_gb/p1.prior_capacity_gb*100 prior_used_pct,
c1.current_used_gb/c1.current_capacity_gb*100 current_used_pct,
(c1.current_used_gb/c1.current_capacity_gb*100) - (p1.prior_used_gb/p1.prior_capacity_gb*100) 
delta_used_pct,
(c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day daily_growth,
((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)*180 needed_in_180_days,
((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)*365 needed_in_365_days,
((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)*365 needed_in_1096_days,
p1.prior_capacity_gb,
c1.current_capacity_gb,
(p1.prior_capacity_gb-p1.prior_used_gb) prior_avail_gb,
(c1.current_capacity_gb-c1.current_used_gb) current_avail_gb,
((c1.current_capacity_gb-c1.current_used_gb)*.75)/DECODE(((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day),0,null,((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)) days_til_75,
((c1.current_capacity_gb-c1.current_used_gb)*.9)/DECODE(((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day),0,null,((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)) days_til_90,
(c1.current_capacity_gb-c1.current_used_gb)/DECODE(((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day),0,null,((c1.current_used_gb-p1.prior_used_gb)/var.num_day)) days_til_full
FROM c1,p1,var
WHERE c1.host_id = p1.host_id (+)
)
SELECT h.host_id,h.host_name,
nbr_of_filesystems_prior, nbr_of_filesystems_current,
prior_capacity_gb,
current_capacity_gb,
prior_avail_gb,
current_avail_gb,
prior_used_gb,
current_used_gb,
prior_used_pct,
current_used_pct,
delta_used,delta_used_pct,
daily_growth,
days_til_75,
days_til_90,
days_til_full,
CASE WHEN current_used_pct >= 75 THEN '<font color=red>Reached 75%</font>' ELSE TO_CHAR(end_date+days_til_75,'YYYY/MM/DD') END date_75,
CASE WHEN current_used_pct >= 90 THEN '<font color=red>Reached 90%</font>' ELSE TO_CHAR(end_date+days_til_90,'YYYY/MM/DD') END date_90,
CASE WHEN current_used_pct >= 100 THEN '<font color=red>Currently 100%</font>' ELSE TO_CHAR(end_date+days_til_full,'YYYY/MM/DD') END date_full,
needed_in_180_days,
needed_in_365_days,
needed_in_1096_days
FROM t0,var,aps_v_host h
WHERE t0.host_id = h.host_id 
AND daily_growth > 1
ORDER BY delta_used_pct desc

title: Host Filesystem Reclaimation Candidates
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 03/01/2012
--Used to determine which filesystems are not fluctuating much and have available capacity
SELECT DISTINCT 
f.host_id,
f.host_name, 
f.mount_point, 
f.file_system_name,
f.storage_type, 
f.volume_group_name,
f.filesystem_capacity_kb/1024/1024 filesystem_capacity_gb,
f.filesystem_used_kb/1024/1024 filesystem_used_gb,
(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)/1024/1024 filesystem_available_gb,
(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)/f.filesystem_capacity_kb*100 available_pct,
round(nvl(((f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)-(fs.capacity_90day_min-fs.used_90day_min))/(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)*100,0),2) avail_90day_delta_min,
round(nvl(((f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)-(fs.capacity_90day_max-fs.used_90day_max))/(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)*100,0),2) avail_90day_delta_max,
round(nvl(((f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)-(fs.capacity_90day_avg-fs.used_90day_avg))/(f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)*100,0),2) avail_90day_delta_avg,
nvl((fs.capacity_90day_min-fs.used_90day_min)/1024/1024,0) avail_90day_min,
nvl((fs.capacity_90day_max-fs.used_90day_max)/1024/1024,0) avail_90day_max,
nvl((fs.capacity_90day_avg-fs.used_90day_avg)/1024/1024,0) avail_90day_avg
FROM aps_v_file_system_path f, aps_v_file_system_stat fs
WHERE f.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND f.filesystem_id=fs.filesystem_id(+)
AND f.storage_type LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','SAN','S','DAS','D','All','%')
AND f.filesystem_capacity_kb > 0
AND (f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)/f.filesystem_capacity_kb*100 >= (${freeCombo2})
AND nvl((f.filesystem_used_kb-fs.used_90day_avg)/f.filesystem_used_kb*100,0) <= (${freeCombo3})
AND (f.filesystem_capacity_kb-f.filesystem_used_kb)/1024/1024 >= (${freeText1})
ORDER BY f.host_name, f.file_system_name

sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 03/05/2011
WITH 
t1 AS (

host_id,host_name,
'DAS' storage_type,

fs.host_id,fs.host_name,
'NAS' storage_type,
fs.capacity_kb/1024/1024 capacity_gb,
fs.used_kb/1024/1024 used_gb
FROM aps_v_file_system fs
WHERE 
fs.mount_point IS NOT NULL
AND fs.host_id in (${hosts})
AND fs.file_system_type LIKE 'nfs%'
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
host_id,host_name,
SUM(DECODE(storage_type,'DAS',capacity_gb,0)) das_capacity,
SUM(DECODE(storage_type,'DAS',used_gb,0)) das_used,
SUM(DECODE(storage_type,'SAN',capacity_gb,0)) san_capacity,
SUM(DECODE(storage_type,'SAN',used_gb,0)) san_used,

)

DECODE(das_used,0,null,das_used)/das_capacity das_pct,
san_capacity,
san_used,
(san_capacity - san_used) san_free,
DECODE(san_used,0,null,san_used)/san_capacity*100 san_used_pct,
DECODE(san_used,0,null,san_used)/san_capacity san_pct,
nas_capacity,
nas_used,
(nas_capacity - nas_used) nas_free,
DECODE(nas_used,0,null,nas_used)/nas_capacity*100 nas_used_pct,
DECODE(nas_used,0,null,nas_used)/nas_capacity nas_pct
FROM t2

)

title: Host Probe CPU Performance Sparklines
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 05/13/2020
WITH 
cpu AS (--Gather stats for each cpu
SELECT 
  server_id,
  cpu_nbr,
  TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
    'Minute','MI',
    'Hour','HH24',
    'Day','DD',
    'Week','WW',
    'Month','MM',
    'Quarter','Q',
    'Year','YYYY')
  ) AS the_date, 
  MAX(idle_time_pct) AS idle_time_pct,
  MAX(wait_time_pct) AS wait_time_pct,
  MAX(nice_priority_time_pct) AS nice_priority_time_pct,
  MAX(steal_time_pct) AS steal_time_pct,
  MAX(user_processing_time_pct) AS user_processing_time_pct, 
  MAX(system_processing_time_pct) AS system_processing_time_pct
FROM 
  apt_v_host_cpu_log cl
WHERE
  server_id IN (${hosts})
  AND log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY 
  server_id,
  external_name,
  cpu_nbr,
  TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
    'Minute','MI',
    'Hour','HH24',
    'Day','DD',
    'Week','WW',
    'Month','MM',
    'Quarter','Q',
    'Year','YYYY')
  )
ORDER BY 
  3,4
),
s1 AS (--Generate Sparklines
SELECT
  server_id,
  cpu_nbr,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(idle_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS idle_time_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(wait_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS wait_time_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(nice_priority_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS nice_priority_time_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(steal_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS steal_time_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(user_processing_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS user_processing_time_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(system_processing_time_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS system_processing_time_pct_spk
FROM 
  cpu
GROUP BY 
  server_id,
  cpu_nbr
),
m1 AS (--get MAX() and AVG() for each
SELECT
  server_id,
  cpu_nbr,
  MAX(idle_time_pct) AS max_idle_time_pct,
  MAX(wait_time_pct) AS max_wait_time_pct,
  MAX(nice_priority_time_pct) AS max_nice_priority_time_pct,
  MAX(steal_time_pct) AS max_steal_time_pct,
  MAX(user_processing_time_pct) AS max_user_processing_time_pct, 
  MAX(system_processing_time_pct) AS max_system_processing_time_pct,
  AVG(idle_time_pct) AS avg_idle_time_pct,
  AVG(wait_time_pct) AS avg_wait_time_pct,
  AVG(nice_priority_time_pct) AS avg_nice_priority_time_pct,
  AVG(steal_time_pct) AS avg_steal_time_pct,
  AVG(user_processing_time_pct) AS avg_user_processing_time_pct, 
  AVG(system_processing_time_pct) AS avg_system_processing_time_pct
FROM 
  cpu
GROUP BY 
  server_id,
  cpu_nbr
)
SELECT
  s1.server_id,
  s.display_name,
  s1.cpu_nbr,
  s1.idle_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_idle_time_pct,
  m1.avg_idle_time_pct,
  s1.wait_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_wait_time_pct,
  m1.avg_wait_time_pct,
  s1.nice_priority_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_nice_priority_time_pct,
  m1.avg_nice_priority_time_pct,
  s1.steal_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_steal_time_pct,
  m1.avg_steal_time_pct,
  s1.user_processing_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_user_processing_time_pct,
  m1.avg_user_processing_time_pct,
  s1.system_processing_time_pct_spk,
  m1.max_system_processing_time_pct,
  m1.avg_system_processing_time_pct
FROM
  s1, m1, apt_v_server s
WHERE
  s1.server_id = m1.server_id
  AND s1.cpu_nbr = m1.cpu_nbr
  AND s1.server_id = s.server_id
ORDER BY
  UPPER(s.display_name), s1.cpu_nbr

title: Hot LUNs Top 10 I/O with Associated Hosts
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/02/2018
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT 
DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Total IO',1,'Read IO',2,'Write IO',3,'Read Latency',5,'Write Latency',6) top_by,
DECODE('${freeCombo3}','1x',1,'5x',5,'10x',10,'15x',15,'20x',20,'25x',25,'30x',30,'35x',35,'40x',40,'45x',45,'50x',50,'55x',55,'60x',60,'65x',65,'70x',70,'75x',75,'80x',80,'85x',85,'90x',90,'95x',95,'100x',100) threshold
FROM
dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT 
storage_array_id,
array_name,
logical_unit_id,
logical_unit_name,
MAX(read_io) max_read_io,
AVG(read_io) avg_read_io,
MAX(write_io) max_write_io,
AVG(write_io) avg_write_io,
MAX(total_io) max_total_io,
AVG(total_io) avg_total_io,
MAX(read_io_response_time) max_read_io_response,
AVG(read_io_response_time) avg_read_io_response,
MAX(write_io_response_time) max_write_io_response,
AVG(write_io_response_time) avg_write_io_response
FROM aps_v_lun_perform_log pl, var
WHERE pl.storage_array_id IN (${arrays})
AND log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
storage_array_id,
array_name, 
logical_unit_id,
logical_unit_name
ORDER BY 
DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Total IO',MAX(total_io),'Read IO',MAX(read_io),'Write IO',MAX(write_io),'Read Latency',MAX(read_io_response_time),'Write Latency',MAX(write_io_response_time))  DESC
),
h1 AS (
SELECT
sp.logical_unit_id,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT h.host_name) host_names
FROM
t1, aps_v_storage_path sp, aps_v_host h
WHERE sp.host_id = h.host_id
AND t1.logical_unit_id = sp.logical_unit_id
GROUP BY sp.logical_unit_id
)
SELECT 
t1.storage_array_id,
t1.array_name,
t1.logical_unit_id,
t1.logical_unit_name,
t1.avg_read_io,
t1.max_read_io,
(max_read_io / DECODE(avg_read_io,0,NULL,avg_read_io)) moa_read_io,
CASE 
WHEN(max_read_io / DECODE(avg_read_io,0,NULL,avg_read_io)) > threshold  THEN 'red' 
WHEN(max_read_io / DECODE(avg_read_io,0,NULL,avg_read_io)) < threshold  THEN 'green'
ELSE 'white'
END read_io_dot,
t1.avg_write_io,
t1.max_write_io,
(max_write_io / DECODE(avg_write_io,0,NULL,avg_write_io)) moa_write_io,
CASE 
WHEN(max_write_io / DECODE(avg_write_io,0,NULL,avg_write_io)) > threshold  THEN 'red' 
WHEN(max_write_io / DECODE(avg_write_io,0,NULL,avg_write_io)) < threshold  THEN 'green'
ELSE 'white' 
END write_io_dot,
t1.avg_read_io_response,
t1.max_read_io_response,
(max_read_io_response / DECODE(avg_read_io_response,0,NULL,avg_read_io_response)) moa_read_io_response,
CASE 
WHEN(max_read_io_response / DECODE(avg_read_io_response,0,NULL,avg_read_io_response)) > threshold  THEN 'red' 
WHEN(max_read_io_response / DECODE(avg_read_io_response,0,NULL,avg_read_io_response)) < threshold  THEN 'green' 
ELSE 'white' 
END read_io_response_dot,
t1.avg_write_io_response,
t1.max_write_io_response,
(max_write_io_response / DECODE(avg_write_io_response,0,NULL,avg_write_io_response)) moa_write_io_response,
CASE 
WHEN(max_write_io_response / DECODE(avg_write_io_response,0,NULL,avg_write_io_response)) > threshold  THEN 'red' 
WHEN(max_write_io_response / DECODE(avg_write_io_response,0,NULL,avg_write_io_response)) < threshold  THEN 'green' 
ELSE 'white' 
END write_io_response_dot,
h1.host_names 
FROM t1, h1, var
WHERE 
ROWNUM <= ${freeCombo1}
--AND NVL(t1.max_total_io,0) > 0
AND t1.logical_unit_id = h1.logical_unit_id (+)
ORDER BY 
DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Read IO',max_read_io,'Write IO',max_write_io,'Read Latency',max_read_io_response,'Write Latency',max_write_io_response)  DESC

sum(DECODE(j.summary_status,0,1)) Success,
sum(DECODE(j.summary_status,1,1)) Partial,
sum(DECODE(j.summary_status,2,1)) Failed,
count(DISTINCT tl.library_id) libraries,
count(DISTINCT td.drive_id) drives
FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_tape_library tl, apt_v_tape_drive td
WHERE j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.start_date BETWEEN  ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND j.server_id = tl.server_id
AND j.server_id = td.management_server_id
GROUP BY j.product_type_name,j.server_name
ORDER BY j.product_type_name,j.server_name
)
SELECT product_type_name,server_name,clients,
total_jobs,success,partial,failed,
success/total_jobs success_rate,
CASE 
WHEN success/total_jobs*100 = 100 then 'blue'
WHEN success/total_jobs*100 BETWEEN 97 AND 99 THEN 'green'
WHEN success/total_jobs*100 BETWEEN 85 AND 97 THEN 'yellow'
WHEN success/total_jobs*100 BETWEEN 0  AND 90 THEN 'red'
END status_dot,
libraries,drives
FROM t1

title: Job Volume Per Backup Server
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 05/19/2012
--Job volume per backup master server
--Note: Key's off of the server_id rather than the client_id.
--Also plot max and average on a separate axis when mixing lines and bars on the same chart
--otherwise the average line will appear along the top instead of the center.
WITH 
t1 AS (
SELECT 
server_name,
ROUND(SUM(kilobytes/1024/1024/1024),2) job_size_tb
FROM apt_v_job
WHERE server_id IN (${hosts})
AND finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND '${freeCombo1}' IN 
  CASE 
    WHEN '${freeCombo1}' NOT IN ('All') THEN
      CASE
        WHEN job_type_name like 'Full%' THEN 'Full'
        WHEN job_type_name like 'Incr%' THEN 'Incremental'
        WHEN job_type_name not like 'Incr%' AND job_type_name not like 'Full%' THEN 'Other'
      END
   ELSE 'All'
 END
GROUP BY server_name
),
t2 AS ( 
SELECT 
ROUND(MAX(job_size_tb),2) max_job_size_tb,
ROUND(AVG(job_size_tb),2) avg_job_size_tb
FROM t1
)
SELECT
t1.server_name,
t1.job_size_tb,
t2.max_job_size_tb,
t2.avg_job_size_tb
FROM t1,t2
ORDER BY 2 DESC

title: Job and Client Success by Window
sql_query:
WITH t1 as (
  SELECT start_date, finish_date finish_date  FROM 
              TABLE(rtd.ListOfBackupWindowDates(${startDate},${endDate},${queryCombo1})) bw
),
t2 as (
  SELECT t1.start_date, t1.finish_date,
      count(DISTINCT client_id) Client_count,
      count(j.job_id) Job_Count,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-0)))) success,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-1)))) partial,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-2)))) failed,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-1)))) running,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-0)))) queued,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-2)))) re_queued
      FROM apt_v_job j,t1
      WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN t1.start_date AND t1.finish_date
      AND t1.start_date >= ${startDate}
      AND j.server_id IN (${hosts})
      AND j.job_type_name like '%Backup'
      AND j.vendor_status NOT IN (150)
      GROUP BY  t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
      ORDER BY t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
),
t3 as (
  SELECT t1.start_date, t1.finish_date, client_id, min(summary_status) 
      FROM apt_v_job j,t1
      WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN t1.start_date AND t1.finish_date
      AND t1.start_date >= ${startDate}
      AND j.server_id IN (${hosts})
      AND j.vendor_status NOT IN (150)
      GROUP BY client_id, t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
      HAVING min(summary_status) > 1
      ORDER BY client_id, t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
) 
SELECT DISTINCT t2.start_date AS "Window Start", t2.finish_date AS "Window End",
      t2.job_count AS "Jobs", (t2.success+t2.partial) AS "Successful", 
      t2.failed AS "Failed", t2.running, t2.queued+t2.re_queued AS "Queued", 
      (t2.success + t2.partial) / t2.job_count*100 AS "Job Success Rate",
      t2.client_count AS "Total Clients", 
      (SELECT count(*) FROM t3 WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date 
        AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date ) AS "Failed Clients",
      (t2.client_count-(SELECT count(*) FROM t3 WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date 
        AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date )) / t2.client_count*100 AS "Client Success Rate"
      FROM t2,t3
      WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date (+)
      AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date (+)

title: Job and Client Success by Window and Server Group
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 05/10/2012
--This report requires a defined backup window and a properly structured
--server grouping
--Status 1 jobs (partially successful) are treated as successful
--A comma separated list of error codes can be specified for exclusion at runtime.
--If no error error code is to be excluded enter None or some other bogus value
--Note: 
-- 1. You have to enter something in the Exclude Error Codes: i.e. None
-- 2. If you put in a comma separated list of codes, use no spaces!
-- EXAMPLE 150,50,6 NOT 150, 50, 6
-- You can always edit the template and remove this option from the Report Designer and the SQL
-- or you can hard code the errors for exclusion
WITH 
g0 as (--Be sure to only select one server group if multiple were selected
SELECT max(group_id) server_group
FROM apt_v_group 
WHERE group_id IN (decode('${serverGroups}','',-1,'${serverGroups}'))
),
t1 as (--Seed the backup window dated based on the window_id from the dropdown
SELECT start_date, finish_date finish_date  
FROM TABLE(rtd.ListOfBackupWindowDates(${startDate},${endDate},${queryCombo1})) bw
),
t2 as ( --Aggregate the job data by  the server group selected
SELECT 
rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) server_group,
t1.start_date, t1.finish_date,
count(DISTINCT client_id) Client_count,
count(j.job_id) Job_Count,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-0)))) success,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-1)))) partial,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-2)))) failed,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-1)))) running,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-0)))) queued,
sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.vendor_state-2)))) re_queued
FROM apt_v_job j,t1,g0
WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN t1.start_date AND t1.finish_date
AND t1.start_date >= ${startDate}
AND j.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND j.job_type_name like '%Backup'
AND j.vendor_status NOT IN (${freeText1})
GROUP BY  
rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) ,
t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
ORDER BY 
      rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) ,
      t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
),
t3 as (
      SELECT 
      rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) server_group,
      t1.start_date, t1.finish_date, client_id, min(summary_status) 
      FROM apt_v_job j,t1,g0
      WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN t1.start_date AND t1.finish_date
      AND t1.start_date >= ${startDate}
      AND j.server_id IN (${hosts})
      AND j.vendor_status NOT IN (150)
      GROUP BY client_id, 
      rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) ,
      t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
      HAVING min(summary_status) > 1
      ORDER BY 
      client_id, 
      rtd.getServerGroupContextById(g0.server_group,client_id,1) ,
      t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
) 
SELECT DISTINCT 
t2.server_group, 
t2.start_date AS "Window Start", 
t2.finish_date AS "Window End",
t2.job_count AS "Jobs", 
(t2.success+t2.partial) AS "Successful", 
t2.failed AS "Failed", t2.running, t2.queued+t2.re_queued AS "Queued", 
(t2.success + t2.partial) / t2.job_count*100 AS "Job Success Rate",
      t2.client_count AS "Total Clients", 
      (SELECT count(*) FROM t3 WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date 
        AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date ) AS "Failed Clients",
      (t2.client_count-(SELECT count(*) FROM t3 WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date 
        AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date )) / t2.client_count*100 AS "Client Success Rate"
      FROM t2,t3
      WHERE t2.start_date = t3.start_date (+)
      AND t2.finish_date = t3.finish_date (+)

sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/27/2017
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
), 
rep AS (
SELECT
'EMC Symmetrix' array_type,
logical_unit_id, 
CASE WHEN SUBSTR(raid_type,1,4) = 'RDF1' THEN 'Y'WHEN SUBSTR(raid_type,1,5) = '2-Way' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END is_replicated_lun

UNION ALL
SELECT 
'HDS' array_type,
logical_unit_id,
CASE WHEN true_copy_vol_type = 'P-VOL' 
OR univ_replicator_vol_type = 'P-VOL' 
OR shadow_image_vol_type = 'P-VOL' 
OR quick_shadow_vol_type = 'P-VOL' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END is_replicated_lun
FROM aps_v_hds_logical_unit 
UNION ALL
SELECT
'IBM XIV' array_type,
xiv_volume_id logical_unit_id, 
is_mirrored is_replicated_lun
FROM aps_v_xiv_volume
UNION ALL
SELECT
'IBM SVC' array_type,
svc_storage_volume_id logical_unit_id, 
CASE WHEN COUNT(svc_mirror_extent_id) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END is_replicated_lun
FROM aps_v_svc_mirror_extent sme
GROUP BY sme.svc_storage_volume_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
'HP EVA' array_type,
logical_unit_id, 
does_mirror_exists is_replicated_lun

),
t1 AS (
SELECT 
lu.storage_array_id,
lu.array_name,
COUNT(lu.logical_unit_id) tot_lun_count,
COUNT(DECODE(NVL(rep.is_replicated_lun,'N'),'N',lu.logical_unit_id)) non_rep_lun_count,

SUM(DECODE(NVL(rep.is_replicated_lun,'N'),'N',lu.total_capacity_gb)/div_by) non_rep_lun_capacity,
SUM(DECODE(NVL(rep.is_replicated_lun,'N'),'Y',lu.total_capacity_gb)/div_by) rep_lun_capacity
FROM aps_v_logical_unit lu, rep, var
WHERE lu.logical_unit_id = rep.logical_unit_id (+)
GROUP BY 
lu.storage_array_id,
lu.array_name
)
SELECT 
s.vendor_name,
s.array_family,
t1.storage_array_id,
t1.array_name,
t1.tot_lun_count,
non_rep_lun_count,
rep_lun_count,
rep_lun_count/tot_lun_count rep_lun_pct_count,
rep_lun_count/tot_lun_count*100 pct_rep_lun_count,
tot_lun_capacity,
non_rep_lun_capacity,
rep_lun_capacity,
rep_lun_capacity/tot_lun_capacity rep_lun_pct_cap,
rep_lun_capacity/tot_lun_capacity*100 pct_rep_lun_cap
