title: TSM Failed Instance Processes
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 10/03/2011
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
--User Defined Threshholds
1 AS yellow_threshold,
2 AS red_threshold
FROM apt_v_dual
),
q1 AS (
SELECT
to_char(${startDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') start_date_char,
to_char(${startDate},'HH24') start_hour_char,
to_char(${endDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') finish_date_char,
to_char(${endDate},'HH24') finish_hour_char,
server_id,
server_name,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Expiration',1,0)) Expiration,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Full DB Backup',1,0)) Full_DB_Backup,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Incremental DB Backup',1,0)) Incr_DB_Backup,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Migration',1,0)) migration,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Move Media',1,0)) move_media,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Reclamation',1,0)) reclamation,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Storage Pool Backup',1,0)) stg_pool_backup,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Incr Backup',1,0)) Incr_Backup,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Archive',1,0)) Archive,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Command',1,0)) Command,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Restore',1,0)) restore,
sum(DECODE(job_type_name,'Selective Backup',1,0)) selective_backup
FROM apt_v_job
WHERE start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND server_id IN (${hosts})
AND summary_status = 2
GROUP BY server_id,server_name
)
SELECT
start_date_char,
start_hour_char,
finish_date_char,
finish_hour_char,
server_id,
server_name,
expiration,
CASE WHEN expiration >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN expiration >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow'  ELSE 'green' END expiration_dot,
full_DB_Backup,
CASE WHEN full_DB_Backup >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN full_DB_Backup >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow'  ELSE 'green' END full_DB_Backup_dot,
incr_DB_Backup,
CASE WHEN incr_DB_Backup >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN incr_DB_Backup >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END incr_DB_Backup_dot,
migration,
CASE WHEN migration >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN migration >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END migration_dot,
move_media,
CASE WHEN move_media >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN move_media >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END move_media_dot,
reclamation,
CASE WHEN reclamation >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN reclamation >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END reclamation_dot,
stg_pool_backup,
CASE WHEN stg_pool_backup >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN stg_pool_backup >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END stg_pool_backup_dot,
incr_backup,
CASE WHEN incr_backup >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN incr_backup >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END incr_backup_dot,
Archive,
CASE WHEN archive >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN archive >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END archive_dot,
command,
CASE WHEN command >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN command >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END command_dot,
restore,
CASE WHEN restore >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN restore >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END restore_dot,
selective_backup,
CASE WHEN selective_backup >= var.red_threshold THEN 'red' WHEN selective_backup >= var.yellow_threshold THEN 'yellow' ELSE 'green' END selective_backup_dot,
var.yellow_threshold,var.red_threshold
FROM q1,var

title: TSM Instance Growth Period over Period
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 09/09/2011
--
--Compares the client count and job volume period over period
--EXAMPLE: If you choose "Last 7 Days" it compares last 7 days to prior 7 days if you choose last 
--"30 Days" it compares last 30 days to prior 30 days, etc...
--NOTE: in large environments it may take a while to run if select all instances and long time periods
--(like 1 year) so be sure to select a small time period first (like last 24 hrs), and see how it goes.
WITH d1 as (
SELECT (trunc(${endDate}) - trunc(${startDate})) num_day
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 as (
SELECT server_name, 
count(DISTINCT client_id) client_count_curr,
sum(kilobytes)/1024/1024 GB_SIZE_curr
FROM apt_v_tsm_job, d1
WHERE trunc(start_date) between (trunc(sysdate) - num_day) AND trunc(sysdate) 
group by server_name
),
t2 AS (
SELECT server_name, 
count(DISTINCT client_id) client_count_prior,
sum(kilobytes)/1024/1024 GB_SIZE_Prior
FROM apt_v_tsm_job, d1
WHERE trunc(start_date) between trunc(sysdate) - (num_day*2) AND (trunc(sysdate) - num_day)
GROUP BY server_name
)
SELECT t1.server_name, 
trunc(sysdate) - (num_day*2) ||'-'|| (trunc(sysdate) - num_day) prior_period,
client_count_prior,
t2.GB_SIZE_Prior,
(trunc(sysdate) - num_day) ||'-'|| trunc(sysdate) curr_period,
client_count_curr,
t1.GB_SIZE_curr, 
(t1.client_count_curr - t2.client_count_Prior) delta_client_count,
(t1.GB_SIZE_curr - t2.GB_SIZE_Prior) delta_volume
FROM t1,t2,d1
WHERE t1.server_name = t2.server_name (+)
ORDER BY (t1.GB_SIZE_curr- t2.GB_SIZE_Prior) desc

title: TSM Job Details
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 08/24/2011
--Display TSM Job Details
SELECT DISTINCT  
       tj.server_name,
       tj.client_name tcp_name,
       tj.node_name,
       tj.job_type_name,
       tj.domain_name,
       tj.schedule_name,
       tsp.storage_pool_name,
       tj.start_date,
       tj.finish_date,
       (finish_date-start_date)*24*60 duration_min,
       CASE tj.vendor_status
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Completed'
         WHEN 2 THEN 'Missed'
         WHEN 3 THEN 'Failed'
         WHEN 4 THEN 'Started'
         WHEN 5 THEN 'Restarted'
         WHEN 6 THEN 'Severed'
         WHEN 7 THEN 'Future'
         WHEN 8 THEN 'Pending'
         WHEN 9 THEN 'Uncertain'
         WHEN 10 THEN 'In Progress'
         WHEN null THEN 'Unknown'
         ELSE 'Unknown'
       END state,
       CASE tj.summary_status 
         WHEN 0 THEN '<font color=blue>Successful'
         WHEN 1 THEN '<font color=orange>Partial'
         ELSE '<font color=red>Failed'
       END status,
       tj.kilobytes/1024/1024 size_gb, 
       tj.nbr_of_files, 
       tj.mbytes_sec 
    FROM apt_v_tsm_job tj,
         apt_v_tsm_storage_pool tsp
    WHERE tj.client_id IN (${hosts})
      AND tj.finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
      AND tj.storage_pool_id = tsp.storage_pool_id(+)
      AND job_type_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','All','%','${freeCombo1}')
    ORDER BY tj.finish_date DESC

title: TSM Job SLA Totals by Window
sql_query:
WITH t1 as (
  SELECT start_date, finish_date finish_date  FROM 
              TABLE(rtd.ListOfBackupWindowDates(${startDate},${endDate}, 
      apt_BackupWindowListType( 
        APT_BACKUPWINDOWTYPE('Mon',44,68), 
        APT_BACKUPWINDOWTYPE('Tue',68,92), 
        APT_BACKUPWINDOWTYPE('Wed',92,116), 
        APT_BACKUPWINDOWTYPE('Thu',116,140), 
        APT_BACKUPWINDOWTYPE('Weekend',140,212) ))) bw
),
t2 as (
  SELECT t1.start_date, t1.finish_date,
      count(j.job_id) Job_Count,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-0)))) success,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-1)))) partial,
      sum(1*(1-abs(sign(j.summary_status-2)))) failed
      FROM apt_v_tsm_job j,t1
      WHERE j.start_date BETWEEN t1.start_date AND t1.finish_date
      AND t1.start_date >= ${startDate}
      AND j.client_id IN (${hosts})
      AND j.job_type_name like '%Backup'
      AND j.summary_status IS NOT null 
      AND j.vendor_state IS NOT null 
      GROUP BY  t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
      ORDER BY t1.start_date, t1.finish_date
) SELECT t2.start_date AS "Window Start", t2.finish_date AS "Window End", 
      t2.job_count AS "Jobs", t2.success AS "Successful", t2.partial AS "Partial", 
      t2.failed AS "Failed",
      (t2.success+t2.partial) / t2.job_count AS "Success Rate"
      FROM t2

title: TSM Node Filespace Last Backup
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com    Date: 07/07/2011
--
--
WITH t1 as (
SELECT f.node_name node,f.filespace_name filespace,
max(f.backup_finish_date) last_backup,
max(f.capacity_kbytes/1024/1024) last_size_gb
FROM apt_v_tsm_filespace f, apt_v_tsm_node n
WHERE f.backup_finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND f.node_id = n.node_id
AND n.client_id in (${hosts})
GROUP BY f.node_name,f.filespace_name
)
SELECT node, filespace, last_backup, last_size_gb,
(sysdate - last_backup) days_since_last_backup
FROM t1
WHERE (sysdate - last_backup) > ${freeCombo1} 
ORDER BY node, filespace

title: TSM Node Filespace Volumes
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 11/07/2011
WITH 
c1 AS ( --Only select one client because of performance
SELECT max(server_id) client_id
FROM apt_v_server 
WHERE server_id IN (${hosts})
),
t1 AS (
SELECT n.node_id, n.node_name,
  f.filespace_id, f.filespace_name,
  f.capacity_kbytes, 
  DECODE(f.capacity_kbytes,NULL,NULL,TRUNC(f.capacity_kbytes - (f.capacity_kbytes * (NVL(f.pct_utilized, 0)/100)))) free_kbytes,
  f.backup_start_date,
  f.backup_finish_date
FROM apt_v_tsm_filespace f, apt_v_tsm_node n, c1
WHERE n.client_id = c1.client_id
  AND n.node_id   = f.node_id
),
t2 AS (
SELECT tj.node_id, j.job_id, j.finish_date, t1.filespace_id
FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_tsm_job tj, t1, c1
WHERE j.client_id = c1.client_id
  AND j.job_type IN (401,402,403,408,420,420)
  --401=TSM_SCHEDULE_SELECTIVE 
  --402=TSM_SCHEDULE_INCREMENTAL
  --403=TSM_SCHEDULE_IMAGE_BACKUP
  --408=TSM_SCHEDULE_COMMAND
  --420=TSM_PROCESS_NAS_BACKUP
  --421=TSM_BACKUP_SET   
  AND t1.backup_start_date  BETWEEN ${startDate}  AND ${endDate}
  AND j.job_id   = tj.job_id
  AND tj.node_id = t1.node_id
  AND j.summary_status IN (1,2)
),
f1 AS (
SELECT p.filespace_id, SUM(p.stg_pool_phy_kbytes) sum_phys_kbytes
FROM t1, apt_v_tsm_stgpool_contents p, c1
WHERE p.client_id = c1.client_id
 AND p.filespace_id = t1.filespace_id
GROUP BY p.filespace_id
),                          
v1 AS (
SELECT 
  v.filespace_id,
  v.volume_id, 
  NVL(m.media_name, d.media_name) volume_name,
  NVL(mt.storage_pool_id, d.storage_pool_id) storage_pool_id
FROM apt_v_tsm_volume_contents v, apt_v_tape_media m, apt_v_tsm_tape_media mt, apt_v_tsm_disk_media d,f1
WHERE v.filespace_id = f1.filespace_id
  AND v.volume_id = m.tape_media_id(+)
  AND v.volume_id = mt.tape_media_id(+)
  AND v.volume_id = d.disk_media_id(+)                         
),
v2 AS (
SELECT UNIQUE 
  v1.filespace_id,
  v1.volume_id,
  v1.volume_name,
  s.storage_pool_id,
  s.storage_pool_name
FROM v1, apt_v_tsm_storage_pool s
WHERE v1.storage_pool_id = s.storage_pool_id(+)
  AND v1.volume_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t1.node_id,
  t1.node_name,
  t1.filespace_id,
  t1.filespace_name,
  DECODE(t1.capacity_kbytes, NULL, f1.sum_phys_kbytes, 0, 
  f1.sum_phys_kbytes, t1.capacity_kbytes)/1024 capacity_mbytes,
  t1.free_kbytes/1024 free_mbytes,
  t2.job_id,
  t1.backup_finish_date finish_date,
  aptStringConcat(DISTINCT v2.storage_pool_name) storage_pools,
  aptStringConcat(DISTINCT v2.volume_name) volumes
FROM t1,f1,t2,v2
WHERE t1.filespace_id = t2.filespace_id(+)
  AND t1.filespace_id = f1.filespace_id(+)                                                    
  AND t1.filespace_id = v2.filespace_id(+)   
GROUP BY 
  t1.node_id,
  t1.node_name,
  t1.filespace_id,
  t1.filespace_name,
  DECODE(t1.capacity_kbytes, NULL, f1.sum_phys_kbytes, 0, f1.sum_phys_kbytes, t1.capacity_kbytes),
  t1.free_kbytes,
  t2.job_id,
  t1.backup_finish_date                                               
ORDER BY Upper(t1.node_name), Upper(t1.filespace_name)

title: TSM Node Occupancy
sql_query:
--tsm_node_occupancy_htm.sql
--Select: Server Groups and Client Scope
--Format: Table
WITH 
f1 AS (
SELECT n.node_id, n.client_id, f.filespace_id
    FROM apt_v_tsm_node n,
         apt_v_tsm_filespace f
    WHERE n.client_id IN (${hosts})
      AND n.node_id    = f.node_id
),
sp AS (
SELECT f1.client_id, f1.node_id, SUM(p.stg_pool_phy_kbytes) sum_kbytes
    FROM f1, apt_v_tsm_stgpool_contents p
    WHERE f1.client_id    = p.client_id
      AND f1.filespace_id = p.filespace_id
    GROUP BY f1.client_id, f1.node_id
),
vo AS (
SELECT f1.client_id, f1.node_id, COUNT(UNIQUE v.volume_id) count_volumes
    FROM f1, apt_v_tsm_volume_contents v
    WHERE f1.client_id    = v.client_id
      AND f1.filespace_id = v.filespace_id
      AND v.volume_type   = 'T'
    GROUP BY f1.client_id, f1.node_id         
)    
SELECT i.instance_name, s.hostname tcp_name, n.node_name, 
       sp.sum_kbytes/1024/1024 sum_GB, vo.count_volumes
    FROM sp, vo,
         apt_v_tsm_node n,
         apt_v_server s,
         apt_v_server_instance i
    WHERE sp.client_id  = s.server_id
      AND sp.client_id  = vo.client_id
      AND sp.node_id    = vo.node_id
      AND sp.node_id    = n.node_id
      AND n.server_instance_id = i.server_instance_id
    ORDER BY Upper(i.instance_name), Upper(s.hostname), Upper(n.node_name)

title: TSM Platform Policy Domain Occupancy
sql_query:
WITH pd as (
SELECT
pd.server_instance_id,
pd.server_instance_name,
s.os_version,
pd.domain_id,
pd.domain_name,
pd.backup_retention_days,
pd.archive_retention_days,
count(DISTINCT n.node_id) nbr_of_nodes,
--sum((fs.capacity_kbytes*(pct_utilized/100))/1024/1024) fs_capacity_gb
sum(fs.capacity_kbytes/1024/1024) fs_capacity_gb
FROM apt_v_tsm_policy_domain pd, apt_v_tsm_node n, apt_v_server s, apt_v_tsm_filespace fs
WHERE pd.domain_id = n.domain_id
AND n.client_id IN (${hosts})
AND n.client_id = s.server_id
AND fs.node_id = n.node_id
AND s.os_version is not null
GROUP BY
pd.server_instance_id,
pd.server_instance_name,
s.os_version,
pd.domain_id,
pd.domain_name,
pd.backup_retention_days,
pd.archive_retention_days
),
sp AS (
SELECT s.os_version, n.domain_id, SUM(spc.stg_pool_phy_kbytes/1024/1024) total_occupancy
    FROM apt_v_tsm_node n, apt_v_tsm_stgpool_contents spc, apt_v_tsm_storage_pool p, apt_v_server s
    WHERE n.client_id = spc.client_id
    AND n.client_id IN (${hosts})
    AND n.client_id = s.server_id
    AND spc.storage_pool_id=p.storage_pool_id
    AND s.os_version is not null
    AND Upper(p.storage_pool_type) LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}','ALL','%','PRIMARY','PRIMARY','COPY','COPY')
    GROUP BY s.os_version, n.domain_id
),
vo AS (
SELECT  s.os_version,n.domain_id, COUNT(UNIQUE vc.volume_id) nbr_of_volumes
    FROM apt_v_tsm_node n, apt_v_tsm_volume_contents vc, apt_v_server s
    WHERE n.client_id = vc.client_id
    AND n.client_id IN (${hosts})
    AND n.client_id = s.server_id
    AND s.os_version is not null
    GROUP BY  s.os_version, n.domain_id
)
SELECT
s.server_id,
pd.server_instance_id,
pd.server_instance_name,
pd.os_version node_os,
pd.domain_id,
pd.domain_name,
pd.backup_retention_days,
pd.archive_retention_days,
pd.nbr_of_nodes,
pd.fs_capacity_gb,
sp.total_occupancy,
vo.nbr_of_volumes
FROM pd,sp,vo,apt_v_server s, apt_v_server_instance si
WHERE pd.os_version = sp.os_version
AND pd.os_version = vo.os_version
AND pd.domain_id = sp.domain_id
AND pd.domain_id = vo.domain_id
AND pd.server_instance_id = si.server_instance_id
AND si.server_id = s.server_id

title: TSM Process Type Throughput Histogram
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 10/30/2015 WITH avg_tpt AS ( SELECT AVG((j.kilobytes/1024) / ((j.finish_date-j.start_date)*24*60*60)) avgThroughput FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_tsm_process p WHERE j.server_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.finish_date IS NOT NULL AND j.job_id = p.job_id AND j.finish_date > j.start_date AND j.kilobytes > 1024 AND j.summary_status <= 1 ), pol AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.job_type_name FROM apt_v_job j, apt_v_tsm_process p WHERE j.server_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND j.job_id = p.job_id AND j.finish_date IS NOT NULL AND j.finish_date > j.start_date AND j.kilobytes >1024 AND j.summary_status <= 1 ), jt AS ( SELECT job_type_name, the_date FROM pol, (SELECT the_date FROM TABLE(CAST(rtd.APTlistOfDates(${startDate}, ${endDate}, 10) AS dateListType))) d ), jobs AS ( SELECT jt.job_type_name, jt.the_date, ROUND(NVL(SUM(j.kilobytes/1024) / (SUM(j.finish_date-j.start_date)*24*60*60),0 ) , 2) throughput FROM jt, apt_v_job j, apt_v_tsm_process p WHERE jt.job_type_name = p.job_type_name AND j.client_id IN (${hosts}) AND j.job_id = p.job_id AND j.start_date <= (jt.the_date + 3599/86400) AND j.finish_date >= jt.the_date AND j.finish_date IS NOT NULL AND j.finish_date > j.start_date AND j.kilobytes > 1024 AND j.summary_status <= 1 GROUP BY jt.job_type_name, jt.the_date ) SELECT to_char(jt.the_date,'MM/DD hh:AM') the_date, jt.job_type_name, CASE WHEN throughput > 0 AND throughput <= avgThroughput-(avgThroughput*.3333) THEN '
'||throughput||'
' WHEN throughput >= avgThroughput-(avgThroughput*.3333) AND throughput <= avgThroughput+(avgThroughput*.3333) THEN '
'||throughput||'
' WHEN throughput >= avgThroughput+(avgThroughput*.3333) THEN '
'||throughput||'
' WHEN throughput = 0 THEN ' ' END throughput FROM jt, jobs, avg_tpt WHERE jt.job_type_name = jobs.job_type_name (+) AND jt.the_date = jobs.the_date (+) ORDER BY upper(jt.job_type_name), jt.the_date

title: TSM Stale Filespace Breakdown
sql_query:
--TSM Stale Filespaces Breakdown
WITH t1 as (
SELECT f.node_name node,f.filespace_name filespace,
max(f.backup_finish_date) last_backup
FROM apt_v_tsm_filespace f, apt_v_tsm_node n
WHERE f.backup_finish_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND f.node_id = n.node_id
AND n.client_id in (${hosts})
GROUP BY f.node_name,f.filespace_name
),
t2 as (
SELECT node, filespace, last_backup,
(sysdate - last_backup) days_since_last_backup
FROM t1
ORDER BY node, filespace
)
SELECT
0 ord,'Less Than 3 Days' unit, count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_backup < 3 THEN 1 END) metric
FROM t2
UNION
SELECT
1 ord, '3 to 14 Days' unit, count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_backup BETWEEN 3 AND 14 THEN 1 END) metric
FROM t2
UNION
SELECT
2 ord,'Greater Than 14 Days' unit, count(CASE WHEN days_since_last_backup > 14 THEN 1 END) metric
FROM t2

title: VM Datastore Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 07/26/2018
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting VM Datastore Usage over time
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.vmw_datastore_id the_id_1,
0 the_id_2,
MAX(l.free_capacity_kb/div_by) the_value
FROM
apt_v_vmw_datastore_log l, var
WHERE
l.vmw_datastore_id IN (${datastores}) 
AND l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.vmw_datastore_id
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC),2) first_value, 
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC),2) last_value,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0),2) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
f2.first_value, 
f2.last_date,
f2.last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
f2.the_value_lin,
f2.sum_of_the_value,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_lin,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
--
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_pop,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2, var
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
t1 AS (--Format the final Output
SELECT
f3.the_id_1 vmw_datastore_id,
d.datastore_name,
f3.the_id_2,
s1.the_spk,
f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Not Changed'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, apt_v_vmw_datastore d
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = d.vmw_datastore_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM t1
WHERE 
usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}')
AND nbr_of_days >= ${freeCombo3}
ORDER BY NVL(days_left_pop,0) ASC

title: VM Datastore Thin Provisioning Report

--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 06/26/2015
WITH
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays,
${startDate} startDate,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by
FROM apt_v_dual
)
SELECT 
DISTINCT
du.vmw_datastore_id, 
du.datastore_name, 
du.total_ds_capacity_kb/div_by total_ds_capacity, 
du.ds_used_kb/div_by ds_used, 
du.ds_free_kb/div_by ds_free,
du.ds_used_kb / total_ds_capacity_kb used_pct, 
du.ds_used_kb / total_ds_capacity_kb pct_used, 
du.total_vmdisk_size_kb/div_by consumed , 
CASE WHEN (du.total_ds_capacity_kb-du.total_vmdisk_size_kb)< 0
THEN
(du.total_ds_capacity_kb-du.total_vmdisk_size_kb)/div_by
ELSE null
END over_consumed,
du.total_prov_vmdisk_size_kb/div_by provisioned, 
(du.total_prov_vmdisk_size_kb - total_ds_capacity_kb)/div_by overprov,
(du.total_prov_vmdisk_size_kb / total_ds_capacity_kb) overprov_pct,
(du.total_prov_vmdisk_size_kb / total_ds_capacity_kb) pct_overprov
FROM apt_v_vmw_datastore_usage du, apt_v_vmw_extent de, apt_v_virtual_system vs, var

title: VM Fastest Growing Guests 07/21/2015
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 10/19/2015
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
p.partition_id,
TRUNC(l.log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) log_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.partition_id ORDER BY p.partition_id) row_number,
ROUND(MAX(l.total_size_kb/div_by),2) total_size
FROM apt_v_vmw_virtual_machine_log l, apt_v_partition p, var
WHERE p.partition_id = l.partition_id
AND l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND p.collection_status != 3
AND p.host_id IN (${hosts})
AND l.total_size_kb > 0
--FIXME this table has both guests and ESX servers. filter out ESX Servers
GROUP BY 
p.partition_id, 
TRUNC(l.log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY'))
),
lin1 AS (--Get the Linear Growth statistics
SELECT 
partition_id,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(total_size,row_number),2) linear_trend,
REGR_R2(total_size,row_number) r2_value,
REGR_AVGX(total_size,row_number) avex,
REGR_AVGY(total_size,row_number)  avey,
REGR_INTERCEPT(total_size,row_number) y_intercept,
REGR_COUNT(total_size,row_number) period_count,
STDDEV(total_size)  stddev
FROM t1
GROUP BY 
partition_id
),
pop1 AS (--Get the Period over Period Numbers
SELECT
t1.partition_id, 
SUM(DECODE(t1.row_number,1,t1.total_size,0)) first_period_total_size,
SUM(DECODE(t1.row_number,lin1.period_count,t1.total_size,0)) last_period_total_size
FROM t1, lin1
WHERE
t1.partition_id = lin1.partition_id
AND t1.row_number IN (1,lin1.period_count) --Only get the first and last period numbers
GROUP BY
t1.partition_id 
),
g1 AS (--Calculate Growth
SELECT
lin1.partition_id,
vm.partition_name,
vm.host_name,
pop1.first_period_total_size,
pop1.last_period_total_size,
(pop1.last_period_total_size - pop1.first_period_total_size) total_change,
(pop1.last_period_total_size - pop1.first_period_total_size) / DECODE(pop1.first_period_total_size,0,NULL,pop1.first_period_total_size) simple_growth_rate,
linear_trend,
r2_value,
avex,
avey,
y_intercept,
stddev,
lin1.period_count,
ROUND((pop1.last_period_total_size - pop1.first_period_total_size ) / DECODE(lin1.period_count,0,NULL,lin1.period_count),2) pop_trend,
POWER((pop1.last_period_total_size / DECODE(pop1.first_period_total_size,0,NULL,pop1.first_period_total_size)),(1/DECODE(lin1.period_count,0,NULL,lin1.period_count))) - 1 compound_growth_rate
FROM pop1, lin1, apt_v_vmw_virtual_machine vm
WHERE pop1.partition_id = lin1.partition_id
AND lin1.partition_id = vm.partition_id
)
SELECT 
partition_id,
partition_name,
host_name,
first_period_total_size,
last_period_total_size,
total_change,
simple_growth_rate,
compound_growth_rate,
DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY compound_growth_rate DESC) compound_growth_rank,
period_count, 
pop_trend,
linear_trend,
r2_value,
avex,
avey,
y_intercept,
stddev
FROM g1
WHERE 
total_change > 0
ORDER BY compound_growth_rate DESC

title: VM Guest CPU Stats Sparklines
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@veritas.com
--Last Modified: 03/25/2020
WITH 
c1 AS (
SELECT
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')) AS the_date,
  p.partition_id,
  p.partition_name,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_mhz,0)/1000),2) cpu_usage_ghz, --MHz converted to GHz
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_pct,0)),2) cpu_usage_pct,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_wait_ms,0)),2) cpu_wait_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_ready_ms,0)),2) cpu_ready_ms
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_perform_cpu_log l, apt_v_partition p
WHERE 
  p.partition_id IN (${vmGuests})
  AND p.partition_id = l.partition_id
  AND l.end_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND p.collection_status != 3
  AND p.partition_type = 'VM'
GROUP BY 
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')),
  p.partition_id,
  p.partition_name
),
s1 AS (--Generate Sparklines
SELECT
  c1.partition_id,
  c1.partition_name,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(cpu_usage_ghz,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS cpu_usage_ghz_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(cpu_usage_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS cpu_usage_pct_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(cpu_wait_ms,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS cpu_wait_ms_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(cpu_ready_ms,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS cpu_ready_ms_spk
FROM 
  c1
GROUP BY 
  c1.partition_id,
  c1.partition_name
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
  c1.partition_id,
  MAX(c1.cpu_usage_ghz) AS max_cpu_usage_ghz,
  MAX(c1.cpu_usage_pct) AS max_cpu_usage_pct,
  MAX(c1.cpu_wait_ms) AS max_cpu_wait_ms,
  MAX(c1.cpu_ready_ms) AS max_cpu_ready_ms,
  AVG(c1.cpu_usage_ghz) AS avg_cpu_usage_ghz,
  AVG(c1.cpu_usage_pct) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct,
  AVG(c1.cpu_wait_ms) AS avg_cpu_wait_ms,
  AVG(c1.cpu_ready_ms) AS avg_cpu_ready_ms
FROM
  c1
GROUP BY 
  c1.partition_id
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
  s1.partition_id,
  s1.partition_name,
  s1.cpu_usage_ghz_spk,
  t1.max_cpu_usage_ghz,
  t1.avg_cpu_usage_ghz,
  s1.cpu_usage_pct_spk,
  t1.max_cpu_usage_pct,
  t1.avg_cpu_usage_pct,
  s1.cpu_wait_ms_spk,
  t1.max_cpu_wait_ms,
  t1.avg_cpu_wait_ms,
  s1.cpu_ready_ms_spk,
  t1.max_cpu_ready_ms,
  t1.avg_cpu_ready_ms
FROM
  s1, t1
WHERE
  s1.partition_id = t1.partition_id
ORDER BY t1.max_cpu_usage_ghz DESC
)
SELECT 
  *
FROM 
  t2
WHERE 
  ROWNUM <= ${freeCombo2}
ORDER BY 
 max_cpu_usage_ghz DESC

title: VM Guest CPU Usage History
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@veritas.com
--Last Modified: 03/26/2020
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT 
  DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Minutes',1,'Hours',1,'Days',1,'Weeks',7,'Months',31,'Quarters',93,'Years',365.25) AS the_multiplier,
  TO_NUMBER('${freeCombo3}') AS forecast_periods
FROM apt_v_dual
), 
c1 AS (
SELECT
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')) AS the_date,
  p.partition_id, 
  p.partition_name, 
  ROUND(AVG(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_mhz,0)/1000),2) avg_cpu_usage_ghz, --MHz converted to GHz
  ROUND(AVG(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_pct,0)),2) avg_cpu_usage_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(NVL(l.avg_cpu_wait_ms,0)),2) avg_cpu_wait_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(NVL(l.avg_cpu_ready_ms,0)),2) avg_cpu_ready_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_mhz,0)/1000),2) max_cpu_usage_ghz, --MHz converted to GHz
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_usage_pct,0)),2) max_cpu_usage_pct,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_wait_ms,0)),2) max_cpu_wait_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_cpu_ready_ms,0)),2) max_cpu_ready_ms
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_perform_cpu_log l, apt_v_partition p
WHERE 
  p.partition_id IN (${vmGuests})
  AND p.partition_id = l.partition_id
  AND l.end_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND p.collection_status != 3
  AND p.partition_type = 'VM'
GROUP BY 
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')),
  p.partition_id, 
  p.partition_name 
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(the_date,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') the_date,
  DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
    'CPU Usage (GHz)',AVG(avg_cpu_usage_ghz),
    'CPU Usage%',AVG(avg_cpu_usage_pct),
    'CPU Wait (ms)',AVG(avg_cpu_wait_ms),
    'CPU Ready (ms)',AVG(avg_cpu_ready_ms)
  ) AS avg_the_metric,
  DECODE('${freeCombo1}',
    'CPU Usage (GHz)',MAX(max_cpu_usage_ghz),
    'CPU Usage%',MAX(max_cpu_usage_pct),
    'CPU Wait (ms)',MAX(max_cpu_wait_ms),
    'CPU Ready (ms)',MAX(max_cpu_ready_ms)
  ) AS max_the_metric
FROM 
  c1
GROUP BY
  TO_CHAR(the_date,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI')
ORDER BY 
  the_date

title: VM Guest Disk Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 07/26/2018
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting VM Guest Disk Paths
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.partition_id the_id_1, 
l.disk_path the_id_2,
MAX(ROUND(l.free_space_kb/div_by,2)) the_value
FROM
apt_v_vmw_vmguest_disk_log l,apt_v_partition p, var
WHERE l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.partition_id = p.partition_id
AND p.partition_id IN (${vmGuests})
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.partition_id, 
l.disk_path
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC),2) first_value, 
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC),2) last_value,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0),2) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
f2.first_value, 
f2.last_date,
f2.last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
f2.the_value_lin,
f2.sum_of_the_value,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_lin,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
--
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop >= 0 
    THEN 9999 
END days_left_pop,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2, var
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
t1 AS (--Format the final Output
SELECT
f3.the_id_1 partition_id,
p.partition_name,
f3.the_id_2,
s1.the_spk,
f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Not Changed'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, apt_v_partition p
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = p.partition_id
)
SELECT * 
FROM t1
WHERE usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}')
AND nbr_of_days >= ${freeCombo3}
ORDER BY days_left_pop ASC

title: VM Guest Disk Writes Heat Map
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 12/17/2014 WITH t1 AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(l.start_log_date,'HH24'),'YY/MM/DD HH24') the_date, l.partition_id, l.partition_name, SUM(l.nbr_of_disk_write) nbr_of_disk_write, ROUND((RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(l.nbr_of_disk_write)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.partition_id, l.partition_name))*100,2) rr_nbr_of_disk_write FROM apt_v_vmw_perform_disk_log l, apt_v_partition p WHERE l.start_log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} AND l.partition_id = p.partition_id AND p.host_id IN (${hosts}) AND l.partition_type = 'VM' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(l.start_log_date,'HH24'),'YY/MM/DD HH24'), l.partition_id, l.partition_name ORDER BY 1,2 ), t2 AS (--Rank them SELECT the_date, partition_id, partition_name, nbr_of_disk_write, rr_nbr_of_disk_write, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY partition_id, partition_name ORDER BY nbr_of_disk_write) dr_nbr_of_disk_write FROM t1 ORDER BY 1,2 ), t3 AS (--Assign colors to the rankings SELECT the_date, partition_id, partition_name, nbr_of_disk_write, rr_nbr_of_disk_write, dr_nbr_of_disk_write, CASE WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '#FBEFEF' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN '#F6CECE' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 10 AND 15 THEN '#F78181' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 15 AND 20 THEN '#FE2E2E' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 20 AND 25 THEN '#DF0101' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 25 AND 30 THEN '#B40404' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 30 AND 35 THEN '#8A0808' WHEN dr_nbr_of_disk_write BETWEEN 35 AND 100 THEN '#610B0B' ELSE '#FBEFEF' END cell_color FROM t2 ORDER BY 1,2 ) SELECT the_date, partition_id, partition_name, nbr_of_disk_write, rr_nbr_of_disk_write, dr_nbr_of_disk_write, '
'||nbr_of_disk_write||'
' heatmap FROM t3 ORDER BY 1,2

title: VM Guest Memory Stats Sparklines
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@veritas.com
--Last Modified: 04/01/2020
WITH 
c1 AS (
SELECT
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')) AS the_date,
  p.partition_id,
  p.partition_name,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_memory_usage_kb/1024,0)/1000),2) mem_usage_gb,
  ROUND(MAX(NVL(l.avg_memory_usage_pct,0)),2) mem_usage_pct
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_perform_memory_log l, apt_v_partition p
WHERE 
  p.partition_id IN (${vmGuests})
  AND p.partition_id = l.partition_id
  AND l.end_log_date  BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND p.collection_status != 3
  AND p.partition_type = 'VM'
GROUP BY 
  TRUNC(l.end_log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Minutes','MI','Hours','HH24','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years')),
  p.partition_id,
  p.partition_name
),
s1 AS (--Generate Sparklines
SELECT
  c1.partition_id,
  c1.partition_name,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(mem_usage_gb,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS mem_usage_gb_spk,
  rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(mem_usage_pct,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') AS mem_usage_pct_spk
FROM 
  c1
GROUP BY 
  c1.partition_id,
  c1.partition_name
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
  c1.partition_id,
  MAX(c1.mem_usage_gb) AS max_mem_usage_gb,
  MAX(c1.mem_usage_pct) AS max_mem_usage_pct,
  AVG(c1.mem_usage_gb) AS avg_mem_usage_gb,
  AVG(c1.mem_usage_pct) AS avg_mem_usage_pct
FROM
  c1
GROUP BY 
  c1.partition_id
),
t2 AS (
SELECT
  s1.partition_id,
  s1.partition_name,
  s1.mem_usage_gb_spk,
  t1.max_mem_usage_gb,
  t1.avg_mem_usage_gb,
  s1.mem_usage_pct_spk,
  t1.max_mem_usage_pct,
  t1.avg_mem_usage_pct
FROM
  s1, t1
WHERE
  s1.partition_id = t1.partition_id
ORDER BY 
  t1.max_mem_usage_gb DESC
)
SELECT *
FROM t2
WHERE
  rownum <= ${freeCombo2}

title: VM Guest NetApp SnapVault Lag Time Status
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 09/20/2011
--Maps the VM Guests to their Datastores then displays the source and destination
--of the filers SnapVaults.  The threshold for the lag time can be set at runtime 
--to trigger the color change of the status dot. 
WITH 
ds AS (
SELECT vm.partition_id, 
  vm.host_name,
  ds.vmw_datastore_id, ds.datastore_name
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_virtual_machine vm, apt_v_vmw_datastore ds, apt_v_partition p
WHERE vm.partition_id = p.partition_id
  AND p.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vm.vmw_datastore_id = ds.vmw_datastore_id
  AND vm.guest_state = 'running'
  AND vm.host_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ds.partition_id, 
  ds.host_name,
  ss.nap_snapvault_status_id,
  ss.mirror_timestamp, 
  DECODE(ss.summary_status,0,'blue',1,'yellow',2,'red') summary_status,
  rtd.secsToHoursMinSecs(ss.lag_time) lag_time,
  CASE 
    WHEN ss.lag_time/60/60 < ${freeCombo1} THEN 'green'
    WHEN ss.lag_time/60/60 > ${freeCombo1} AND ss.lag_time/60/60 < ${freeCombo2} THEN 'yellow' 
    WHEN ss.lag_time/60/60 > ${freeCombo2} THEN 'red'
  END lag_time_status,
  ds.vmw_datastore_id, 
  ds.datastore_name,
  sc.source_storage_system_id,
  sc.source_system_name,
  sc.source_volume_id,
  sc.source_volume_name,
  sc.source_qtree_id, 
  sc.source_qtree_name, 
  sc.destination_storage_system_id,
  sc.destination_system_name,
  sc.destination_volume_id, 
  sc.destination_volume_name 
FROM ds, aps_v_nap_snapvault_status ss, aps_v_nap_snapvault_config sc, 
  aps_v_storage_array src, aps_v_storage_array dest  
WHERE ss.nap_snapvault_config_id       = sc.nap_snapvault_config_id
  AND sc.source_storage_system_id      = src.storage_array_id 
  AND sc.destination_storage_system_id = dest.storage_array_id
  AND ss.mirror_timestamp BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND ss.summary_status IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.source_system_name LIKE DECODE('${queryCombo1}',' All','%','${queryCombo1}')
  AND instr(sc.source_volume_name,ds.datastore_name,1,1) > 0

title: VM Guest Snapshot Summary
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@veritas.com --Last Updated: 05/11/2020 WITH VAR AS ( SELECT ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, ${startDate} startDate, DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by, '${freeCombo1}' the_unit FROM apt_v_dual ), t1 AS ( SELECT vs.virtual_system_id AS vm_host_id, vs.virtual_system_name AS vm_host_name, pt.partition_id AS vm_id, pt.partition_name AS vm_name, h.host_id, h.display_name AS host_name, ds.vmw_datastore_id, ds.datastore_name, df.file_name, st.full_snapshot_name||' ('||st.short_snapshot_name||')' AS snapshot_name, df.size_kb/div_by AS df_size, st.create_date, (sysdate - create_date) AS age FROM var, apt_v_vmw_vmsnapshot_tree st, apt_v_vmw_map_snapshot_file mp, apt_v_vmw_datastore_file df, apt_v_vmw_datastore ds, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_partition pt, aps_v_host h WHERE pt.host_id IN (${hosts}) AND pt.host_id = h.host_id AND pt.partition_id= st.partition_id AND st.vmw_snapshot_id= mp.vmw_snapshot_id AND mp.vmw_datastore_file_id= df.vmw_datastore_file_id AND df.vmw_datastore_id = ds.vmw_datastore_id AND st.virtual_system_id = vs.virtual_system_id AND vs.collection_status != 3 AND st.create_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate} ORDER BY df.file_name, st.create_date ) SELECT vm_host_id, vm_host_name, vm_id, vm_name, host_id, host_name, vmw_datastore_id, datastore_name, REPLACE(aptStringConcat(file_name),',','
') files, snapshot_name, SUM(df_size) AS df_size, create_date, age FROM t1 GROUP BY vm_host_id, vm_host_name, vm_id, vm_name, host_id, host_name, vmw_datastore_id, datastore_name, snapshot_name, create_date, age ORDER BY UPPER(vm_name)

)

t1.vm_guest_name,

CASE 
WHEN upper(t1.os) LIKE '%WINDOWS%' THEN 'Windows'

WHEN upper(t1.os) LIKE '%VMNIX-X86%' THEN 'ESX'

host_free_gb,
rd.rdisk_capacity_gb raw_fs_capacity

        WHEN upper(t1.os) LIKE '%LINUX%' THEN 'Linux'
        WHEN upper(t1.os) LIKE '%VMNIX-X86%' THEN 'ESX'
        WHEN upper(t1.os) LIKE '%AIX%' THEN 'AIX'
      END
   ELSE 'All'
 END

title: VM Orphaned LUNs
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/11/2017
WITH 
  a0 AS (--Get the VM physical disks associated with datastores
  SELECT 
    e.vmw_physical_disk_id,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT e.vmw_datastore_id) AS vmw_datastore_id,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT e.datastore_name)   AS datastore_name
  FROM apt_v_vmw_extent e
  GROUP BY e.vmw_physical_disk_id
  ),
  a1 AS (--Get the host disk IDs of LUNS that are mapped
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    lm.host_disk_id,
    sp.logical_unit_id,
    sp.logical_unit_name,
    sp.total_capacity_kb/1024/1024 AS lun_capacity_gb,
    sp.storage_array_id,
    sp.array_name
  FROM aps_v_lun_mapping lm,
    aps_v_storage_path sp
  WHERE lm.hba_port_id    = sp.host_port_id
  AND lm.array_port_id    = sp.array_port_id
  AND lm.scsi_os_lun_nbr  = sp.lun_nbr
  ) ,
  a2 AS (--Get all the physical disks that 
  SELECT 
    vc.container_name AS virtual_center_name,
    c.vmw_cluster_id,
    c.cluster_name,
    pd.virtual_system_id,
    vs.virtual_system_name,
    h.host_name,
    a0.vmw_datastore_id,
    a0.datastore_name,
    pd.canonical_name,
    --ft.lun_nbr AS scsi_os_lun_nbr,
    a1.logical_unit_name,
    a1.logical_unit_id,
    a1.lun_capacity_gb,
    a1.storage_array_id,
    a1.array_name,
    pd.capacity_kb
  FROM apt_v_vmw_physical_disk pd,
    a0,
    apt_v_virtual_system vs,
    apt_v_vmw_cluster c,
    --apt_vmw_fc_target ft,
    apt_v_vmw_container vc,
    a1,
    aps_v_host h
  WHERE pd.virtual_system_id  = vs.virtual_system_id
  AND vs.virtual_center_id    = vc.virtual_center_id
  AND vs.host_id              = h.host_id
  AND vc.container_type       = 'virtualCenter'
  AND vs.vmw_cluster_id       = c.vmw_cluster_id (+)
  AND pd.vmw_physical_disk_id = a0.vmw_physical_disk_id (+)
  --AND pd.vmw_physical_disk_id = ft.vmw_physical_disk_id (+)
  AND pd.host_disk_id         = a1.host_disk_id (+)
  AND pd.operational_state    = 'ok'
  ),
  a3 AS (
  SELECT 
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.virtual_center_name)                                                AS virtual_center_name,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.vmw_cluster_id)                                                     AS vmw_cluster_id,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.cluster_name)                                                       AS cluster_name,
    upper(aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.virtual_system_name) )                                        AS virtual_system_group,
    upper(aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.host_name) )                                                  AS host_group,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.vmw_datastore_id)                                                   AS vmw_datastore_id,
    aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.datastore_name)                                                     AS datastore_name,
    NVL(aptstringconcat(DISTINCT vd.partition_name) , aptstringconcat(DISTINCT vd2.partition_name)) AS VM,
    a2.canonical_name,
    --aptstringconcat(DISTINCT a2.scsi_os_lun_nbr) AS scsi_os_lun_nbr,
    a2.logical_unit_name,
    a2.logical_unit_id,
    a2.storage_array_id,
    a2.array_name,
    NVL(ROUND(a2.capacity_kb/1024/1024,2),0)                                              AS canonical_capacity_gb,
    ROUND(a2.lun_capacity_gb,2)                                                           AS lun_capacity_gb,

sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 04/16/2020
--Forecasting Framework II Future value
--Similar to original framework except rather than telling you when you will run out
--It tells you what a value will be in the future
--Better for computing usage rates
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',(1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --
TRUNC(l.start_log_date) the_date,
vs.virtual_system_id the_id_1,
1 the_id_2 ,
MAX(l.avg_cpu_usage_pct) the_value
FROM 
apt_v_vmw_perform_cpu_log l, apt_v_partition P, apt_v_virtual_system vs
WHERE
vs.virtual_system_id IN (${vmServers})
AND vs.virtual_system_id = p.virtual_system_id
AND p.partition_id = l.partition_id
AND l.start_log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND l.partition_type = 'HOST'
GROUP BY 
TRUNC(l.start_log_date),
vs.virtual_system_id
ORDER BY 1
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) the_value_lin,
REGR_R2(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) the_r2_value_lin,
(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
ROUND(f2.first_value,2) first_value, 
f2.last_date,
ROUND(f2.last_value,2) last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
ROUND(f2.the_value_lin,2) the_value_lin,
ROUND(f2.the_r2_value_lin,2) the_r2_value_lin,
ROUND(f2.sum_of_the_value,2) sum_of_the_value,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_lin*30)),2) lin_30_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_lin*180)),2) lin_180_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_lin*365)),2) lin_365_day_forecast,
ROUND(f2.the_value_pop,2) the_value_pop,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_pop*30)),2) pop_30_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_pop*180)),2) pop_180_day_forecast,
ROUND((f2.last_value + (f2.the_value_pop*365)),2) pop_365_day_forecast
FROM f2
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
s2 AS (-- Trend sparklines
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(f2.last_value + (f1.row_number * f2.the_value_lin),2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') lin_spk,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(f2.last_value + (f1.row_number * f2.the_value_pop),2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') pop_spk
FROM f1,f2
WHERE
f1.the_id_1 = f2.the_id_1
AND f1.the_id_2 = f2.the_id_2
GROUP BY 
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2
),
final AS (
SELECT
vc.vmw_cluster_id,
vc.cluster_name,
f3.the_id_1 virtual_system_id,
vs.virtual_system_name,
s1.the_spk,
f3.first_date, 
f3.last_date,
f3.nbr_of_days,
ROUND(f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0),2) avg_avail,
f3.first_value,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_r2_value_lin,
s2.lin_spk,
f3.the_value_pop,
s2.pop_spk,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Did Not Change'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'trend_down'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'trend_flat'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'trend_up'
END trend_icon,
lin_30_day_forecast,
lin_180_day_forecast,
lin_365_day_forecast,
pop_30_day_forecast,
pop_180_day_forecast,
pop_365_day_forecast
FROM f3, s1, s2, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_cluster vc
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = s2.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s2.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = vs.virtual_system_id
AND vs.vmw_cluster_id = vc.vmw_cluster_id (+)
ORDER BY 
vs.virtual_system_name,
f3.the_id_2
)
SELECT * 
FROM final
WHERE 
  usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo1}',' All','%','${freeCombo1}')
  AND rownum <= ${freeCombo2}
ORDER BY
  the_value_lin_pct DESC

FROM f3, s1, s2, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_cluster vc

title: VM Stats vs Last Month
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 04/30/2020
--Compare VMWare metrics today vs same time last month
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT 
  '${freeCombo1}' unit,
  DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by,
  ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'MM'),-1) p_first, 
  LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(sysdate,-1)) p_last, 
  ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(sysdate,'DD'),-1) p_day,
  TRUNC(sysdate,'MM') c_first, 
  LAST_DAY(sysdate) c_last,
  TRUNC(sysdate,'DD') c_day
FROM apt_v_dual
),
p0 AS (--Previous Period
SELECT
  p.parent_partition_id, 
  l.partition_id, 
  MAX(l.host_memory_usage_kb/div_by) host_memory_usage,
  MAX(l.overall_cpu_usage) overall_cpu_usage,
  MAX(l.nbr_cpu) nbr_cpu
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_partition_stats_log l, apt_v_partition p, var
WHERE 
  p.partition_id = l.partition_id
  AND p.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND l.log_date BETWEEN p_first AND p_day
GROUP BY 
  p.parent_partition_id, 
  l.partition_id
),
p1 AS (
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT parent_partition_id) parent_partitions, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT partition_id) partitions, 
  ROUND(SUM(host_memory_usage),2) host_memory_usage,
  ROUND(SUM(overall_cpu_usage),2) overall_cpu_usage,
  ROUND(SUM(nbr_cpu),2) nbr_cpu
FROM 
  p0
),
c0 AS (--Current Period
SELECT
  p.parent_partition_id, 
  l.partition_id, 
  MAX(l.host_memory_usage_kb/div_by) host_memory_usage,
  MAX(l.overall_cpu_usage) overall_cpu_usage,
  MAX(l.nbr_cpu) nbr_cpu
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_partition_stats_log l, apt_v_partition p, var
WHERE 
  p.partition_id = l.partition_id
  AND p.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND l.log_date BETWEEN c_first AND c_day
GROUP BY 
p.parent_partition_id, 
l.partition_id
),
c1 AS (
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT parent_partition_id) parent_partitions, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT partition_id) partitions, 
  ROUND(SUM(host_memory_usage),2) host_memory_usage,
  ROUND(SUM(overall_cpu_usage),2) overall_cpu_usage,
  ROUND(SUM(nbr_cpu),2) nbr_cpu
FROM 
  c0
)
SELECT
0 sort_order,
'ESX Servers' metric,
p1.parent_partitions p_value,
c1.parent_partitions c_value, 
(c1.parent_partitions - p1.parent_partitions) delta, 
ROUND((c1.parent_partitions - p1.parent_partitions) / DECODE(p1.parent_partitions,0,NULL,p1.parent_partitions),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.parent_partitions - p1.parent_partitions) / DECODE(p1.parent_partitions,0,NULL,p1.parent_partitions),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1
UNION
SELECT
1 sort_order,
'VM Guests' metric,
p1.partitions p_value,
c1.partitions c_value, 
(c1.partitions - p1.partitions) delta, 
ROUND((c1.partitions - p1.partitions) / DECODE(p1.partitions,0,NULL,p1.partitions),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.partitions - p1.partitions) / DECODE(p1.partitions,0,NULL,p1.partitions),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var
UNION
SELECT 
2 sort_order,
'VM Guests Memory Usage'||' ('||var.unit||')' metric,
p1.host_memory_usage p_value,
c1.host_memory_usage c_value, 
(c1.host_memory_usage - p1.host_memory_usage) delta, 
ROUND((c1.host_memory_usage - p1.host_memory_usage) / DECODE(p1.host_memory_usage,0,NULL,p1.host_memory_usage),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.host_memory_usage - p1.host_memory_usage) / DECODE(p1.host_memory_usage,0,NULL,p1.host_memory_usage),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var
UNION
SELECT 
3 sort_order,
'VM Guests CPU Use Mhz' metric,
p1.overall_cpu_usage p_value,
c1.overall_cpu_usage c_value, 
(c1.overall_cpu_usage - p1.overall_cpu_usage) delta, 
ROUND((c1.overall_cpu_usage - p1.overall_cpu_usage) / DECODE(p1.overall_cpu_usage,0,NULL,p1.overall_cpu_usage),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.overall_cpu_usage - p1.overall_cpu_usage) / DECODE(p1.overall_cpu_usage,0,NULL,p1.overall_cpu_usage),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var
UNION
SELECT 
4 sort_order,
'VM Guests # of vCPUs' metric,
p1.nbr_cpu p_value,
c1.nbr_cpu c_value, 
(c1.nbr_cpu - p1.nbr_cpu) delta, 
ROUND((c1.nbr_cpu - p1.nbr_cpu) / DECODE(p1.nbr_cpu,0,NULL,p1.nbr_cpu),2) delta_pct,
ABS(ROUND((c1.nbr_cpu - p1.nbr_cpu) / DECODE(p1.nbr_cpu,0,NULL,p1.nbr_cpu),2)) pct_delta
FROM p1, c1, var

title: vSphere Cluster Datastore Multi-Metric Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 09/13/2018
--Forecasting Framework
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT
DECODE('${freeCombo1}','KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual
),
--
--For each entry in the log, put here
-- NOTE: Substitute log_date as the_date and xxxxx_id as the_id and xxxxxx_value as the_value
f0 AS (-- Forecasting begins here. First, get 1 entry per day
SELECT --Forecasting VM Datastore Usage over time
TRUNC(l.log_date) the_date,
l.vmw_datastore_id the_id_1,
0 the_id_2,
MAX(l.free_capacity_kb/div_by) the_value
FROM
apt_v_vmw_datastore_log l, var
WHERE
l.vmw_datastore_id IN (${datastores}) 
AND REGEXP_LIKE(l.datastore_name,'${freeText2}')
AND l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
TRUNC(l.log_date),
l.vmw_datastore_id
),
--
--Everything from here down is calculated for you nothing else to do
--Except any final joins at the very end to pull in additional columns
--
f1 AS (--This step provides the row number needed to make the REGR_SLOPE() function to work properly
SELECT
the_date,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2) row_number,
the_id_1,
the_id_2,
the_value
FROM f0
ORDER BY the_id_1,
the_id_2, the_date
),
f2 AS (--This is the actual code block for calculating trends
SELECT DISTINCT
the_id_1, 
the_id_2,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) nbr_of_days,
SUM(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2) sum_of_the_value,
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date, 
FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC),2) first_value, 
ROUND(FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC),2) last_value,
ROUND(REGR_SLOPE(the_value, row_number) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),2) the_value_lin,
ROUND((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2 ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY the_id_1, the_id_2),0),2) the_value_pop
FROM f1
ORDER BY the_id_1, the_id_2
),
f3 AS (--Format the results of the forecast 
SELECT
f2.the_id_1,
f2.the_id_2,
f2.first_date, 
f2.first_value, 
f2.last_date,
f2.last_value,
f2.nbr_of_days,
f2.the_value_lin,
f2.sum_of_the_value,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_lin,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_lin),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_lin > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END lin_run_out_date,
f2.the_value_pop,
--
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0 --Capacity is Decreasing 
    THEN (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop >= 0 
    THEN 9999
END days_left_pop,
CASE 
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop < 0
    THEN
      CASE --only show a run out date if less than 3 years from now
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) > 1095
          THEN 'Will Last Over 3 Years'
        WHEN  (f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) < 1095
          THEN 'Will Run Out on '|| ((f2.last_value/NULLIF(ABS(f2.the_value_pop),0)) + sysdate) 
      END
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop = 0 
    THEN 'Capacity not Changing'
  WHEN f2.the_value_pop > 0 
    THEN 'Capacity is Increasing'
END pop_run_out_date
FROM f2, var
),
--Forecasting ends here
s1 AS (-- Generate sparklines
SELECT
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2,
rtd.collectString(CAST(COLLECT(TO_CHAR(ROUND(the_value,2)) ORDER BY the_date) AS StringListType),', ') the_spk
FROM f1
GROUP BY 
f1.the_id_1,
f1.the_id_2
),
t1 AS (--Format the final Output
SELECT DISTINCT
vc.vmw_cluster_id,
NVL(vc.cluster_name,'Not Clustered') cluster_name,
f3.the_id_1 vmw_datastore_id,
d.datastore_name,
f3.the_id_2,
s1.the_spk,
f3.sum_of_the_value/NULLIF(f3.nbr_of_days,0) avg_avail,
f3.nbr_of_days,
f3.first_date, 
f3.first_value, 
f3.last_date,
f3.last_value,
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value) avail_delta, 
(f3.last_value - f3.first_value)/NULLIF(f3.first_value,0)*100 avail_delta_pct,
f3.the_value_lin,
f3.the_value_pop,
f3.the_value_lin/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_lin_pct,
f3.the_value_pop/NULLIF((f3.sum_of_the_value/f3.nbr_of_days),0)*100 the_value_pop_pct,
CASE 
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) < 0 THEN 'Decreased'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) = 0 THEN 'Not Changed'
WHEN (f3.last_value - f3.first_value) > 0 THEN 'Increased'
END usage_name,
f3.days_left_lin,
f3.lin_run_out_date,
f3.days_left_pop,
f3.pop_run_out_date
FROM f3, s1, apt_v_vmw_datastore d, apt_v_vmw_map_vsys_dtstore dm, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_cluster vc
WHERE f3.the_id_1 = s1.the_id_1
AND f3.the_id_2 = s1.the_id_2
AND f3.the_id_1 = d.vmw_datastore_id
AND d.vmw_datastore_id = dm.vmw_datastore_id (+)
AND dm.virtual_system_id = vs.virtual_system_id (+)
AND vs.vmw_cluster_id = vc.vmw_cluster_id (+)
AND REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(vc.cluster_name,'Not Clustered'),'${freeText1}')
)
SELECT * 
FROM t1
WHERE 
usage_name LIKE DECODE('${freeCombo2}','All','%','${freeCombo2}')
AND nbr_of_days >= ${freeCombo3}
ORDER BY NVL(days_left_pop,0) ASC
