title: vSphere Cluster Hardware Summary
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com --Last Modified: 05/23/2018 WITH g1 AS ( SELECT vc.vmw_cluster_id, COUNT(DISTINCT vs.virtual_system_id) esx_host_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.partition_id) guest_count, SUM(p.memory_size_kb/1024/1024) vmemory_size, SUM(p.nbr_cpu) nbr_vcpu FROM apt_v_partition p, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_cluster vc WHERE vs.host_id IN (${hosts}) AND vc.vmw_cluster_id = vs.vmw_cluster_id AND vs.virtual_system_id = p.virtual_system_id AND p.partition_type = 'VM' GROUP BY vc.vmw_cluster_id ), t1 AS ( SELECT vc.vmw_cluster_id, vc.cluster_name, vh.system_vendor||' '||vh.system_model||' '||cpu_description hardware, COUNT(*) hardware_count, SUM((vc.total_memory_kb/1024/1024) / vc.nbr_of_hosts) total_memory_gb, SUM((vc.total_memory_kb/1024/1024) / vc.nbr_of_hosts) / MAX(vc.nbr_of_hosts) avg_memory_per_host, SUM(vc.nbr_of_cpu_cores / vc.nbr_of_hosts) nbr_of_cpu_cores FROM apt_v_vmw_cluster vc,apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_hardware vh WHERE vs.host_id IN (${hosts}) AND vs.vmw_cluster_id = vc.vmw_cluster_id AND vs.virtual_system_id = vh.virtual_system_id GROUP BY vc.vmw_cluster_id, vc.cluster_name, vh.system_vendor||' '||vh.system_model||' '||cpu_description ), t2 AS ( SELECT t1.vmw_cluster_id, t1.cluster_name, REPLACE(aptStringConcat(DISTINCT t1.hardware),',','
') hardware, SUM(t1.hardware_count) hardware_count, SUM(t1.total_memory_gb) total_memory_gb, MAX(avg_memory_per_host) avg_memory_per_host, SUM(t1.nbr_of_cpu_cores) nbr_of_cpu_cores FROM t1 GROUP BY vmw_cluster_id, cluster_name ) SELECT t2.vmw_cluster_id, t2.cluster_name, t2.hardware, t2.hardware_count, t2.total_memory_gb, t2.avg_memory_per_host, t2.nbr_of_cpu_cores, g1.esx_host_count, g1.guest_count, g1.nbr_vcpu, g1.vmemory_size, g1.vmemory_size/t2.total_memory_gb*100 memory_pct, g1.vmemory_size/t2.total_memory_gb pct_memory FROM g1, t2 WHERE t2.vmw_cluster_id = g1.vmw_cluster_id (+) ORDER BY t2.cluster_name

title: vSphere Cluster LUN stats
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 11/07/2016
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT
ROUND((${endDate} - ${startDate}),2) nbrOfDays, 
${startDate} startDate, 
'${freeCombo1}' unit,
DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'KB',1,'MB',1024,'GB',(1024*1024),'TB',(1024*1024*1024),'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by 
FROM apt_v_dual 
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
vc.vmw_cluster_id,
vc.cluster_name,
vs.virtual_system_id,
sp.logical_unit_id
FROM apt_v_vmw_cluster vc, apt_v_virtual_system vs, aps_v_storage_path sp
WHERE vc.vmw_cluster_id = vs.vmw_cluster_id
AND vs.host_id = sp.host_id
AND vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
),
t2 AS ( --Unique LUNs per Cluster
SELECT
DISTINCT
vmw_cluster_id,
cluster_name,
logical_unit_id
FROM t1
),
l1 AS (--Get all the LUNs
SELECT
t2.vmw_cluster_id,
t2.cluster_name,
t2.logical_unit_id,
lu.storage_array_id,
lu.array_name,
lu.logical_unit_name,
lu.total_capacity_kb
FROM t2, aps_v_logical_unit lu
WHERE t2.logical_unit_id = lu.logical_unit_id
),
p1 AS (--Get the performance stats
SELECT
t2.logical_unit_id,
SUM(pl.kbytes_read) read,
SUM(pl.kbytes_written) written,
SUM(pl.total_io) total_io,
AVG(pl.read_io_response_time) avg_read_io_response_time,
MAX(pl.read_io_response_time) max_read_io_response_time,
AVG(pl.write_io_response_time) avg_write_io_response_time,
MAX(pl.write_io_response_time) max_write_io_response_time
FROM t2, aps_v_lun_perform_log pl
WHERE t2.logical_unit_id = pl.logical_unit_id
AND log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
GROUP BY
t2.logical_unit_id
)
SELECT
l1.vmw_cluster_id,
l1.cluster_name,
l1.storage_array_id,
l1.array_name,
COUNT(l1.logical_unit_id) nbr_of_luns,
aptStringConcat(DISTINCT l1.logical_unit_id) logical_unit_ids,
SUM(l1.total_capacity_kb/div_by) lun_capacity,
SUM(p1.read/div_by) read,
SUM(p1.written/div_by) written,
SUM(p1.total_io/div_by) total_io,
AVG(p1.avg_read_io_response_time) avg_read_io_response_time,
MAX(p1.max_read_io_response_time) max_read_io_response_time,
AVG(p1.avg_write_io_response_time) avg_write_io_response_time,
MAX(p1.max_write_io_response_time) max_write_io_response_time
FROM l1, p1, var
WHERE l1.logical_unit_id = p1.logical_unit_id(+) 
GROUP BY
l1.vmw_cluster_id,
l1.cluster_name,
l1.storage_array_id,
l1.array_name
--Uncomment to show only ones with perf data collection
--HAVING SUM(p1.total_io/div_by) > 0
ORDER BY l1.cluster_name

title: vSphere Cluster Memory Future Demand Forecast
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/31/2020
WITH 
var AS (
SELECT 
  DECODE('${queryCombo1}','95%',.95,'90%',.90,'85%',.85,'80%',.80,'75%',.75,'70%',.70) pct_1,
  DECODE('${queryCombo2}','95%',.95,'90%',.90,'85%',.85,'80%',.80,'75%',.75,'70%',.70) pct_2,
  DECODE('${freeCombo1}','GB',1,'TB',1024,'PB',1024*1024) div_by,
  DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days',1,'Weeks',7,'Months',31,'Quarters',93,'Years',365.25) day_multiplier,
  TO_NUMBER('${freeCombo3}') forecast_periods
FROM apt_v_dual
),
/***********************************************/
l1 AS (--First get 1 entry per period
SELECT DISTINCT
  TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years','YY')) log_date,
  vs.vmw_cluster_id,
  l.virtual_system_id,
  l.partition_id,
  l.partition_type,
  MAX(l.nbr_cpu) nbr_cpu,
  MAX(l.host_memory_usage_kb) host_memory_usage_kb,
  MAX(l.guest_memory_usage_kb) guest_memory_usage_kb,
  MAX(l.memory_size_kb) memory_size_kb,
  MAX(l.overall_cpu_usage) overall_cpu_usage
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_partition_stats_log l, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_cluster vc
WHERE
  vc.vmw_cluster_id = vs.vmw_cluster_id
  AND vs.virtual_system_id = l.virtual_system_id
  AND l.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
  AND vs.data_center_name||' - '||vc.cluster_name LIKE '${queryCombo3}'
GROUP BY 
  TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days','DD','Weeks','WW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years','YY')),
  vs.vmw_cluster_id,
  l.virtual_system_id,
  l.partition_id,
  l.partition_type
),
l2 AS (
SELECT
  l1.log_date,
  vs.vmw_cluster_id,
  l1.virtual_system_id,
  SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'VM',1,0)) nbr_vms,
  SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'HOST',nbr_cpu,0)) nbr_hcpu,
  SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'VM',nbr_cpu,0)) nbr_vcpu,
  ROUND(SUM(host_memory_usage_kb/1024/1024),2) host_mem_used,
  ROUND(SUM(guest_memory_usage_kb/1024/1024),2) guest_mem_used,
  ROUND(SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'HOST',memory_size_kb/1024/1024,0)),2) host_mem_size,
  ROUND(SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'VM',memory_size_kb/1024/1024,0)),2) guest_mem_size,
  SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'HOST',overall_cpu_usage,0)) host_cpu_usage,
  SUM(DECODE(l1.partition_type,'VM',overall_cpu_usage,0)) vm_cpu_usage
FROM 
  l1, apt_v_virtual_system vs
WHERE
  l1.virtual_system_id = vs.virtual_system_id
GROUP BY 
  l1.log_date,
  vs.vmw_cluster_id,
  l1.virtual_system_id
ORDER BY 2,3,1	
),
t1 AS (
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_date ASC) the_period,
  log_date the_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT vmw_cluster_id) nbr_vmw_clusters,
  COUNT(DISTINCT virtual_system_id) nbr_virtual_systems,
  TRUNC(SUM(nbr_hcpu)) nbr_hcpu,
  TRUNC(SUM(host_mem_used)) the_value,
  TRUNC(SUM(host_mem_size)) the_capacity,
  ROUND(SUM(host_mem_used) / NULLIF(SUM(host_mem_size),0) * 100,2) host_mem_pct_used,
  TRUNC(SUM(host_cpu_usage)) host_cpu_usage,
  TRUNC(SUM(nbr_vms)) nbr_vms,
  TRUNC(SUM(nbr_vcpu)) nbr_vcpu,
  TRUNC(SUM(guest_mem_used)) guest_mem_used,
  TRUNC(SUM(guest_mem_size)) guest_mem_size,
  ROUND(SUM(guest_mem_used) / NULLIF(SUM(guest_mem_size),0) * 100,2) guest_mem_pct_used,
  TRUNC(SUM(vm_cpu_usage)) vm_cpu_usage
FROM 
  l2
GROUP BY
  log_date
ORDER BY 
  log_date
),
f0 AS (--Gather the forecasting variables - This will return 1 row
SELECT DISTINCT
  COUNT(*) OVER () nbr_of_periods,
  MAX(the_capacity) OVER () max_the_capacity,
  MAX(the_value) OVER () max_of_the_value,
  FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_date,
  FIRST_VALUE(the_date) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_date,
  FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) first_value, 
  FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) last_value,
  REGR_INTERCEPT(the_value, the_period) OVER () lin_y_intercept,
  REGR_SLOPE(the_value, the_period) OVER () lin_slope,
  REGR_R2(the_value, the_period) OVER () r2_value,
  REGR_COUNT(the_value, the_period) OVER () r_count,
  (FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
  FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
  NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (),0) pop_slope,
  (FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) -
  (((FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date DESC) - 
  FIRST_VALUE(the_value) OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC)) /
  NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (),0))) * (COUNT(*) OVER ())) pop_y_intercept
FROM 
  t1
),
d0 AS (--Future Dates
SELECT 
f0.nbr_of_periods + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) the_period, 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY the_date ASC) the_future_period, --Will start as 1 in the future 
the_date the_date
FROM var, f0, TABLE(rtd.APTlistOfDates(f0.last_date+var.day_multiplier,f0.last_date+(var.forecast_periods*var.day_multiplier),DECODE('${freeCombo2}','Days',11,'Weeks',12,'Months',13,'Quarters',14,'Years',15))) the_dates
)
SELECT
'Past' the_tense,
t1.the_period,
TO_CHAR(t1.the_date,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS the_date,
f0.max_the_capacity,
ROUND(t1.the_value,2) the_past_value,
0 the_future_value,
(f0.max_the_capacity - t1.the_value)  available_capacity,
f0.max_the_capacity*pct_1 stop_allocating,
f0.max_the_capacity*pct_2 order_new,
f0.nbr_of_periods,
f0.max_of_the_value,
f0.first_date,
f0.last_date,
f0.first_value, 
f0.last_value,
f0.lin_slope,
f0.lin_y_intercept,
ROUND((t1.the_period * f0.lin_slope) + f0.lin_y_intercept,2) lin_trend_line, 
f0.pop_slope,
f0.pop_y_intercept,
ROUND((t1.the_period * f0.pop_slope) + f0.pop_y_intercept,2) pop_trend_line 
FROM f0, t1, var
UNION
SELECT
'Future' the_tense,
d0.the_period,
TO_CHAR(d0.the_date,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS the_date,
f0.max_the_capacity,
0 the_past_value,
ROUND(f0.last_value + (f0.lin_slope * d0.the_future_period),2) the_future_value,
f0.max_the_capacity - (f0.last_value + (f0.lin_slope * d0.the_future_period)) available_capacity,
f0.max_the_capacity*pct_1 stop_allocating,
f0.max_the_capacity*pct_2 order_new,
f0.nbr_of_periods,
f0.max_of_the_value,
f0.first_date,
f0.last_date,
f0.first_value, 
f0.last_value,
f0.lin_slope,
f0.lin_y_intercept,
ROUND((d0.the_period * f0.lin_slope) + f0.lin_y_intercept,2) lin_trend_line, 
f0.pop_slope,
f0.pop_y_intercept,
ROUND((d0.the_period * f0.pop_slope) + f0.pop_y_intercept,2) pop_trend_line 
FROM d0, f0, var
ORDER BY the_date

title: vSphere Cluster Stats Report
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Modified: 03/13/2020
WITH 
VAR AS (
SELECT
  '${freeCombo1}' unit,
  DECODE('${freeCombo1}', 'GB',1024*1024,'TB',1024*1024*1024,'PB',(1024*1024*1024*1024)) div_by
FROM apt_v_dual
),
cl1 AS (--Get the cluster stats
SELECT DISTINCT
  vc.vmw_cluster_id,
  vc.cluster_name,
  vc.overall_status,
  vc.nbr_of_cpu_cores nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores,
  vc.nbr_of_cpu_threads,
  vc.total_cpu_mhz,
  vc.nbr_of_hosts nbr_of_cl_hosts,
  vc.nbr_of_effective_hosts,
  vc.total_memory_kb/div_by total_cl_memory
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_cluster vc, apt_v_virtual_system vs, var
WHERE 
  vc.vmw_cluster_id = vs.vmw_cluster_id
  AND vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
),
rr0 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
  vmw_cluster_id,
  ROUND((RATIO_TO_REPORT(nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores) OVER ()),2) rr_cpu_cores,
  ROUND((RATIO_TO_REPORT(total_cl_memory) OVER ()),2) rr_total_cl_memory,
  ROUND((RATIO_TO_REPORT(nbr_of_cl_hosts) OVER ()),2) rr_nbr_of_cl_hosts
FROM 
  cl1
),
vs1 AS (--Get the ESX Server Stats
SELECT 
  vs.vmw_cluster_id, 
  COUNT(vs.virtual_system_id) nbr_of_vs,
  SUM(vs.tot_cpu) nbr_of_vs_cpus,
  SUM(vs.tot_memory_kb/div_by) total_vs_memory
FROM 
  apt_v_virtual_system  vs, var 
WHERE 
  vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vs.collection_status != 3 
GROUP BY 
  vs.vmw_cluster_id
),
vg1 AS (--Get the VM Guest stats
SELECT 
  vs.vmw_cluster_id, 
  COUNT(p.partition_id) nbr_of_vms, 
  SUM(p.nbr_cpu) nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  MIN(p.nbr_cpu) min_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  MAX(p.nbr_cpu) max_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  AVG(p.nbr_cpu) avg_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  SUM(p.memory_size_kb/div_by) total_vm_memory,
  MIN(p.memory_size_kb/div_by) min_vm_memory,
  MAX(p.memory_size_kb/div_by) max_vm_memory,
  AVG(p.memory_size_kb/div_by) avg_vm_memory 
FROM 
  apt_v_virtual_system  vs, apt_v_partition p, var 
WHERE 
  vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vs.virtual_system_id = p.virtual_system_id 
  AND vs.collection_status != 3 
  AND p.partition_type = 'VM' 
  AND p.power_state = 'poweredOn'
GROUP BY 
vs.vmw_cluster_id
),
ds0 AS (-- get the datastore capacity
SELECT DISTINCT 
  vs.vmw_cluster_id, 
  ds.vmw_datastore_id, 
  ds.tot_capacity_kb/div_by total_capacity, 
  ds.free_capacity_kb/div_by free_capacity
FROM 
  apt_v_vmw_map_vsys_dtstore md, apt_v_vmw_datastore ds, apt_v_virtual_system vs, var
WHERE 
  vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vs.virtual_system_id = md.virtual_system_id
  AND md.vmw_datastore_id  = ds.vmw_datastore_id
),
ds1 AS (
SELECT 
  vmw_cluster_id, 
  SUM(total_capacity)   ds_total_capacity, 
  SUM((total_capacity-free_capacity))  ds_used_capacity 
FROM 
  ds0
GROUP BY 
  vmw_cluster_id
),
rr1 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
  vmw_cluster_id,
  ROUND((RATIO_TO_REPORT(ds_total_capacity) OVER ()),2) rr_ds_total_capacity
FROM 
  ds1
),
vmdk AS ( --get the vmdk info
SELECT
  vs.vmw_cluster_id, 
  SUM(vf.file_size/div_by) total_vmdk_size,
  MIN(vf.file_size/div_by) min_vmdk_size,
  MAX(vf.file_size/div_by) max_vmdk_size,
  AVG(vf.file_size/div_by) avg_vmdk_size
FROM 
  apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_vmw_vmfile vf, var
WHERE 
  vs.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vf.host_id IN (${hosts})
  AND vs.virtual_system_id = vf.virtual_system_id
  AND vf.file_type = 'VmDisk'
  AND vs.collection_status != 3 
GROUP BY
  vs.vmw_cluster_id
),
FINAL AS (
SELECT
  cl1.vmw_cluster_id,
  cl1.cluster_name,
  cl1.overall_status,
  vg1.nbr_of_vms,
  cl1.nbr_of_cl_hosts,
  cl1.total_cl_memory,
  vs1.total_vs_memory,
  vg1.total_vm_memory,
  cl1.total_cl_memory - vg1.total_vm_memory avail_memory,
  vg1.total_vm_memory/cl1.total_cl_memory*100 memory_pct,
  vg1.total_vm_memory/cl1.total_cl_memory pct_memory,
  (cl1.total_cl_memory / cl1.nbr_of_cl_hosts) avg_memory_per_host,
  cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores,
  vs1.nbr_of_vs_cpus,
  vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus/cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores cpu_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN (vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus/cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores) >= 1 THEN 'red'
    WHEN (vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus/cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores) >= .5 THEN 'yellow'
    ELSE 'green'
  END cpu_ratio_dot,
  ds1.ds_used_capacity,
  ds1.ds_total_capacity - ds1.ds_used_capacity ds_free_capacity,
  ds1.ds_total_capacity,
  ds1.ds_used_capacity/ ds1.ds_total_capacity*100 ds_pct,
  ds1.ds_used_capacity/ ds1.ds_total_capacity pct_ds,
  rr0.rr_nbr_of_cl_hosts*100 rr_nbr_of_cl_hosts,
  rr0.rr_total_cl_memory*100 rr_total_cl_memory,
  rr0.rr_cpu_cores*100 rr_cpu_cores,
  rr1.rr_ds_total_capacity*100 rr_ds_total_capacity,
  vg1.min_vm_memory,
  vg1.max_vm_memory,
  vg1.avg_vm_memory,
  vmdk.min_vmdk_size,
  vmdk.max_vmdk_size,
  vmdk.avg_vmdk_size,
  vg1.min_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  vg1.max_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  vg1.avg_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  -- avail mem  / Avg Mem per VM = # VMs Avail Memory
  ((cl1.total_cl_memory - vg1.total_vm_memory) / (vg1.total_vm_memory / vg1.nbr_of_vms)) nbr_vms_memory,
  ((ds1.ds_total_capacity - ds1.ds_used_capacity) / (ds1.ds_used_capacity / vg1.nbr_of_vms)) nbr_vms_disk,
  ((cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores - vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus) / (vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus / vg1.nbr_of_vms)) nbr_vms_cpu,
  LEAST(
    ((cl1.total_cl_memory - vg1.total_vm_memory) / (vg1.total_vm_memory / vg1.nbr_of_vms)),
    ((cl1.nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores - vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus) / (vg1.nbr_of_vm_cpus / vg1.nbr_of_vms)),
    ((ds1.ds_total_capacity - ds1.ds_used_capacity) / (ds1.ds_used_capacity / vg1.nbr_of_vms))
  ) avail_vms,
  (cl1.total_cl_memory - vg1.total_vm_memory) - (cl1.total_cl_memory/cl1.nbr_of_cl_hosts) failover_avail_memory
FROM 
  cl1, rr0, rr1, vg1, ds1, vs1, vmdk
WHERE
  cl1.vmw_cluster_id = rr0.vmw_cluster_id
  AND cl1.vmw_cluster_id = vg1.vmw_cluster_id
  AND cl1.vmw_cluster_id = ds1.vmw_cluster_id
  AND cl1.vmw_cluster_id = rr1.vmw_cluster_id
  AND cl1.vmw_cluster_id = vs1.vmw_cluster_id
  AND cl1.vmw_cluster_id = vmdk.vmw_cluster_id
ORDER BY 2
)
SELECT
  vmw_cluster_id,
  cluster_name,
  overall_status,
  nbr_of_vms,
  nbr_of_cl_hosts,
  total_cl_memory,
  total_vs_memory,
  total_vm_memory,
  avail_memory,
  memory_pct,
  pct_memory,
  avg_memory_per_host,
  nbr_of_cl_cpu_cores,
  nbr_of_vs_cpus,
  nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  cpu_ratio,
  cpu_ratio_dot,
  ds_used_capacity,
  ds_free_capacity,
  ds_total_capacity,
  ds_pct,
  pct_ds,
  rr_nbr_of_cl_hosts,
  rr_total_cl_memory,
  rr_cpu_cores,
  rr_ds_total_capacity,
  min_vm_memory,
  max_vm_memory,
  avg_vm_memory,
  min_vmdk_size,
  max_vmdk_size,
  avg_vmdk_size,
  min_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  max_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  avg_nbr_of_vm_cpus,
  nbr_vms_memory,
  nbr_vms_disk,
  nbr_vms_cpu,
  avail_vms,
  failover_avail_memory
FROM
  final
ORDER BY 2,4

title: vSphere Cluster VM Guest Count over Time
sql_query:
--Author: rich.rose@aptare.com
--Last Updated: 10/23/2018
WITH 
t1 AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')) sort_order,
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'MM/DD/YYYY') log_date,
vs.virtual_system_id,
TRUNC(AVG(nbr_of_active_vms)) nbr_of_active_vms
FROM apt_v_vmw_cluster vc, apt_v_virtual_system vs, apt_v_virtual_system_log vsl
WHERE 
vc.vmw_cluster_id = vs.vmw_cluster_id
AND vs.virtual_system_id = vsl.virtual_system_id
AND vsl.log_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
AND vs.data_center_name||' - '||vc.cluster_name LIKE '${queryCombo1}'
GROUP BY
TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(log_date,DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Day','DD','Week','WW','Month','MM','Quarter','Q','Year','YY')),'MM/DD/YYYY'),
vs.virtual_system_id
)
SELECT
sort_order,
log_date,
COUNT(virtual_system_id) nbr_virtual_systems,
SUM(nbr_of_active_vms) nbr_of_active_vms
FROM 
t1
GROUP BY
sort_order,
log_date
ORDER BY 
sort_order ASC

title: NBU SQLServer DB Summary
sql_query:
-- Author:  ernie.bergan@veritas.com
-- Modified 2025/09/07
-- Excluded duplication jobs, changed to outer join from job to apt_v_nbu_policy_db_instance.policy_id
--
-- Modified 2024/04/25
-- Replaced aptstringconcat with LISTAGG and added solver hints for performance

-- Previously modified 2022/08/16
-- Added Schedule level

-- Previously Modified:  2022/05/20
-- Added date ranging logic and additional hidden fields to help guide drilldowns
-- Previously Modified:   2022/04/27
--
-- Summarizes best status achieved for MSSQL policies per user-specified time period.
-- Default grouping is per day, based on job start time.
-- Jobs that don't resolve to a SQL Server DB name are ignored.
-- Order is client_name, instance name, DB name, period (date)
--
WITH
/* 1) Seed jobs strictly by requested range (do not lose these) */
jobs_seed AS (
    SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
        server_id,
        job_id,
        parent_job_id,
        policy_id,
        policy_name,
        job_type_name,
        schedule_type_name,
        summary_status,
        vendor_status_name,
        client_id,
        client_host_name,
        nbu_job_id,
        parent_nbu_job_id,
        start_date,
        finish_date
    FROM apt_v_nbu_job_detail
    WHERE policy_type = 15
      AND start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
      AND client_id IN (${hosts})
      AND job_type NOT IN (107)
),

/* 2) Root mapping (hierarchy-safe). Scoped to same clients AND same server_ids for performance. */
seed_root AS (
    SELECT
        seed_job_id,
        MAX(job_id)         KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_job_id,
        MAX(summary_status) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_summary_status,
        MAX(start_date)     KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_start,
        MAX(finish_date)    KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_finish
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CONNECT_BY_ROOT d.job_id AS seed_job_id,
            d.job_id,
            d.summary_status,
            d.start_date,
            d.finish_date,
            LEVEL AS lvl
        FROM apt_v_nbu_job_detail d
        WHERE d.policy_type = 15
          AND d.client_id IN (${hosts})
          AND d.server_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT server_id FROM jobs_seed)
        START WITH d.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM jobs_seed)
        CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR d.parent_job_id = d.job_id
    )
    GROUP BY seed_job_id
),

/* 3) Parse DB name from job files into ONE row per job_id (prevents row explosion) */
job_file_parse AS (
    SELECT
        jf.job_id,
        MAX(parsed_db_name) KEEP (
            DENSE_RANK FIRST
            ORDER BY LENGTH(parsed_db_name) DESC, parsed_db_name ASC
        ) AS parsed_db_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            jf.job_id,
            CASE
                WHEN jf.pathname IS NULL THEN NULL

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') + 3,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') - 2)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') + 3,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') - 2)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') > 0
                 AND INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"%24ALL\"') = 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') + 10,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, ';TYPE=') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') - 10)))
            END AS parsed_db_name
        FROM apt_v_nbu_job_file jf
        JOIN jobs_seed j
          ON j.job_id = jf.job_id
        WHERE jf.pathname IS NOT NULL
          AND jf.pathname <> 'AUTOMATIC_DATABASE_BACKUP'
          AND (
                 INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') > 0
              OR (INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') > 0 AND INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"%24ALL\"') = 0)
          )
    ) jf
    WHERE parsed_db_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY job_id
),

/* 4) Policy instance fallback (can be many-per-policy; we only join when needed) */
policy_instances AS (
    SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
        policy_id,
        instance_name
    FROM apt_v_nbu_policy_db_instance
    WHERE instance_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY policy_id, instance_name
),

/* 5) Build the base set in ONE pass:
      - prefer parsed_db_name
      - else fall back to policy instance (only if no parsed name)
      - else UNKNOWN
*/
pretime_base AS (
    SELECT
        j.server_id,
        j.client_id,
        j.client_host_name,
        NVL(pi.instance_name, 'none') AS instance_name,
        NVL(fp.parsed_db_name, NVL(pi.instance_name, 'UNKNOWN')) AS db_name,

        j.policy_id,
        j.policy_name,
        j.job_type_name,
        j.schedule_type_name,
        j.summary_status,
        j.vendor_status_name,
        j.start_date,
        j.finish_date,

        sr.root_job_id,
        sr.root_summary_status,
        sr.root_start,
        sr.root_finish,

        TRUNC(
            j.start_date,
            DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Days','DD','Weeks','IW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years','YYYY')
        ) AS period
    FROM jobs_seed j
    LEFT JOIN seed_root sr
      ON sr.seed_job_id = j.job_id
    LEFT JOIN job_file_parse fp
      ON fp.job_id = j.job_id
    LEFT JOIN policy_instances pi
      ON pi.policy_id = j.policy_id
     AND fp.job_id IS NULL           -- only fallback to policy instances if no file-derived db name
),

/* 6) Stats aggregation */
pretime_stats AS (
    SELECT
        server_id,
        client_id,
        client_host_name,
        instance_name,
        db_name,
        period,

        MIN(summary_status) AS summary_status,
        CASE
            WHEN MIN(summary_status) >= 2 THEN 'red'
            WHEN MIN(summary_status) = 1  THEN 'yellow'
            WHEN MIN(summary_status) = 0  THEN 'green'
            ELSE 'white'
        END AS summary,

        MIN(root_summary_status) AS root_summary_status_num,
        CASE
            WHEN MIN(root_summary_status) >= 2 THEN 'red'
            WHEN MIN(root_summary_status) = 1  THEN 'yellow'
            WHEN MIN(root_summary_status) = 0  THEN 'green'
            ELSE 'white'
        END AS root_summary_status,

        MAX(start_date)  AS max_start,
        MIN(root_start)  AS min_root_start,
        MAX(root_finish) AS max_root_finish
    FROM pretime_base
    GROUP BY server_id, client_id, client_host_name, instance_name, db_name, period
),

pretime_agg AS (
    SELECT
        server_id,
        client_id,
        client_host_name,
        instance_name,
        db_name,
        period,

        LISTAGG(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(policy_id), ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE '...')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY policy_id)      AS policy_ids,

        LISTAGG(DISTINCT policy_name, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE '...')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY policy_name)    AS policy_names,

        LISTAGG(DISTINCT job_type_name, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE '...')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY job_type_name)  AS job_type_names,

        LISTAGG(DISTINCT schedule_type_name, ',' ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE '...')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY schedule_type_name) AS schedule_type_names
    FROM pretime_base
    GROUP BY server_id, client_id, client_host_name, instance_name, db_name, period
),

/* 8) Final combined pretime (1 join instead of 4) */
pretime AS (
    SELECT
        s.server_id,
        s.client_id,
        s.client_host_name,
        s.instance_name,
        s.db_name,
        s.period,

        a.policy_ids,
        a.job_type_names,
        a.schedule_type_names,
        a.policy_names,

        s.summary_status,
        s.summary,
        s.root_summary_status,
        s.max_start,
        s.min_root_start,
        s.max_root_finish
    FROM pretime_stats s
    LEFT JOIN pretime_agg a
      ON a.server_id = s.server_id
     AND a.client_id = s.client_id
     AND a.client_host_name = s.client_host_name
     AND a.instance_name = s.instance_name
     AND a.db_name = s.db_name
     AND a.period = s.period
)

/* 9) Period end calculations */
SELECT
    p.*,
    CASE '${freeCombo1}'
      WHEN 'Days'     THEN p.period + 1  - (1/86400)
      WHEN 'Weeks'    THEN p.period + 7  - (1/86400)
      WHEN 'Months'   THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 1)  - (1/86400)
      WHEN 'Quarters' THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 3)  - (1/86400)
      WHEN 'Years'    THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 12) - (1/86400)
      ELSE p.period + 1 - (1/86400)
    END AS period_end,
    GREATEST(
      CASE '${freeCombo1}'
        WHEN 'Days'     THEN p.period + 1  - (1/86400)
        WHEN 'Weeks'    THEN p.period + 7  - (1/86400)
        WHEN 'Months'   THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 1)  - (1/86400)
        WHEN 'Quarters' THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 3)  - (1/86400)
        WHEN 'Years'    THEN ADD_MONTHS(p.period, 12) - (1/86400)
        ELSE p.period + 1 - (1/86400)
      END,
      p.max_start
    ) AS Trueperiod_end
FROM pretime p
ORDER BY p.client_host_name, p.instance_name, p.db_name, p.period

title: NBU SQLServer DB Detail
sql_query:
-- Author:  ernie.bergan@veritas.com
-- Last Modified 2022/08/11
-- Added Schedule level

-- Previously Modified:  2022/05/20
-- Added date ranging logic and additional hidden fields to help guide drilldowns
-- Previously Modified:   2022/04/27
--
-- Summarizes best status achieved for MSSQL policies per user-specified time period.
-- Default grouping is per day, based on job start time.
-- Jobs that don't resolve to a SQL Server DB name are ignored.
-- Order is client_name, instance name, DB name, period (date)
--
WITH vrs as (
  select '${instance}' as the_instance,
         '${dbName}' as the_DBname,
  --       '${summstatus}' as the_summ_status,
         '${serverId}' AS the_server,
         '${clientId}' AS the_client,
         '${policies}' AS the_policies
FROM apt_v_dual
) 
--select * from vrs
,
-- 1) Seed jobs strictly by requested range (do not lose these)
jobs_seed AS (
    SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
        server_id,
        job_id,
        parent_job_id,
        policy_id,
        policy_name,
        job_type_name,
        schedule_type_name,
        summary_status,
        vendor_status_name,
        client_id,
        client_host_name,
        nbu_job_id,
        parent_nbu_job_id,
        start_date,
        finish_date
    FROM apt_v_nbu_job_detail, vrs
    WHERE policy_type = 15
      AND start_date BETWEEN ${startDate} AND ${endDate}
      AND job_type NOT IN (107)
      AND server_id = the_server
      AND client_id = the_client
      AND policy_id IN (${policies})
),

-- 2) Root mapping (hierarchy-safe). Scoped to same clients AND same server_ids for performance.
seed_root AS (
    SELECT
        seed_job_id,
        MAX(job_id)         KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_job_id,
        MAX(summary_status) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_summary_status,
        MAX(start_date)     KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_start,
        MAX(finish_date)    KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY lvl) AS root_finish
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CONNECT_BY_ROOT d.job_id AS seed_job_id,
            d.job_id,
            d.summary_status,
            d.start_date,
            d.finish_date,
            LEVEL AS lvl
        FROM apt_v_nbu_job_detail d
        WHERE d.policy_type = 15
          AND d.client_id IN (${hosts})
          AND d.server_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT server_id FROM jobs_seed)
        START WITH d.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM jobs_seed)
        CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR d.parent_job_id = d.job_id
    )
    GROUP BY seed_job_id
),

-- 3) Parse DB name from job files into ONE row per job_id (prevents row explosion)
job_file_parse AS (
    SELECT
        jf.job_id,
        MAX(parsed_db_name) KEEP (
            DENSE_RANK FIRST
            ORDER BY LENGTH(parsed_db_name) DESC, parsed_db_name ASC
        ) AS parsed_db_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            jf.job_id,
            CASE
                WHEN jf.pathname IS NULL THEN NULL

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') + 3,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') - 2)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') + 3,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') - 2)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') > 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') + 4,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, '~') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') - 3)))

                WHEN INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') > 0
                 AND INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"%24ALL\"') = 0 THEN
                    TRIM('/' FROM TRIM('.' FROM SUBSTR(jf.pathname,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') + 10,
                        INSTR(jf.pathname, ';TYPE=') - 1 - INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') - 10)))
            END AS parsed_db_name
        FROM apt_v_nbu_job_file jf
        JOIN jobs_seed j
          ON j.job_id = jf.job_id
        WHERE jf.pathname IS NOT NULL
          AND jf.pathname <> 'AUTOMATIC_DATABASE_BACKUP'
          AND (
                 INSTR(jf.pathname, 'trx') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, 'inc') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '.md.') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '/md/') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '.db.') > 0
              OR INSTR(jf.pathname, '/db/') > 0
              OR (INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"') > 0 AND INSTR(jf.pathname, 'DATABASE=\"%24ALL\"') = 0)
          )
    ) jf
    WHERE parsed_db_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY job_id
),

-- 4) Policy instance fallback (can be many-per-policy; we only join when needed)
policy_instances AS (
    SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
        policy_id,
        instance_name
    FROM apt_v_nbu_policy_db_instance
    WHERE instance_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY policy_id, instance_name
),

--5) Build the base set in ONE pass:
--      - prefer parsed_db_name
--      - else fall back to policy instance (only if no parsed name)
--      - else UNKNOWN
--
pretime_base AS (
    SELECT
        j.server_id,
        j.client_id,
        j.client_host_name,
        NVL(pi.instance_name, 'none') AS instance_name,
        NVL(fp.parsed_db_name, NVL(pi.instance_name, 'UNKNOWN')) AS db_name,

        j.policy_id,
        j.policy_name,
        j.job_type_name,
        j.schedule_type_name,
        j.summary_status,
        j.vendor_status_name,
        j.start_date,
        j.finish_date,

        sr.root_job_id,
        sr.root_summary_status,
        sr.root_start,
        sr.root_finish,

        TRUNC(
            j.start_date,
            DECODE('${freeCombo1}','Days','DD','Weeks','IW','Months','MM','Quarters','Q','Years','YYYY')
        ) AS period
    FROM jobs_seed j
    LEFT JOIN seed_root sr
      ON sr.seed_job_id = j.job_id
    LEFT JOIN job_file_parse fp
      ON fp.job_id = j.job_id
    LEFT JOIN policy_instances pi
      ON pi.policy_id = j.policy_id
     AND fp.job_id IS NULL           -- only fallback to policy instances if no file-derived db name
)
select * from pretime_base, vrs
WHERE   instance_name = the_instance
AND     db_Name = the_DBname
